composition_summary: Elemental Liposomal Calcium (Tribasic Phosphate) 500 mg + Vitamin D2 600 IU Tablets
short_description: GLYPOCAL-LP Tablets provide elemental calcium with vitamin D2 to help address inadequate intake and support bone mineralisation.
full_description: GLYPOCAL-LP Tablets provide elemental calcium with vitamin D2 to help address inadequate intake and support bone mineralisation. Calcium contributes to normal muscle and nerve function, while vitamin D supports calcium absorption. It complements dietary measures and prescribed bone care when nutritional requirements are not adequately met.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Inadequate Calcium and Vitamin D Intake
benefits.description: Supplements dietary gaps when food intake or sunlight exposure does not adequately meet assessed nutritional needs.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support for Bone Health
benefits.description: Supports bone maintenance in adults, including postmenopausal women, alongside exercise, adequate protein and other prescribed measures.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Calcium
mechanisms.description: Supplies calcium needed for bone mineral and normal muscle and nerve activity.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Calcium Absorption
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D2 is converted to active metabolites that help the intestine absorb calcium.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Maintains Bone Mineralisation
mechanisms.description: Adequate calcium and vitamin D support normal bone turnover when nutritional intake is sufficient.

safety_sections.title: High Calcium and Kidney Problems
safety_sections.description: Avoid in hypercalcaemia. Kidney stones, kidney disease or parathyroid disorders require medical assessment before calcium or vitamin D supplementation.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Keep at least 4 hours from levothyroxine. Separate iron and interacting antibiotics according to their prescribing instructions.

safety_sections.title: Total Daily Intake
safety_sections.description: Include calcium and vitamin D from food and other supplements when assessing the dose. Excess intake can cause constipation or high blood calcium.

composition_summary: L-Methylfolate 5 mg + Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg + Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate 0.5 mg Tablets
short_description: FOLATIS combines active folate with methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate to support folate and vitamin B12 status.
full_description: FOLATIS combines active folate with methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate to support folate and vitamin B12 status. It helps meet specific nutritional needs involved in red blood cell formation, homocysteine metabolism and normal nerve function, when used under medical supervision alongside a balanced diet.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Folate and Vitamin B12 Insufficiency
benefits.description: Provides targeted supplementation when dietary intake, absorption or laboratory assessment indicates an increased requirement.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support for Homocysteine Metabolism
benefits.description: Supports folate-dependent pathways when the clinician identifies a relevant nutritional deficiency. It does not replace cardiovascular risk management.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supplies Active Coenzymes
mechanisms.description: Methylfolate, methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate provide biologically active forms of folate, vitamin B12 and vitamin B6.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports One-Carbon Metabolism
mechanisms.description: These nutrients participate in DNA synthesis and pathways that convert homocysteine to other compounds.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Blood and Nerve Function
mechanisms.description: Correcting relevant deficiencies supports normal red blood cell production and nerve function.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin B12 Assessment
safety_sections.description: Anaemia or neurological symptoms need assessment. Folate can improve blood counts while untreated vitamin B12 deficiency continues to damage nerves.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Supplements and Medicines
safety_sections.description: Review prenatal vitamins, antiepileptics and methotrexate with the clinician. Do not combine high-dose folate products without advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Individual Requirements
safety_sections.description: Use the prescribed folate form and dose during pregnancy. High-dose supplementation is appropriate only for an identified clinical need.

composition_summary: L-methylfolate 800 mcg + methylcobalamin 1500 mcg + pyridoxal-5-phosphate 500 mcg + DHA 200 mg per softgel capsule
short_description: FOLATIS-D combines methylfolate, methylcobalamin, active vitamin B6 and DHA to support nutritional needs before and during pregnancy.
full_description: FOLATIS-D combines methylfolate, methylcobalamin, active vitamin B6 and DHA to support nutritional needs before and during pregnancy. The B vitamins support normal cell division and blood formation, while DHA contributes to brain and retinal structure. Use should be guided by individual dietary and antenatal requirements.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 softgel capsule once daily.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Preconception Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Helps meet assessed folate, vitamin B12 and DHA needs while planning pregnancy, alongside a balanced diet and recommended antenatal care.

benefits.title: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding Nutrition
benefits.description: Supplements relevant nutrients when intake is inadequate. DHA contributes to maternal omega-3 intake and normal fetal tissue development.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Folate and B Vitamins
mechanisms.description: Supplies coenzymes required for normal DNA synthesis, blood formation and homocysteine metabolism.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supplies DHA
mechanisms.description: DHA is incorporated into cell membranes, including those of the developing brain and retina.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Maternal Nutrition
mechanisms.description: Helps close identified dietary gaps during preconception, pregnancy and breastfeeding.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin B12 Assessment
safety_sections.description: Anaemia or neurological symptoms need assessment. Folate can improve blood counts while untreated vitamin B12 deficiency continues to damage nerves.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Supplements and Medicines
safety_sections.description: Review prenatal vitamins, antiepileptics and methotrexate with the clinician. Do not combine high-dose folate products without advice.

safety_sections.title: DHA Source and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Check whether DHA is derived from fish or algae and avoid the product if allergic to its source or excipients.

composition_summary: Dydrogesterone 10 mg per tablet
short_description: Duvia-10 contains dydrogesterone, an oral progestogen used in selected conditions associated with insufficient progesterone activity.
full_description: Duvia-10 contains dydrogesterone, an oral progestogen used in selected conditions associated with insufficient progesterone activity. It helps regulate the response of the uterine lining and may be prescribed for menstrual disorders or luteal support. The dose and treatment days depend on the diagnosed condition.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — irregular cycles: take 1 tablet (10 mg) twice daily on cycle days 11–25. Endometriosis: take 1 tablet twice daily on days 5–25 or continuously under the selected treatment plan. Infertility due to luteal insufficiency: take 1 tablet twice daily on days 11–25 for at least 6 cycles. The prescriber must select one indication-specific schedule.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water, with or without food. Day 1 is the first day of menstrual bleeding. Space divided doses evenly. Pregnancy or assisted-reproduction support requires a separate specialist protocol; do not stop it independently.

benefits.title: Menstrual Disorders Associated with Progesterone Insufficiency
benefits.description: May be prescribed for irregular cycles, painful periods or dysfunctional bleeding after the cause has been evaluated.

benefits.title: Endometriosis
benefits.description: May help manage endometriosis-related symptoms when a progestogen is considered appropriate by the gynaecologist.

benefits.title: Luteal Support
benefits.description: May be prescribed in selected fertility protocols or progesterone-deficiency states. Pregnancy use requires specialist assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates Progesterone Receptors
mechanisms.description: Dydrogesterone binds to progesterone receptors in responsive tissues, particularly the uterine lining.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Changes the Endometrial Response
mechanisms.description: It promotes a progesterone-type response in an oestrogen-primed endometrium.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports the Prescribed Cycle
mechanisms.description: This helps regulate bleeding patterns or provide progestogenic support according to the treatment protocol.

safety_sections.title: Unexplained Bleeding and Tumours
safety_sections.description: Do not start before unexplained vaginal bleeding is investigated. Avoid with known or suspected progestogen-dependent tumours.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Inform the prescriber about liver disease. Stop and seek review for jaundice, severe abdominal pain or an allergic reaction.

safety_sections.title: Individual Pregnancy and Hormone Assessment
safety_sections.description: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and concurrent oestrogen therapy require individual review. Persistent breakthrough bleeding needs investigation.

composition_summary: Ferrous ascorbate equivalent to elemental iron 100 mg + folic acid 1.5 mg + zinc 22.5 mg per tablet
short_description: FEOMA-XT combines iron with folic acid and zinc to support red blood cell formation and address related nutritional deficiencies.
full_description: FEOMA-XT combines iron with folic acid and zinc to support red blood cell formation and address related nutritional deficiencies. Iron contributes to haemoglobin production, while folate supports cell division. It may be prescribed when iron requirements are increased or dietary intake is insufficient, following assessment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with water. Iron is better absorbed away from meals but may be taken after food if it causes nausea. Avoid tea, coffee, calcium and antacids near the dose.

benefits.title: Iron Deficiency and Related Anaemia
benefits.description: Provides iron when laboratory assessment confirms iron deficiency, with or without anaemia. The cause of deficiency also needs treatment.

benefits.title: Increased Nutritional Requirements
benefits.description: Supports assessed iron and folate needs during pregnancy, recovery or blood loss under medical supervision.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Absorbable Iron
mechanisms.description: Iron supplies the mineral needed to produce haemoglobin in developing red blood cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Cell Production
mechanisms.description: Folate and other supplied micronutrients contribute to normal cell division and blood formation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Replenishes Nutrient Stores
mechanisms.description: Continued prescribed supplementation helps restore iron stores and correct deficiency-related symptoms over time.

safety_sections.title: Iron Overload and Non-Iron Anaemia
safety_sections.description: Avoid in haemochromatosis or iron overload. Confirm the cause of anaemia before treatment. Not every low haemoglobin level is due to iron deficiency.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Effects and Accidental Ingestion
safety_sections.description: Nausea, constipation and dark stools may occur. Iron overdose can be fatal in children. Store securely out of their reach.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Separate from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours and from interacting antibiotics as directed. Monitor haemoglobin and iron stores.

composition_summary: Methylcobalamin 500 mcg + Ferrous Bis-Glycinate eq. to Elemental Iron 60 mg + Zinc Bis-Glycinate eq. to Elemental Zinc 15 mg + Folic Acid IP 1 mg Tablet
short_description: FEOMA-PLUS provides iron bisglycinate, methylcobalamin, folic acid and zinc to support blood formation when nutritional intake or stores are inadequate.
full_description: FEOMA-PLUS provides iron bisglycinate, methylcobalamin, folic acid and zinc to support blood formation when nutritional intake or stores are inadequate. Iron supports haemoglobin production, while folate and vitamin B12 contribute to normal red blood cell development. Use should follow assessment of the type and cause of anaemia.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water, preferably away from tea, coffee and calcium. Take after a meal if stomach discomfort occurs.

benefits.title: Iron Deficiency with Nutritional Gaps
benefits.description: Supplements iron and associated micronutrients when iron deficiency coexists with inadequate folate, vitamin B12 or zinc intake.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support in Increased Requirements
benefits.description: May be used during pregnancy or recovery when the clinician identifies a need for this specific combination.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Absorbable Iron
mechanisms.description: Iron supplies the mineral needed to produce haemoglobin in developing red blood cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Cell Production
mechanisms.description: Folate and other supplied micronutrients contribute to normal cell division and blood formation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Replenishes Nutrient Stores
mechanisms.description: Continued prescribed supplementation helps restore iron stores and correct deficiency-related symptoms over time.

safety_sections.title: Iron Overload and Non-Iron Anaemia
safety_sections.description: Avoid in haemochromatosis or iron overload. Confirm the cause of anaemia before treatment. Not every low haemoglobin level is due to iron deficiency.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Effects and Accidental Ingestion
safety_sections.description: Nausea, constipation and dark stools may occur. Iron overdose can be fatal in children. Store securely out of their reach.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Separate from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours and from interacting antibiotics as directed. Monitor haemoglobin and iron stores.

composition_summary: Myo-Inositol 1800 mg + Magnesium Sulphate 600 mg + Ashwagandha root extract 525 mg N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine 450 mg + Inositol 45 mg + Zinc 13.2 mg Chromium picolinate 400 mcg + Vitamin D2 plant source 600 IU Powder
short_description: Chromolyn combines myo-inositol with selected minerals, N-acetylcysteine, ashwagandha and vitamin D2 for nutritional support in women with metabolic or reproductive concerns.
full_description: Chromolyn combines myo-inositol with selected minerals, N-acetylcysteine, ashwagandha and vitamin D2 for nutritional support in women with metabolic or reproductive concerns. These ingredients participate in cellular signalling and antioxidant pathways. Benefits depend on the clinical context, and the formulation should complement an individualised diet and treatment plan.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this powder in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Mix the prescribed measured serving in water and consume promptly after a meal. Do not estimate a serving using an uncalibrated household spoon.

benefits.title: Adjunct Nutritional Support in PCOS
benefits.description: May be considered when the clinician identifies nutritional or metabolic support needs. Evidence for improved ovulation, fertility or weight loss remains limited.

benefits.title: Inadequate Micronutrient Intake
benefits.description: Provides selected micronutrients when dietary intake is insufficient and this combination is considered appropriate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supports Cellular Signalling
mechanisms.description: Myo-inositol participates in intracellular pathways involved in insulin and reproductive hormone signalling.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Antioxidant Substrates
mechanisms.description: N-acetylcysteine supplies cysteine for glutathione synthesis. Other ingredients provide additional nutritional support.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Assessed Nutrient Needs
mechanisms.description: Magnesium, zinc, chromium and vitamin D contribute to normal physiological processes when intake is inadequate.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Thyroid and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically cleared. Ashwagandha may affect thyroid function and has been linked to rare liver injury.

safety_sections.title: Glucose and Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Review diabetes medicines, sedatives, thyroid treatment and immunosuppressants. Monitor glucose if receiving glucose-lowering therapy.

safety_sections.title: Serving Size and Tolerance
safety_sections.description: Confirm the powder serving and elemental mineral amounts. Excess magnesium may cause diarrhoea, particularly in kidney impairment.

composition_summary: Highly purified Human Chorionic Gonadotropin 5000 IU Injection
short_description: Humiphin contains highly purified human chorionic gonadotropin, a hormone with luteinising hormone-like activity.
full_description: Humiphin contains highly purified human chorionic gonadotropin, a hormone with luteinising hormone-like activity. It is used in specialist fertility treatment to trigger final follicular maturation and ovulation after appropriate stimulation. It may also be prescribed for selected male hormonal disorders, with monitoring tailored to the indication.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Ovulation trigger in adult women: administer 5000–10000 IU once after adequate follicular development; each vial supplies 5000 IU. Use ultrasound and hormone monitoring to determine the exact trigger time.

Administration Advice
A trained healthcare professional must reconstitute the required vial(s) with the supplied diluent and administer by the route authorised for the pack. Do not assume that an intramuscular-only preparation is suitable for subcutaneous use.

benefits.title: Ovulation Induction in Women
benefits.description: Used after suitable follicular development to trigger ovulation in selected fertility treatment protocols.

benefits.title: Selected Male Hypogonadism
benefits.description: May stimulate testicular testosterone production in hypogonadotropic hypogonadism under specialist care, sometimes with other gonadotropins.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Mimics the LH Signal
mechanisms.description: hCG activates luteinising hormone receptors in the ovary or testis.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Stimulates Gonadal Function
mechanisms.description: It promotes final oocyte maturation and ovulation or stimulates Leydig-cell testosterone production.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports the Treatment Objective
mechanisms.description: Carefully timed administration supports the fertility or endocrine protocol selected by the specialist.

safety_sections.title: Ovarian Hyperstimulation and Clots
safety_sections.description: Seek urgent care for severe abdominal swelling, rapid weight gain, breathlessness or reduced urine. Ovarian hyperstimulation can cause thrombosis.

safety_sections.title: Multiple Pregnancy and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Ultrasound and hormonal monitoring are required during ovarian stimulation. Multiple pregnancy and ovarian torsion risks need counselling.

safety_sections.title: Hormone-Sensitive Conditions
safety_sections.description: Avoid in relevant hormone-dependent tumours, unexplained genital bleeding or unsuitable uncontrolled endocrine disorders. Disclose all fertility medicines.

composition_summary: Ondansetron - Mouth Dissolving 4 mg Tablet
short_description: Throfree contains ondansetron in a mouth-dissolving tablet that helps prevent nausea and vomiting by blocking serotonin signals.
full_description: Throfree contains ondansetron in a mouth-dissolving tablet that helps prevent nausea and vomiting by blocking serotonin signals. It is prescribed in settings such as chemotherapy, radiotherapy or surgery. The dose and timing depend on the treatment, age and liver function, and should follow medical advice.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Moderately emetogenic chemotherapy — adults and ages 12–17: take 8 mg (2 tablets) 30 minutes before chemotherapy and again 8 hours later, then 8 mg every 12 hours for 1–2 days afterwards. Ages 4–11: give 4 mg (1 tablet) before chemotherapy and 4 and 8 hours later, then 4 mg three times daily for 1–2 days. Severe liver impairment: maximum 8 mg/day. Radiotherapy and surgery require their own prescribed schedules.

Administration Advice
With dry hands, peel back the foil and place the tablet on the tongue. Let it dissolve and swallow with saliva. Water is not required.

benefits.title: Chemotherapy-Related Nausea and Vomiting
benefits.description: Helps prevent nausea and vomiting caused by prescribed cancer chemotherapy when used in the selected antiemetic regimen.

benefits.title: Radiotherapy or Surgery-Related Nausea and Vomiting
benefits.description: May be prescribed around radiotherapy or surgery. The required dose differs from routine symptom-directed use.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Serotonin Receptors
mechanisms.description: Ondansetron selectively blocks 5-HT3 receptors on gut vagal nerves and within central vomiting pathways.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Vomiting Signals
mechanisms.description: This interrupts serotonin-triggered communication between the gastrointestinal tract and the brain’s vomiting centres.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Prevents Nausea and Vomiting
mechanisms.description: Reduced activation of these pathways helps control treatment-associated nausea and vomiting.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Electrolytes
safety_sections.description: Avoid in congenital long-QT syndrome. Low potassium or magnesium and other QT-prolonging medicines increase rhythm risk.

safety_sections.title: Serotonergic Interactions and Apomorphine
safety_sections.description: Do not combine with apomorphine. Seek urgent advice for agitation, fever, tremor or rigidity when taking serotonergic medicines.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Bowel Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Severe liver impairment requires a lower maximum daily dose. Persistent vomiting, severe constipation or abdominal distension needs assessment.

composition_summary: Sucralfate 1 g + oxetacaine 20 mg per 10 mL oral suspension
short_description: Easefate combines sucralfate with oxetacaine to protect irritated upper gastrointestinal lining and relieve associated burning pain.
full_description: Easefate combines sucralfate with oxetacaine to protect irritated upper gastrointestinal lining and relieve associated burning pain. Sucralfate forms a protective barrier over damaged mucosa, while oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic relief. It is used within a prescribed treatment plan after the underlying cause of symptoms is assessed.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults being treated for an active peptic ulcer: take 10 mL four times daily, before the three main meals and at bedtime, for the prescribed course. Each dose supplies sucralfate 1 g and oxetacaine 20 mg. Reassess persistent pain or bleeding instead of increasing the dose.

Administration Advice
Shake well and measure with a calibrated medicine cup or oral syringe. Take on an empty stomach, 1 hour before or 2 hours after food. Keep other oral medicines at least 2 hours apart and antacids at least 30 minutes apart.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer-Related Mucosal Injury
benefits.description: May be prescribed to protect injured stomach or duodenal lining as part of treatment for an assessed ulcer condition.

benefits.title: Painful Gastritis or Acid-Related Irritation
benefits.description: Helps relieve burning discomfort associated with mucosal irritation when the clinician considers this combination appropriate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms a Protective Barrier
mechanisms.description: Sucralfate adheres to damaged mucosa and forms a local protective layer.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Exposure to Irritants
mechanisms.description: The barrier limits contact with acid, pepsin and bile while the lining recovers.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Local Pain
mechanisms.description: Oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic activity that helps reduce burning and discomfort.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Aluminium
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate contains aluminium. Severe kidney impairment requires caution because aluminium may accumulate, particularly with prolonged use.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Absorption
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate can reduce absorption of other medicines. Keep an appropriate gap, commonly at least 2 hours, and follow medicine-specific instructions.

safety_sections.title: Alarm Symptoms and Constipation
safety_sections.description: Persistent pain, weight loss, vomiting blood or black stools need prompt assessment. Constipation may occur.

composition_summary: Progesterone (Natural Micronized) 200 mg Softgels Capsules
short_description: Gestemme-200 contains natural micronised progesterone, used when progestogenic support is needed in a prescribed reproductive or hormone treatment plan.
full_description: Gestemme-200 contains natural micronised progesterone, used when progestogenic support is needed in a prescribed reproductive or hormone treatment plan. It acts on the uterine lining and supports its response to hormonal changes. The route, dose and treatment days depend on the condition and the product’s approved directions.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Oral endometrial protection with oestrogen in postmenopausal adults with an intact uterus: take 1 capsule (200 mg) at bedtime for 12 consecutive days in each 28-day treatment cycle. Fertility and pregnancy support require a separate indication-specific schedule.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole at bedtime. Use by mouth for this regimen; do not switch to vaginal administration unless the prescribed product is approved for that route. Drowsiness can occur.

benefits.title: Menstrual Disorders Related to Progesterone Insufficiency
benefits.description: May be prescribed for secondary amenorrhoea or selected irregular bleeding patterns after evaluation.

benefits.title: Endometrial Protection with Oestrogen Therapy
benefits.description: May be used cyclically in women with a uterus receiving menopausal oestrogen therapy.

benefits.title: Specialist Luteal Support
benefits.description: May be prescribed in selected fertility protocols when the formulation and route are specifically suitable.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates Progesterone Receptors
mechanisms.description: Micronised progesterone binds to receptors in progesterone-responsive reproductive tissues.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Endometrial Transformation
mechanisms.description: It changes the oestrogen-stimulated uterine lining towards a secretory state.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Progestogenic Support
mechanisms.description: This supports the prescribed cycle or hormone regimen when progesterone activity is required.

safety_sections.title: Unexplained Bleeding and Hormone-Sensitive Disease
safety_sections.description: Investigate unexplained vaginal bleeding before treatment. Relevant cancer history, clotting disorders and liver disease require medical review.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Administration Route
safety_sections.description: Oral progesterone may cause dizziness or sleepiness. Avoid driving if affected. Do not switch between oral and vaginal routes without explicit advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Excipients and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Follow the obstetrician’s instructions in pregnancy. Check excipients for relevant allergy and report persistent bleeding or severe headache.

composition_summary: Progesterone (Natural Micronized) 300 mg Sustained Release Tablets
short_description: Gestemme-300 contains natural micronised progesterone in a sustained-release tablet for prescribed progestogenic support.
full_description: Gestemme-300 contains natural micronised progesterone in a sustained-release tablet for prescribed progestogenic support. It helps regulate the response of the uterine lining in selected menstrual and hormonal conditions. The sustained-release formulation is intended for oral use, with the dose and cycle schedule determined by the treating clinician.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with menstrual irregularity due to progesterone insufficiency: take 1 sustained-release tablet (300 mg) once daily in the evening for 10 days per cycle, starting on cycle day 14. Use a separately specified schedule for other indications; this is not the 200 mg HRT regimen.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water at the same time each day, preferably in the evening if it causes drowsiness. Do not crush or chew. This sustained-release tablet is for oral use.

benefits.title: Menstrual Irregularity Related to Progesterone Insufficiency
benefits.description: May be prescribed for selected cycle disturbances after the underlying cause and pregnancy status have been assessed.

benefits.title: Prescribed Progestogenic Support
benefits.description: Provides progesterone support when the clinician selects this strength for an individual hormonal treatment plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates Progesterone Receptors
mechanisms.description: Micronised progesterone binds to receptors in progesterone-responsive reproductive tissues.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Endometrial Transformation
mechanisms.description: It changes the oestrogen-stimulated uterine lining towards a secretory state.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Progestogenic Support
mechanisms.description: This supports the prescribed cycle or hormone regimen when progesterone activity is required.

safety_sections.title: Unexplained Bleeding and Hormone-Sensitive Disease
safety_sections.description: Investigate unexplained vaginal bleeding before treatment. Relevant cancer history, clotting disorders and liver disease require medical review.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Administration Route
safety_sections.description: Oral progesterone may cause dizziness or sleepiness. Avoid driving if affected. Do not switch between oral and vaginal routes without explicit advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Excipients and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Follow the obstetrician’s instructions in pregnancy. Check excipients for relevant allergy and report persistent bleeding or severe headache.

composition_summary: Clindamycin 100 mg + Clotrimazole 100 mg + Tinidazole 100 mg Vaginal Softgels
short_description: CLINDAONE-CT combines clindamycin, clotrimazole and tinidazole in a vaginal softgel for selected mixed vaginal infections.
full_description: CLINDAONE-CT combines clindamycin, clotrimazole and tinidazole in a vaginal softgel for selected mixed vaginal infections. The ingredients act against susceptible bacteria, yeasts and certain protozoa. It may help relieve infection-related discharge and irritation when prescribed after evaluation, and is intended for vaginal insertion rather than swallowing.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: insert 1 vaginal softgel at bedtime for 7 consecutive nights. Persistent or recurrent discharge requires reassessment before another course.

Administration Advice
Wash hands, lie on the back with knees bent and insert the softgel deeply into the vagina. For vaginal use only; do not swallow. Avoid tampons and vaginal douching during treatment. Check the pack for effects on latex barrier contraception.

benefits.title: Mixed Bacterial and Fungal Vaginitis
benefits.description: May be prescribed when examination suggests a mixed infection involving susceptible bacteria and Candida species.

benefits.title: Selected Infective Vaginal Discharge
benefits.description: May be used for syndromic management when the clinician considers this combination appropriate. Suspected sexually transmitted infection requires specific testing and partner management.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Inhibits Bacterial Protein Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Clindamycin binds bacterial 50S ribosomes and suppresses growth of susceptible organisms.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Disrupts Fungal Membranes
mechanisms.description: Clotrimazole interferes with ergosterol synthesis needed for fungal cell membrane function.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Damages Susceptible Microbial DNA
mechanisms.description: Tinidazole forms reactive metabolites in susceptible anaerobic organisms and protozoa.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding
safety_sections.description: Use only after obstetric advice, especially in early pregnancy. Breastfeeding precautions depend on absorption and the prescribed product.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Local Irritation
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek review for severe diarrhoea or marked vaginal burning. A history of antibiotic-associated colitis requires caution.

safety_sections.title: Barrier Contraception and Alcohol
safety_sections.description: Vaginal bases may weaken latex condoms or diaphragms. Follow pack precautions and avoid alcohol during treatment and for 72 hours afterwards.

composition_summary: L-methylfolate 500 mcg + Myo-inositol 2000 mg + Vitamin D3 1000 IU 5 g Sachet
short_description: Ferticore combines myo-inositol, methylfolate and vitamin D3 for nutritional support in women with reproductive or metabolic concerns.
full_description: Ferticore combines myo-inositol, methylfolate and vitamin D3 for nutritional support in women with reproductive or metabolic concerns. Myo-inositol participates in cellular signalling, while folate and vitamin D support normal physiological functions. It may complement a clinician-directed PCOS care plan, with benefits dependent on individual nutritional and clinical needs.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take one 5 g sachet once daily. This supplies 2 g myo-inositol, 500 mcg methylfolate and 1000 IU vitamin D3.

Administration Advice
Dissolve the entire sachet in a glass of water, stir and drink promptly after a meal. Do not divide the powder by eye.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support in PCOS
benefits.description: May be considered as an adjunct after discussing the limited evidence for clinical benefits of inositol in PCOS.

benefits.title: Preconception Nutrient Intake
benefits.description: Helps supplement assessed folate and vitamin D requirements. It does not replace recommended folic acid advice or fertility treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Myo-Inositol
mechanisms.description: Myo-inositol acts as a precursor in intracellular second-messenger pathways.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Nutrient-Dependent Processes
mechanisms.description: Methylfolate supports cell division, while vitamin D contributes to calcium handling and normal cellular functions.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Nutritional Care
mechanisms.description: Replacing relevant dietary gaps may support normal metabolic and reproductive physiology. Fertility outcomes are not assured.

safety_sections.title: Evidence and Ongoing Evaluation
safety_sections.description: Do not use as a substitute for ovulation induction, diabetes treatment or investigation of infertility. Review response with the clinician.

safety_sections.title: Total Vitamin Intake
safety_sections.description: Avoid duplication with high-dose folate or vitamin D. Kidney stones, high calcium or kidney disease require advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Glucose-Lowering Medicines
safety_sections.description: Seek advice in pregnancy or while using diabetes medicines. Mild nausea or loose stools may occur.

composition_summary: Calcium citrate 425 mg + calcitriol 0.25 mcg + magnesium oxide 40 mg + zinc 20 mg per softgel capsule
short_description: GLYPOCAL-CZ combines calcium citrate with calcitriol and selected minerals for prescribed calcium and bone support.
full_description: GLYPOCAL-CZ combines calcium citrate with calcitriol and selected minerals for prescribed calcium and bone support. Calcitriol is an active vitamin D medicine that increases calcium absorption. This combination requires individual assessment and monitoring of calcium balance, particularly in people with kidney problems or other disorders affecting mineral metabolism.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 softgel capsule once daily. This provides 0.25 mcg calcitriol per day; adjust continued treatment using serum calcium, phosphate and kidney-function results.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water after a meal. Keep at least 4 hours apart from levothyroxine; separate interacting antibiotics according to their prescribing instructions.

benefits.title: Calcium Deficiency Requiring Active Vitamin D
benefits.description: May be prescribed when calcium supplementation and calcitriol are both clinically indicated following assessment.

benefits.title: Adjunct Bone and Mineral Support
benefits.description: Supports selected bone-care regimens when the clinician identifies a need for this combination. It does not replace osteoporosis-specific treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Calcium
mechanisms.description: Calcium citrate supplies calcium for skeletal and physiological requirements.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Activates Vitamin D Receptors
mechanisms.description: Calcitriol directly activates vitamin D receptors and increases intestinal calcium and phosphate absorption.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Mineral Balance
mechanisms.description: Appropriate replacement supports bone mineralisation when calcium levels and the underlying condition are monitored.

safety_sections.title: Hypercalcaemia and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Avoid in high blood calcium or vitamin D toxicity. Monitor calcium, phosphate and kidney function as advised.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney disease requires specialist guidance. Review digoxin, thiazides and magnesium-containing products because adverse effects may increase.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Calcium or Vitamin D
safety_sections.description: Do not add other calcium, calcitriol or high-dose vitamin D without advice. Report thirst, constipation, weakness or frequent urination.

composition_summary: Fructo Oligosaccharide (100 mg) + Lactobacillus crispatus (2Billion CFU) + Lactobacillus gasseri (0.6Billion CFU) + Lactobacillus jensenii (0.4Billion CFU) + Lactobacillus rhamnosus (2Billion CFU) Capsule
short_description: Ecofem-BV combines four Lactobacillus species with fructooligosaccharides to support microbial balance as part of a clinician-directed care plan.
full_description: Ecofem-BV combines four Lactobacillus species with fructooligosaccharides to support microbial balance as part of a clinician-directed care plan. The organisms are associated with normal intestinal or vaginal microbiota. Probiotic effects depend on the exact strains and route, and this supplement does not replace treatment for an active vaginal infection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
One capsule daily for a minimum of one month.


Administration Advice
For an oral product, swallow with water and separate antibiotics by at least 2 hours.

benefits.title: Microbiota Support During or After Treatment
benefits.description: May supplement a clinician-directed regimen when support for microbial balance is considered appropriate after antibiotic use.

benefits.title: Routine Intimate-Wellness Support
benefits.description: May be considered for nutritional microbiota support. Prevention of recurrent bacterial vaginosis has not been established for this exact formulation.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Delivers Selected Lactobacilli
mechanisms.description: Supplies the listed live organisms when viable counts are maintained during storage.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides a Prebiotic Substrate
mechanisms.description: Fructooligosaccharides can be fermented by selected intestinal bacteria.

mechanisms.title: 03 — May Support Microbial Balance
mechanisms.description: Benefits depend on strain survival and the host environment. Evidence for another probiotic cannot establish benefit for this blend.

safety_sections.title: Immunocompromised or Seriously Ill Patients
safety_sections.description: Seek specialist advice with severe illness, immunosuppression or an indwelling central venous catheter. Rare invasive probiotic infections can occur.

safety_sections.title: Active Vaginal Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Unusual discharge, pelvic pain, bleeding or fever needs examination. Do not delay antimicrobial treatment when indicated.

safety_sections.title: Storage and Tolerance
safety_sections.description: Follow pack storage instructions to preserve viability. Bloating or gas may occur. Check all excipients for allergy.

composition_summary: Astaxanthin 8 mg + Coenzyme Q10 100 mg + Elemental manganese 0.5 mg + Elemental selenium 50 mcg + L-methylfolate 220 mcg + Levocarnitine 300 mg + Lycopene 5000 mcg + Vitamin A 2500 IU + Vitamin B6 2 mg + Vitamin C 75 mg + Vitamin D3 600 IU + Vitamin E 10 mg + Zinc monomethionine 12.5 mg Tablets
short_description: OneQ10-LM combines coenzyme Q10, levocarnitine, carotenoids, vitamins and minerals for antioxidant and nutritional support.
full_description: OneQ10-LM combines coenzyme Q10, levocarnitine, carotenoids, vitamins and minerals for antioxidant and nutritional support. These nutrients contribute to normal energy metabolism and cellular protection when intake is inadequate. It may complement a clinician-directed wellness or reproductive care plan, without guaranteeing improved fertility or replacing specific treatment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Inadequate Antioxidant and Micronutrient Intake
benefits.description: Supplements selected nutrients when dietary intake is insufficient and the clinician considers this multi-ingredient formula appropriate.

benefits.title: Adjunct Reproductive Nutritional Support
benefits.description: May be considered during fertility evaluation as nutritional support. Improved egg quality, sperm parameters or pregnancy outcomes are not established for this exact blend.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supports Cellular Energy Pathways
mechanisms.description: Coenzyme Q10 participates in mitochondrial electron transfer, while carnitine helps transport fatty acids.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Antioxidant Nutrients
mechanisms.description: Carotenoids, vitamins C and E, selenium and other ingredients support antioxidant systems.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Helps Meet Nutritional Needs
mechanisms.description: Folate and micronutrients contribute to normal metabolic functions when dietary supply is inadequate.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin A and Duplicate Supplements
safety_sections.description: Check total vitamin A, selenium, zinc and vitamin D intake, particularly during pregnancy. Do not combine multiple antioxidant products without advice.

safety_sections.title: Anticoagulants and Other Interactions
safety_sections.description: Coenzyme Q10 may affect warfarin response. Review anticoagulants, thyroid treatment and mineral-sensitive antibiotics with the clinician.

safety_sections.title: Fertility and Cancer Treatment
safety_sections.description: Do not replace fertility investigations or treatment. Obtain oncologist approval before antioxidant supplementation during chemotherapy or radiotherapy.

composition_summary: Cranberry extract 300 mg + D-mannose 600 mg + hibiscus extract 100 mg + Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus 0.5 billion CFU + Lactobacillus reuteri 0.5 billion CFU per tablet (source spore wording corrected; strain codes not supplied)
short_description: CRANLY combines cranberry, D-mannose, hibiscus and selected probiotic species for urinary-wellness support.
full_description: CRANLY combines cranberry, D-mannose, hibiscus and selected probiotic species for urinary-wellness support. Cranberry constituents and D-mannose have been studied for their effects on bacterial adhesion, while probiotics may support microbial balance. Evidence varies by ingredient and formulation, and this product should not replace investigation or antibiotic treatment of infection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Adjunct Urinary-Wellness Support
benefits.description: May be considered alongside hydration and clinician-directed measures in people seeking non-antibiotic urinary health support.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support During Recurrence Assessment
benefits.description: May supplement an individual plan while recurrent urinary symptoms are investigated. Reliable prevention of infection is not established for this combination.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Cranberry Constituents
mechanisms.description: Certain cranberry proanthocyanidins can reduce bacterial adhesion in experimental systems. The extract’s active-content standardisation matters.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supplies D-Mannose and Probiotics
mechanisms.description: D-mannose may bind bacterial adhesins, while selected probiotic strains may influence microbial balance.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Offers Adjunctive Support
mechanisms.description: These proposed actions do not establish infection prevention for this formulation. A large trial found no preventive benefit from daily D-mannose.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Treatment
safety_sections.description: Fever, flank pain, vomiting, pregnancy-related urinary symptoms or blood in urine need prompt medical assessment. Do not delay antibiotics.

safety_sections.title: Evidence and Probiotic Identity
safety_sections.description: Benefits are formulation-specific. Confirm strain identities and viable counts. Probiotic species listed here do not normally form spores.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Problems and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Seek advice with kidney stones, kidney disease or warfarin use. Gastrointestinal upset may occur.

composition_summary: Yellow pea powder 9.6 g + Oryza sativa-rice 3.225 g + Myo-Inositol 600 mg + L-Carnitine 120 mg + Alpha lipoic acid 60 mg + Omega-3 Fatty Acids 24 mg + Vitamin C 12 mg + Vitamin E 6.6 IU + Vitamin B3 4.2 mg + Vitamin B5 18 mg + Vitamin B6 0.78 mg + Vitamin B2 0.78 mg + Vitamin B1 0.33 mg + Vitamin A 180 mcg + Vitamin B9 52.95 mcg Powder
short_description: Womento combines pea and rice ingredients with myo-inositol, carnitine, alpha-lipoic acid, omega-3 fatty acids and selected vitamins.
full_description: Womento combines pea and rice ingredients with myo-inositol, carnitine, alpha-lipoic acid, omega-3 fatty acids and selected vitamins. It provides supplemental nutrition when dietary intake is inadequate. The powder may support an individual nutritional plan, but its protein content and serving size must be assessed from the finished product label.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this powder in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Mix a measured serving in the labelled quantity of water or another suitable beverage. Consume promptly and use alongside regular meals.

benefits.title: Inadequate Dietary Intake
benefits.description: May supplement a balanced diet when the clinician identifies a need for additional plant-based nutrition and selected micronutrients.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support in Metabolic Care
benefits.description: May complement dietary planning for women with metabolic or reproductive concerns. It is not a treatment for PCOS, diabetes or infertility.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Dietary Substrates
mechanisms.description: Pea and rice ingredients supply nutrients, with their actual protein contribution determined by the finished formulation.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Nutrient Metabolism
mechanisms.description: B vitamins and other micronutrients participate in normal energy and cellular pathways.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Dietary Intake
mechanisms.description: Myo-inositol and other components provide additional nutritional support within a balanced dietary plan.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Protein Source
safety_sections.description: Check pea, rice and other ingredient sensitivities. The source ingredient weights are not equivalent to grams of protein.

safety_sections.title: Diabetes and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Review carbohydrate content and medicines for diabetes or thyroid disease. Alpha-lipoic acid may lower blood glucose.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Pregnancy
safety_sections.description: Use with individual advice in kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Do not use as the sole source of nutrition.

composition_summary: Tranexamic Acid 500 mg + Mefenamic Acid 250 mg Tablets
short_description: Traxpause MF combines tranexamic acid with mefenamic acid for prescribed management of heavy menstrual bleeding with period pain.
full_description: Traxpause MF combines tranexamic acid with mefenamic acid for prescribed management of heavy menstrual bleeding with period pain. Tranexamic acid helps reduce excessive clot breakdown, while mefenamic acid reduces prostaglandin-related pain and inflammation. It is used during the bleeding episode after assessment of the underlying cause.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with heavy menstrual bleeding and cramps: take 1 tablet three times daily during heavy-flow days, for no more than 5 days per cycle. Start when menstrual bleeding begins. Kidney impairment requires a lower or alternative regimen.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water after food, spacing doses through the day. Do not combine with other NSAID painkillers. Investigate persistent or irregular bleeding before repeating treatment.

benefits.title: Heavy Menstrual Bleeding
benefits.description: May help reduce excessive menstrual blood loss when this combination is prescribed after evaluation of the bleeding pattern.

benefits.title: Painful Periods with Heavy Flow
benefits.description: Provides pain relief during heavy menstrual bleeding through the anti-inflammatory effect of mefenamic acid.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Clot Breakdown
mechanisms.description: Tranexamic acid blocks plasminogen binding and limits fibrin breakdown.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Prostaglandin Formation
mechanisms.description: Mefenamic acid inhibits cyclo-oxygenase enzymes involved in pain and inflammation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Controls Bleeding and Pain
mechanisms.description: The combined effects reduce menstrual blood loss and associated cramps during treatment.

safety_sections.title: Blood Clots and Hormonal Contraception
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active or previous thrombosis unless a specialist specifically advises otherwise. Combined hormonal contraception can increase clot risk.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Mefenamic acid can cause ulcer bleeding and kidney injury. Avoid in active ulcers, severe kidney impairment or NSAID-sensitive asthma.

safety_sections.title: Abnormal Bleeding and Pregnancy
safety_sections.description: Irregular unexplained bleeding needs assessment. Do not use for bleeding in pregnancy without urgent medical evaluation.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Urgent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Seek urgent care for chest pain, breathlessness, leg swelling, black stools or visual disturbance.

composition_summary: Calcium Carbonate (1250 mg) + Vitamin D3 (2000 IU) + Methylcobalamin (1500 mcg) + L-Methyl Folate Calcium (1 mg) + Pyridoxal-5-phosphate (20 mg) Tablet
short_description: FOLATIS-CA combines calcium and vitamin D3 with methylcobalamin, methylfolate and active vitamin B6.
full_description: FOLATIS-CA combines calcium and vitamin D3 with methylcobalamin, methylfolate and active vitamin B6. It supports assessed bone and micronutrient requirements when dietary intake is inadequate. Calcium contributes to bone mineralisation, while the B vitamins participate in normal blood formation, nerve function and homocysteine metabolism.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Combined Calcium and Vitamin Insufficiency
benefits.description: Supplements calcium, vitamin D and selected B vitamins when an individual assessment identifies overlapping dietary gaps.

benefits.title: Adjunct Bone and Nerve Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Supports normal bone and nerve physiology when relevant nutrients are insufficient. It does not replace treatment for osteoporosis or neuropathic pain.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Calcium and Vitamin D
mechanisms.description: Calcium supplies skeletal mineral while vitamin D3 supports intestinal calcium absorption.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supplies Active B Vitamins
mechanisms.description: Methylcobalamin, methylfolate and pyridoxal phosphate participate in normal cellular and blood-forming pathways.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Deficiency Correction
mechanisms.description: Replacing identified nutrient deficits supports normal bone maintenance and nerve function.

safety_sections.title: High Calcium and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Avoid with hypercalcaemia. Kidney stones or kidney impairment require individual advice and monitoring.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin B6 and Duplicate Products
safety_sections.description: The 20 mg vitamin B6 content warrants review of long-term total intake. Stop and seek advice for new tingling or numbness.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Separate from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours. Review iron, antibiotics, antiepileptics and other supplements with the clinician.

composition_summary: Evening Primrose Oil 1000 mg & Tocotrienol 30 mg , L-Methyl Folate 400 mcg & Methylcobalamin1500 mcg Softgelatin Capsules
short_description: FOLATIS-ET combines evening primrose oil, tocotrienols, methylfolate and methylcobalamin for targeted nutritional support.
full_description: FOLATIS-ET combines evening primrose oil, tocotrienols, methylfolate and methylcobalamin for targeted nutritional support. Evening primrose oil supplies fatty acids, while the vitamins support normal cellular and blood-forming processes. It may complement an individual dietary plan, but benefits for hormonal symptoms or breast discomfort are not established for this formulation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 softgel capsule once daily.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Dietary Fatty Acid Support
benefits.description: Provides evening primrose oil when a clinician considers supplementary fatty acid intake appropriate.

benefits.title: Folate and Vitamin B12 Intake
benefits.description: Helps meet assessed folate and vitamin B12 needs when dietary intake is inadequate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supplies Fatty Acids
mechanisms.description: Evening primrose oil provides linoleic acid and variable amounts of gamma-linolenic acid.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Antioxidant Vitamin E Forms
mechanisms.description: Tocotrienols contribute antioxidant activity within biological membranes.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports B-Vitamin Pathways
mechanisms.description: Methylfolate and methylcobalamin support normal DNA synthesis and homocysteine metabolism.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding and Surgery
safety_sections.description: Review anticoagulants, antiplatelets and planned surgery before use. Stop according to the treating clinician’s instructions.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Seizures and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Seek advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding and with a seizure disorder. Check oil-source and capsule excipients for allergy.

safety_sections.title: Evidence and Vitamin Intake
safety_sections.description: Do not replace investigation of breast symptoms or menstrual disorders. Avoid duplicate high-dose folate products without advice.

composition_summary: Fosfomycin trometamol equivalent to fosfomycin 3 g per 8 g sachet of granules for oral solution (salt form inferred)
short_description: Foscore contains fosfomycin, an antibiotic supplied as granules for oral solution.
full_description: Foscore contains fosfomycin, an antibiotic supplied as granules for oral solution. It is prescribed as a single-dose treatment for selected uncomplicated bladder infections in women caused by susceptible bacteria. The sachet must be dissolved before use, and it is not suitable for treating kidney infection or unexplained recurrent urinary symptoms.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adult women with acute uncomplicated cystitis: take 1 sachet containing 3 g fosfomycin as a single dose. Do not take a daily course or repeat for the same episode without reassessment.

Administration Advice
Dissolve the entire sachet in a glass of water and drink immediately. Take on an empty stomach, 2–3 hours before or after food, preferably at bedtime after emptying the bladder. Do not swallow the dry granules.

benefits.title: Acute Uncomplicated Cystitis
benefits.description: Treats selected lower urinary tract infections in women when the likely organism and local antibiotic guidance support fosfomycin use.

benefits.title: Susceptible Resistant-Organism Cystitis
benefits.description: May be selected after culture confirms susceptibility, including some resistant organisms, when the infection remains an uncomplicated bladder infection.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Enters Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Fosfomycin is taken into susceptible bacterial cells through specific transport systems.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Cell Wall Synthesis
mechanisms.description: It inhibits MurA, an enzyme involved in an early step of peptidoglycan production.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Kills Urinary Pathogens
mechanisms.description: Disrupted cell wall formation causes bacterial death at effective urinary concentrations.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Infection and Persistent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Fever, flank pain or vomiting may indicate kidney infection and require prompt assessment. Seek review if symptoms persist after treatment.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Severe Diarrhoea
safety_sections.description: Avoid in known fosfomycin allergy. Persistent or bloody diarrhoea after an antibiotic needs medical review.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Severe kidney impairment requires individual advice. Metoclopramide may reduce fosfomycin exposure and should be reviewed.

composition_summary: Esomeprazole 40 mg + domperidone 30 mg sustained release per capsule
short_description: Stomazo-D combines esomeprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility.
full_description: Stomazo-D combines esomeprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility. The proton pump inhibitor reduces stomach acid, while domperidone promotes gastrointestinal movement. Use requires review of heart rhythm risks, other medicines and the shortest appropriate treatment duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. This supplies the full 30 mg daily domperidone dose. Use for the shortest necessary period and review within 7 days.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush, chew or combine with another domperidone-containing medicine.

benefits.title: Reflux with Regurgitation
benefits.description: May be prescribed when acid reflux is accompanied by troublesome regurgitation and the clinician considers a prokinetic appropriate.

benefits.title: Reflux-Associated Nausea
benefits.description: May help selected adults with nausea accompanying reflux when both components are justified after assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Suppresses Gastric Acid
mechanisms.description: Esomeprazole inhibits the gastric proton pump and reduces acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Upper Gut Motility
mechanisms.description: Domperidone blocks peripheral dopamine D2 receptors and supports coordinated gastric movement.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Associated Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced acidity and improved motility may relieve selected reflux-associated symptoms when the combination is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Domperidone may cause serious rhythm disturbances. Avoid with QT prolongation, significant electrolyte disturbance, potent CYP3A4 inhibitors or other QT-prolonging medicines.

safety_sections.title: Dose, Duration and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Do not exceed 30 mg domperidone daily. Use for the shortest period, usually no longer than 7 days without review. Avoid in moderate or severe liver impairment.

safety_sections.title: Gastrointestinal Obstruction
safety_sections.description: Do not use if there is gastrointestinal bleeding, mechanical obstruction or perforation. Persistent nausea requires investigation.

composition_summary: Esomeprazole 40 mg Tablets
short_description: Stomazo-40 contains esomeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production.
full_description: Stomazo-40 contains esomeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production. It helps manage gastro-oesophageal reflux and selected acid-related ulcers by reducing irritation and allowing damaged lining to heal. The dose, formulation and treatment duration depend on the diagnosed condition and the prescriber’s assessment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with erosive reflux disease: take 1 tablet (40 mg) once daily for 4 weeks; continue for a further 4 weeks only if healing remains incomplete after review.

Administration Advice
Swallow the tablet whole with water at least 1 hour before breakfast. Do not crush or chew the gastro-resistant tablet.

benefits.title: Gastro-Oesophageal Reflux Disease
benefits.description: Reduces acid-related heartburn and regurgitation and helps heal reflux-related oesophageal inflammation when indicated.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer Disease
benefits.description: May be prescribed for gastric or duodenal ulcers, including within an appropriate Helicobacter pylori eradication regimen when required.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches Acid-Producing Cells
mechanisms.description: Esomeprazole is absorbed and activated in the acidic environment of gastric parietal cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks the Proton Pump
mechanisms.description: It inhibits the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme responsible for the final step of acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Acid Exposure
mechanisms.description: Lower acidity helps relieve reflux symptoms and allows acid-related mucosal injury to heal.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Long-Term Treatment
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose for the necessary duration. Prolonged treatment may require review of magnesium, vitamin B12, fracture risk and persistent diarrhoea.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Tell the clinician about all medicines, particularly antiretrovirals, high-dose methotrexate and anticoagulants. Some combinations require avoidance or monitoring.

composition_summary: Pantoprazole 40 mg per gastro-resistant tablet
short_description: Panflat-40 contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production.
full_description: Panflat-40 contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production. It helps manage gastro-oesophageal reflux and selected acid-related ulcers by reducing irritation and allowing damaged lining to heal. The dose, formulation and treatment duration depend on the diagnosed condition and the prescriber’s assessment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with reflux oesophagitis: take 1 tablet (40 mg) once daily for 4 weeks. Extend to 8 weeks only after review if healing is incomplete.

Administration Advice
Swallow the gastro-resistant tablet whole with water 1 hour before breakfast. Do not crush, split or chew.

benefits.title: Gastro-Oesophageal Reflux Disease
benefits.description: Reduces acid-related heartburn and regurgitation and helps heal reflux-related oesophageal inflammation when indicated.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer Disease
benefits.description: May be prescribed for gastric or duodenal ulcers, including within an appropriate Helicobacter pylori eradication regimen when required.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches Acid-Producing Cells
mechanisms.description: Pantoprazole is absorbed and activated in the acidic environment of gastric parietal cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks the Proton Pump
mechanisms.description: It inhibits the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme responsible for the final step of acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Acid Exposure
mechanisms.description: Lower acidity helps relieve reflux symptoms and allows acid-related mucosal injury to heal.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Long-Term Treatment
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose for the necessary duration. Prolonged treatment may require review of magnesium, vitamin B12, fracture risk and persistent diarrhoea.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Tell the clinician about all medicines, particularly antiretrovirals, high-dose methotrexate and anticoagulants. Some combinations require avoidance or monitoring.

composition_summary: Bilastine 20 mg + Montelukast 10 mg Tablets
short_description: Bilariv-M combines bilastine with montelukast for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms requiring both antihistamine and leukotriene-blocking activity.
full_description: Bilariv-M combines bilastine with montelukast for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms requiring both antihistamine and leukotriene-blocking activity. It helps reduce sneezing, runny nose and associated irritation. The combination should be used after assessment of alternatives, particularly because montelukast can cause serious mood, sleep and behavioural effects.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily in the evening. Each dose supplies bilastine 20 mg and montelukast 10 mg.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after food or fruit juice. Take at the same time daily. This is maintenance treatment and does not relieve an acute asthma attack.

benefits.title: Allergic Rhinitis Inadequately Controlled with Alternatives
benefits.description: May be prescribed when appropriate alternative allergy treatments are insufficient or not tolerated and both ingredients are justified.

benefits.title: Associated Allergic Rhinoconjunctivitis Symptoms
benefits.description: May relieve itchy, watery eyes and nasal symptoms accompanying allergic rhinitis within the prescribed treatment plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Histamine Effects
mechanisms.description: Bilastine blocks peripheral H1 receptors to reduce histamine-related allergy symptoms.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Leukotriene Signalling
mechanisms.description: Montelukast blocks cysteinyl leukotriene receptors involved in allergic inflammation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Selected Allergy Symptoms
mechanisms.description: The two pathways can reduce nasal and associated eye symptoms when combination treatment is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Mood, Sleep and Behaviour Changes
safety_sections.description: Montelukast can cause serious neuropsychiatric effects, including suicidal thoughts. Stop treatment and contact the prescriber promptly for new mood, sleep or behavioural changes.

safety_sections.title: Appropriate Allergy Use
safety_sections.description: Reserve montelukast-containing treatment for allergic rhinitis when alternatives are ineffective or unsuitable. It does not treat an acute asthma attack.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Individual Assessment
safety_sections.description: Avoid driving if affected. Review pregnancy, breastfeeding, organ impairment and all other medicines with the clinician.

composition_summary: Pantoprazole 40 mg + Domperidone 30 mg SR Capsules
short_description: Panflat-DSR combines pantoprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility.
full_description: Panflat-DSR combines pantoprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility. The proton pump inhibitor reduces stomach acid, while domperidone promotes gastrointestinal movement. Use requires review of heart rhythm risks, other medicines and the shortest appropriate treatment duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. This supplies the full 30 mg daily domperidone dose. Use for the shortest necessary period and review within 7 days.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush, chew or combine with another domperidone-containing medicine.

benefits.title: Reflux with Regurgitation
benefits.description: May be prescribed when acid reflux is accompanied by troublesome regurgitation and the clinician considers a prokinetic appropriate.

benefits.title: Reflux-Associated Nausea
benefits.description: May help selected adults with nausea accompanying reflux when both components are justified after assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Suppresses Gastric Acid
mechanisms.description: Pantoprazole inhibits the gastric proton pump and reduces acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Upper Gut Motility
mechanisms.description: Domperidone blocks peripheral dopamine D2 receptors and supports coordinated gastric movement.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Associated Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced acidity and improved motility may relieve selected reflux-associated symptoms when the combination is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Domperidone may cause serious rhythm disturbances. Avoid with QT prolongation, significant electrolyte disturbance, potent CYP3A4 inhibitors or other QT-prolonging medicines.

safety_sections.title: Dose, Duration and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Do not exceed 30 mg domperidone daily. Use for the shortest period, usually no longer than 7 days without review. Avoid in moderate or severe liver impairment.

safety_sections.title: Gastrointestinal Obstruction
safety_sections.description: Do not use if there is gastrointestinal bleeding, mechanical obstruction or perforation. Persistent nausea requires investigation.

full_description: Doxicent CV contains cefpodoxime with clavulanic acid, a beta-lactamase inhibitor for treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections. Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet (cefpodoxime 200 mg/clavulanic acid 125 mg) every 12 hours for the prescribed infection-specific course. Reduce the dosing frequency in significant kidney impairment.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water immediately after food. Take doses about 12 hours apart and complete the prescribed course. Do not replace this combination with cefpodoxime alone without a new prescription.

benefits.title: Susceptible Urinary Tract Infections

mechanisms.title: 02 — Protects Against Selected Beta-Lactamases

mechanisms.title: 03 — Kills Susceptible Bacteria

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Antibiotic Resistance

safety_sections.title: Liver Problems

composition_summary: Aceclofenac 100 mg + Paracetamol 325 mg Tablets
short_description: Frecox combines aceclofenac and paracetamol for short-term relief of selected painful musculoskeletal conditions.
full_description: Frecox combines aceclofenac and paracetamol for short-term relief of selected painful musculoskeletal conditions. Aceclofenac reduces inflammation, while paracetamol supports pain relief. Treatment may make movement more comfortable during recovery. The combination should be used at the lowest effective dose for the shortest prescribed duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet twice daily for the shortest necessary course. Do not exceed 2 tablets in 24 hours; this supplies the maximum 200 mg daily aceclofenac dose.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water immediately after breakfast and the evening meal. Do not crush an enteric-coated enzyme component. Avoid other NSAIDs and review other paracetamol-containing medicines before use.

benefits.title: Musculoskeletal Pain and Inflammation
benefits.description: May relieve pain associated with acute strains, sprains or other assessed musculoskeletal conditions.

benefits.title: Arthritic Pain Flares
benefits.description: May be prescribed briefly for painful inflammatory flares, alongside the underlying condition’s treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Prostaglandin Production
mechanisms.description: Aceclofenac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase activity and reduces pain-related inflammatory mediators.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Additional Pain Relief
mechanisms.description: Paracetamol acts mainly within central pain pathways to support analgesia.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Pain-Limited Function
mechanisms.description: Reduced pain and inflammation can make movement more comfortable during a short prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active peptic ulcer, previous NSAID-related bleeding or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Stop and seek urgent care for black stools or vomiting blood.

safety_sections.title: Kidney, Heart and Liver Problems
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose briefly. Kidney disease, dehydration, cardiovascular disease and liver problems need medical assessment.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, particularly from 20 weeks onwards. Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Review anticoagulants and other interacting medicines.

safety_sections.title: Additional Ingredient Precautions
safety_sections.description: Avoid duplicate paracetamol and excessive alcohol because of liver toxicity. Seek advice before use if liver disease is present.

short_description: Nervia-NX combines pregabalin, nortriptyline and methylcobalamin for prescribed management of neuropathic pain.
full_description: Nervia-NX combines pregabalin, nortriptyline and methylcobalamin for prescribed management of neuropathic pain. Pregabalin and nortriptyline reduce abnormal pain signalling through different pathways, while methylcobalamin provides vitamin B12 support. The regimen should be individualised according to kidney function, tolerability and the exact release formulation supplied.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water. Do not crush a sustained-release tablet. Do not stop abruptly; withdrawal should follow a prescriber-directed taper.

benefits.title: Painful Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy
benefits.description: May reduce burning, tingling or shooting pain when neuropathic pain treatment is indicated after assessment.

benefits.title: Other Selected Peripheral Neuropathic Pain
benefits.description: May be prescribed for persistent nerve pain, including postherpetic symptoms, when the clinician selects this combination.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Excitatory Nerve Transmission
mechanisms.description: Pregabalin binds alpha-2-delta calcium-channel subunits and reduces excitatory neurotransmitter release.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Strengthens Descending Pain Control
mechanisms.description: Nortriptyline inhibits noradrenaline and serotonin reuptake, enhancing central modulation of pain.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Vitamin B12-Dependent Function
mechanisms.description: Methylcobalamin supports normal nerve and blood-cell function when vitamin B12 supply is inadequate.

safety_sections.title: Sedation and Breathing Risk
safety_sections.description: Dizziness and sleepiness may impair driving. Alcohol, opioids and sedatives increase respiratory-depression risk.

safety_sections.title: Heart, Eye and Urinary Problems

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Withdrawal
