composition_summary: Lactulose 10 g per 15 mL oral solution
short_description: Mesolac contains lactulose, an osmotic laxative that softens stools by increasing water within the bowel.
full_description: Mesolac contains lactulose, an osmotic laxative that softens stools by increasing water within the bowel. It helps manage constipation and may also be prescribed at a different dose for hepatic encephalopathy. The dose is adjusted to the treatment goal, bowel response and risk of fluid or electrolyte disturbance.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Constipation in adults: start with 15–30 mL once daily and adjust to produce a soft stool; allow 2–3 days for effect. Hepatic encephalopathy in adults: start with 30–45 mL three or four times daily and titrate to 2–3 soft stools per day under medical monitoring.

Administration Advice
Measure with a calibrated cup. Take the constipation dose at the same time daily, with or without food; dilute in water or juice if needed. Maintain adequate fluids unless fluid restriction has been prescribed.

benefits.title: Constipation
benefits.description: Helps soften hard stools and improve bowel frequency when dietary and lifestyle measures are insufficient.

benefits.title: Hepatic Encephalopathy
benefits.description: May reduce intestinal ammonia absorption in patients with liver disease when prescribed as part of a supervised treatment plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches the Colon Unabsorbed
mechanisms.description: Lactulose passes through the small intestine with limited absorption.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Draws Water into the Bowel
mechanisms.description: Colonic bacteria ferment it into organic acids, increasing osmotic water retention and softening stools.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Ammonia Absorption
mechanisms.description: Acidification converts ammonia to less absorbable ammonium and promotes its elimination in stool.

safety_sections.title: Obstruction and Abdominal Pain
safety_sections.description: Do not use with suspected bowel obstruction, perforation or unexplained severe abdominal pain.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Electrolytes
safety_sections.description: Excess dosing can cause diarrhoea, dehydration and electrolyte disturbance. Adjust the dose and seek review if symptoms persist.

safety_sections.title: Diabetes and Sugar Intolerance
safety_sections.description: The solution may contain residual sugars. Review use in diabetes or galactose-related disorders and follow product-specific contraindications.

composition_summary: Rabeprazole Sodium 20 mg Tablets & Injection
short_description: Rabtico-20 contains rabeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production.
full_description: Rabtico-20 contains rabeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces stomach acid production. It helps manage gastro-oesophageal reflux and selected acid-related ulcers by reducing irritation and allowing damaged lining to heal. The dose, formulation and treatment duration depend on the diagnosed condition and the prescriber’s assessment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: oral tablet — take 20 mg once daily; erosive reflux disease is treated for 4–8 weeks. Intravenous injection — administer 20 mg once daily while oral treatment is unsuitable, then switch to oral therapy as soon as possible.

Administration Advice
Tablet: swallow whole with water before breakfast. Injection: hospital administration only; reconstitute and dilute using the vial’s authorised directions, then give by slow intravenous injection or infusion. Do not administer the injectable product by mouth or intramuscularly.

benefits.title: Gastro-Oesophageal Reflux Disease
benefits.description: Reduces acid-related heartburn and regurgitation and helps heal reflux-related oesophageal inflammation when indicated.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer Disease
benefits.description: May be prescribed for gastric or duodenal ulcers, including within an appropriate Helicobacter pylori eradication regimen when required.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches Acid-Producing Cells
mechanisms.description: Rabeprazole is absorbed and activated in the acidic environment of gastric parietal cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks the Proton Pump
mechanisms.description: It inhibits the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme responsible for the final step of acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Acid Exposure
mechanisms.description: Lower acidity helps relieve reflux symptoms and allows acid-related mucosal injury to heal.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Long-Term Treatment
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose for the necessary duration. Prolonged treatment may require review of magnesium, vitamin B12, fracture risk and persistent diarrhoea.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Tell the clinician about all medicines, particularly antiretrovirals, high-dose methotrexate and anticoagulants. Some combinations require avoidance or monitoring.

composition_summary: Sucralfate (500 mg/5 mL) + Oxetacaine (10 mg/5 mL) Syrup
short_description: Goodfate-O combines sucralfate with oxetacaine to protect irritated upper gastrointestinal lining and relieve associated burning pain.
full_description: Goodfate-O combines sucralfate with oxetacaine to protect irritated upper gastrointestinal lining and relieve associated burning pain. Sucralfate forms a protective barrier over damaged mucosa, while oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic relief. It is used within a prescribed treatment plan after the underlying cause of symptoms is assessed.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults being treated for an active peptic ulcer: take 10 mL four times daily, before the three main meals and at bedtime, for the prescribed course. Each dose supplies sucralfate 1 g and oxetacaine 20 mg. Reassess persistent pain or bleeding instead of increasing the dose.

Administration Advice
Shake well and measure with a calibrated medicine cup or oral syringe. Take on an empty stomach, 1 hour before or 2 hours after food. Keep other oral medicines at least 2 hours apart and antacids at least 30 minutes apart.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer-Related Mucosal Injury
benefits.description: May be prescribed to protect injured stomach or duodenal lining as part of treatment for an assessed ulcer condition.

benefits.title: Painful Gastritis or Acid-Related Irritation
benefits.description: Helps relieve burning discomfort associated with mucosal irritation when the clinician considers this combination appropriate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms a Protective Barrier
mechanisms.description: Sucralfate adheres to damaged mucosa and forms a local protective layer.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Exposure to Irritants
mechanisms.description: The barrier limits contact with acid, pepsin and bile while the lining recovers.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Local Pain
mechanisms.description: Oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic activity that helps reduce burning and discomfort.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Aluminium
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate contains aluminium. Severe kidney impairment requires caution because aluminium may accumulate, particularly with prolonged use.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Absorption
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate can reduce absorption of other medicines. Keep an appropriate gap, commonly at least 2 hours, and follow medicine-specific instructions.

safety_sections.title: Alarm Symptoms and Constipation
safety_sections.description: Persistent pain, weight loss, vomiting blood or black stools need prompt assessment. Constipation may occur.

composition_summary: Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg SR (10 mg IR + 20 mg SR) Capsules
short_description: Rabtico-DSR combines rabeprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility.
full_description: Rabtico-DSR combines rabeprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux symptoms associated with nausea or impaired upper gastrointestinal motility. The proton pump inhibitor reduces stomach acid, while domperidone promotes gastrointestinal movement. Use requires review of heart rhythm risks, other medicines and the shortest appropriate treatment duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. This supplies the full 30 mg daily domperidone dose. Use for the shortest necessary period and review within 7 days.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush, chew or combine with another domperidone-containing medicine.

benefits.title: Reflux with Regurgitation
benefits.description: May be prescribed when acid reflux is accompanied by troublesome regurgitation and the clinician considers a prokinetic appropriate.

benefits.title: Reflux-Associated Nausea
benefits.description: May help selected adults with nausea accompanying reflux when both components are justified after assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Suppresses Gastric Acid
mechanisms.description: Rabeprazole inhibits the gastric proton pump and reduces acid secretion.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Upper Gut Motility
mechanisms.description: Domperidone blocks peripheral dopamine D2 receptors and supports coordinated gastric movement.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Associated Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced acidity and improved motility may relieve selected reflux-associated symptoms when the combination is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Domperidone may cause serious rhythm disturbances. Avoid with QT prolongation, significant electrolyte disturbance, potent CYP3A4 inhibitors or other QT-prolonging medicines.

safety_sections.title: Dose, Duration and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Do not exceed 30 mg domperidone daily. Use for the shortest period, usually no longer than 7 days without review. Avoid in moderate or severe liver impairment.

safety_sections.title: Gastrointestinal Obstruction
safety_sections.description: Do not use if there is gastrointestinal bleeding, mechanical obstruction or perforation. Persistent nausea requires investigation.

composition_summary: Probiotics (2.5 Billion Cells) & Prebiotic Softgel Capsules
short_description: Omnagut combines probiotics with a prebiotic for support of intestinal microbial balance.
full_description: Omnagut combines probiotics with a prebiotic for support of intestinal microbial balance. Probiotics provide selected live microorganisms, while the prebiotic supplies substrates used by some beneficial bacteria. The clinical effect depends on the strains, viable count and formulation, and the product complements appropriate dietary and medical care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take 1 capsule daily after meals or as advised by a healthcare professional.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water and separate antibacterial medicines by at least 2 hours. Follow storage instructions and avoid exposing live organisms to heat.

benefits.title: Support During Antibiotic Use
benefits.description: May be considered as an adjunct for selected patients receiving antibiotics. Prevention of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea depends on the specific probiotic strain.

benefits.title: Digestive Microbiota Support
benefits.description: May supplement dietary measures when support for intestinal microbial balance is considered appropriate after clinical assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Delivers Live Microorganisms
mechanisms.description: The capsule supplies the labelled probiotic organisms when viability is preserved.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Fermentable Substrate
mechanisms.description: The prebiotic can be used by selected intestinal bacteria.

mechanisms.title: 03 — May Influence Intestinal Balance
mechanisms.description: Strain-specific effects may support microbial balance and digestive function. Benefits cannot be assumed from CFU count alone.

safety_sections.title: Severe Illness and Immunosuppression
safety_sections.description: Use only after specialist advice in critically ill or immunocompromised patients or those with central venous catheters.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea Requiring Assessment
safety_sections.description: Fever, blood in stools, dehydration or persistent diarrhoea needs medical assessment. Probiotics do not replace rehydration or required treatment.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Storage
safety_sections.description: Check excipients for allergy and follow temperature instructions. Gas and bloating may occur.

composition_summary: Rabeprazole 20 mg + Levosulpiride 75 mg SR Capsules
short_description: Rabtico-L combines rabeprazole with levosulpiride in a modified-release capsule for selected reflux symptoms requiring additional motility support.
full_description: Rabtico-L combines rabeprazole with levosulpiride in a modified-release capsule for selected reflux symptoms requiring additional motility support. Rabeprazole reduces stomach acid, while levosulpiride promotes upper gastrointestinal movement. It is prescribed after clinical assessment, with treatment duration and suitability reviewed according to symptoms, response and other medicines.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. Review symptom response and the need for continued combination treatment.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush or chew the gastro-resistant or sustained-release components.

benefits.title: Reflux Not Adequately Controlled by Acid Suppression
benefits.description: May be prescribed when reflux symptoms persist and the clinician considers adding a motility agent appropriate.

benefits.title: Reflux with Post-Meal Fullness or Regurgitation
benefits.description: May help selected patients with associated upper gastrointestinal motility symptoms after obstructive or other causes are excluded.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Acid Secretion
mechanisms.description: Rabeprazole inhibits H+/K+-ATPase in gastric parietal cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Gastrointestinal Motility
mechanisms.description: Levosulpiride blocks dopamine D2 receptors to support acetylcholine-mediated gastrointestinal movement.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Selected Reflux Symptoms
mechanisms.description: The combined actions address acidity and associated motility symptoms within the prescribed treatment plan.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding, Obstruction and Alarm Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Avoid with gastrointestinal bleeding, obstruction or perforation. Unexplained weight loss, dysphagia or persistent vomiting needs investigation.

safety_sections.title: Movement, Hormonal and Heart Effects
safety_sections.description: Levosulpiride can cause tremor, stiffness, involuntary movements, raised prolactin and rhythm disturbances. Report these promptly and review interacting medicines.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Prolonged Use
safety_sections.description: Use in pregnancy or breastfeeding only after individual advice. Long-term proton pump inhibitor treatment needs periodic review.

composition_summary: Rabeprazole 20 mg + Itopride 150 mg SR Capsules
short_description: Rabtico-IT combines rabeprazole with itopride in a modified-release capsule for selected reflux symptoms requiring additional motility support.
full_description: Rabtico-IT combines rabeprazole with itopride in a modified-release capsule for selected reflux symptoms requiring additional motility support. Rabeprazole reduces stomach acid, while itopride promotes upper gastrointestinal movement. It is prescribed after clinical assessment, with treatment duration and suitability reviewed according to symptoms, response and other medicines.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. Review symptom response and the need for continued combination treatment.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush or chew the gastro-resistant or sustained-release components.

benefits.title: Reflux Not Adequately Controlled by Acid Suppression
benefits.description: May be prescribed when reflux symptoms persist and the clinician considers adding a motility agent appropriate.

benefits.title: Reflux with Post-Meal Fullness or Regurgitation
benefits.description: May help selected patients with associated upper gastrointestinal motility symptoms after obstructive or other causes are excluded.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Acid Secretion
mechanisms.description: Rabeprazole inhibits H+/K+-ATPase in gastric parietal cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Gastrointestinal Motility
mechanisms.description: Itopride blocks dopamine D2 receptors and inhibits acetylcholinesterase to support acetylcholine-mediated gastrointestinal movement.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Selected Reflux Symptoms
mechanisms.description: The combined actions address acidity and associated motility symptoms within the prescribed treatment plan.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding, Obstruction and Alarm Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Avoid with gastrointestinal bleeding, obstruction or perforation. Unexplained weight loss, dysphagia or persistent vomiting needs investigation.

safety_sections.title: Hormonal Effects and Medicine Review
safety_sections.description: Itopride may raise prolactin and cause abdominal discomfort. Review other medicines and report breast changes or menstrual disturbances.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Prolonged Use
safety_sections.description: Use in pregnancy or breastfeeding only after individual advice. Long-term proton pump inhibitor treatment needs periodic review.

composition_summary: Deflazacort 6 mg per tablet
short_description: Deftos-6 contains deflazacort, a prescription corticosteroid that reduces inflammation and suppresses excessive immune activity.
full_description: Deftos-6 contains deflazacort, a prescription corticosteroid that reduces inflammation and suppresses excessive immune activity. It is used in selected inflammatory, allergic and autoimmune conditions when systemic steroid treatment is justified. The dose varies widely by disease and response, and treatment may require gradual withdrawal rather than abrupt stopping.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: the total dose is 6–90 mg daily according to the inflammatory or autoimmune condition and its severity. Each tablet supplies 6 mg. Start at the indication-specific prescribed dose, then reduce to the lowest effective dose; prolonged treatment requires a planned gradual taper.

Administration Advice
Take the prescribed total daily dose with food, preferably in the morning when given once daily. Swallow with water. Do not stop abruptly after prolonged treatment; follow the written taper.

benefits.title: Selected Severe Inflammatory or Allergic Disorders
benefits.description: May be prescribed for conditions such as significant inflammatory airway, skin or joint disease when systemic corticosteroid treatment is appropriate.

benefits.title: Autoimmune and Other Steroid-Responsive Disorders
benefits.description: May help control excessive immune activity in selected conditions under specialist supervision.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates Glucocorticoid Receptors
mechanisms.description: The active metabolite binds intracellular glucocorticoid receptors.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Changes Inflammatory Gene Activity
mechanisms.description: This reduces production of inflammatory mediators and modifies immune-cell responses.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Suppresses Excess Inflammation
mechanisms.description: The resulting effect reduces steroid-responsive inflammation and immune activity.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Vaccination
safety_sections.description: Steroids can mask or worsen infection. Report fever and exposure to chickenpox or measles. Live vaccines may be unsuitable during immunosuppressive doses.

safety_sections.title: Glucose, Bone and Eye Effects
safety_sections.description: Monitor blood glucose, blood pressure and relevant bone or eye risks during continued therapy. Mood and sleep changes may occur.

safety_sections.title: Adrenal Suppression and Withdrawal
safety_sections.description: Do not stop prolonged treatment abruptly. Illness or surgery may require additional steroid cover and an individual taper.

composition_summary: Cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) 60000 IU per softgel capsule (D3 form inferred)
short_description: Oneriv D3 60K contains high-dose vitamin D3 for prescribed correction of vitamin D deficiency.
full_description: Oneriv D3 60K contains high-dose vitamin D3 for prescribed correction of vitamin D deficiency. Vitamin D supports calcium and phosphate absorption and normal bone mineralisation. This strength is usually given intermittently during a defined treatment course, followed by reassessment and an appropriate maintenance plan rather than unsupervised daily use.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with confirmed vitamin D deficiency: take 1 capsule (60000 IU) once weekly for 8 weeks. Recheck vitamin D and calcium before selecting maintenance therapy. Do not take this strength daily.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water after a main meal on the same day each week. Mark the weekly dose on a calendar and avoid duplicate high-dose vitamin D products.

benefits.title: Laboratory-Assessed Vitamin D Deficiency
benefits.description: Replenishes vitamin D when deficiency is established and a clinician selects a high-dose replacement course.

benefits.title: Deficiency-Related Bone Mineralisation Problems
benefits.description: May form part of treatment for osteomalacia or associated low calcium when the underlying cause and calcium needs are addressed.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Cholecalciferol
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D3 is absorbed and converted to 25-hydroxyvitamin D in the liver.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Forms Active Vitamin D
mechanisms.description: Further conversion, mainly in the kidney, produces the active hormone calcitriol.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Mineral Absorption
mechanisms.description: Active vitamin D supports intestinal calcium and phosphate uptake and appropriate bone mineralisation.

safety_sections.title: High Calcium and Vitamin D Toxicity
safety_sections.description: Avoid with hypercalcaemia or vitamin D toxicity. Excess dosing can cause vomiting, thirst, frequent urination, confusion and kidney injury.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Stones and Special Conditions
safety_sections.description: Kidney disease, stones, sarcoidosis and parathyroid disorders require individual assessment before high-dose treatment.

safety_sections.title: Dose Frequency and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Check the weekly schedule carefully. Review digoxin, thiazides and other vitamin D or calcium products. Paediatric or pregnancy dosing must be prescribed individually.

composition_summary: Acebrophylline 100 mg Capsules
short_description: Ekabro contains acebrophylline, a medicine used in selected chronic airway disorders associated with mucus and airflow limitation.
full_description: Ekabro contains acebrophylline, a medicine used in selected chronic airway disorders associated with mucus and airflow limitation. It helps modify mucus and support airway clearance, with bronchodilator-related activity. It is an adjunct to an individual respiratory treatment plan and should not be used for rapid relief of an acute attack.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule (100 mg) twice daily, approximately 12 hours apart. Review dosing separately in older adults and in kidney or liver impairment.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water after breakfast and the evening meal. Use regularly for airway maintenance; use the prescribed rescue inhaler for sudden breathlessness.

benefits.title: Chronic Obstructive Airway Disease with Mucus
benefits.description: May be prescribed as an adjunct when mucus production and difficulty clearing secretions contribute to symptoms.

benefits.title: Selected Chronic Bronchitic Symptoms
benefits.description: May help manage mucus-associated cough and airflow symptoms after the underlying respiratory condition is assessed.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Modifies Mucus Properties
mechanisms.description: Acebrophylline influences mucus production and surfactant-related processes.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Airway Clearance
mechanisms.description: Improved mucus characteristics can help mucociliary transport and expectoration.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Airway Function
mechanisms.description: Additional bronchodilator and anti-inflammatory actions may support symptoms in selected chronic airway disease.

safety_sections.title: Acute Breathlessness
safety_sections.description: This medicine is not a rescue treatment. Sudden or severe breathlessness needs the prescribed reliever and urgent assessment when appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Cardiac and Seizure History
safety_sections.description: Tell the prescriber about arrhythmia, recent cardiac illness, seizures or peptic ulcer. Palpitations or significant dizziness need review.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Organ Impairment
safety_sections.description: Review other xanthines and interacting medicines. Kidney or liver disease, pregnancy and breastfeeding require individual advice.

composition_summary: Fexofenadine hydrochloride 120 mg per tablet
short_description: Fexostil 120 contains fexofenadine, an antihistamine that helps relieve histamine-related allergy symptoms with generally low sedating potential.
full_description: Fexostil 120 contains fexofenadine, an antihistamine that helps relieve histamine-related allergy symptoms with generally low sedating potential. It reduces itching and irritation by blocking peripheral H1 receptors. The prescribed strength depends on the indication, with treatment adjusted to symptoms, age, kidney function and the individual response.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older with seasonal allergic rhinitis: take 1 tablet (120 mg) once daily. Kidney impairment requires review of a lower starting strength.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water before a meal. Do not take with apple, orange or grapefruit juice. Keep aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids at least 2 hours apart.

benefits.title: Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis
benefits.description: Relieves sneezing, runny nose and nasal itching associated with seasonal allergens.

benefits.title: Associated Allergic Eye Symptoms
benefits.description: Helps relieve watery, itchy eyes occurring with allergic rhinoconjunctivitis.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Histamine H1 Receptors
mechanisms.description: Fexofenadine prevents histamine from activating peripheral H1 receptors.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Allergic Tissue Responses
mechanisms.description: This limits histamine-related itching, vascular leakage and irritation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Allergy Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced histamine activity helps control the symptoms appropriate to the prescribed indication.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Drowsiness
safety_sections.description: Avoid if allergic to an ingredient. Although usually less sedating, individual responses vary. Do not drive if dizzy or sleepy.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Pregnancy
safety_sections.description: Ask for individual advice with kidney impairment, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Age-appropriate formulations may be needed for children.

safety_sections.title: Fruit Juice and Antacids
safety_sections.description: Take with water rather than fruit juice. Separate aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids by at least 2 hours.

composition_summary: Fexofenadine hydrochloride 180 mg per tablet
short_description: Fexostil 180 contains fexofenadine, an antihistamine that helps relieve histamine-related allergy symptoms with generally low sedating potential.

benefits.title: Chronic Idiopathic Urticaria
benefits.description: Helps relieve hives and associated itching when prescribed for this condition.

benefits.title: Allergic Rhinitis with Associated Symptoms
benefits.description: May be prescribed for nasal and eye allergy symptoms when this strength is appropriate under local product directions.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Pregnancy
safety_sections.description: Ask for individual advice with kidney impairment, pregnancy or breastfeeding. Age-appropriate formulations may be needed for children.

safety_sections.title: Fruit Juice and Antacids
safety_sections.description: Take with water rather than fruit juice. Separate aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids by at least 2 hours.

composition_summary: Fexofenadine hydrochloride 120 mg + montelukast 10 mg per tablet
short_description: Fexostil-M combines fexofenadine with montelukast for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms requiring both antihistamine and leukotriene-blocking activity.
full_description: Fexostil-M combines fexofenadine with montelukast for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms requiring both antihistamine and leukotriene-blocking activity. It helps reduce sneezing, runny nose and associated irritation. The combination should be used after assessment of alternatives, particularly because montelukast can cause serious mood, sleep and behavioural effects.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily in the evening. This supplies fexofenadine 120 mg and montelukast 10 mg.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water before food. Avoid fruit juice around the dose and keep aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids at least 2 hours apart. Do not use for an acute asthma attack.

benefits.title: Allergic Rhinitis Inadequately Controlled with Alternatives
benefits.description: May be prescribed when appropriate alternative allergy treatments are insufficient or not tolerated and both ingredients are justified.

benefits.title: Associated Allergic Rhinoconjunctivitis Symptoms
benefits.description: May relieve itchy, watery eyes and nasal symptoms accompanying allergic rhinitis within the prescribed treatment plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Histamine Effects
mechanisms.description: Fexofenadine blocks peripheral H1 receptors to reduce histamine-related allergy symptoms.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Leukotriene Signalling
mechanisms.description: Montelukast blocks cysteinyl leukotriene receptors involved in allergic inflammation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Selected Allergy Symptoms
mechanisms.description: The two pathways can reduce nasal and associated eye symptoms when combination treatment is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Mood, Sleep and Behaviour Changes
safety_sections.description: Montelukast can cause serious neuropsychiatric effects, including suicidal thoughts. Stop treatment and contact the prescriber promptly for new mood, sleep or behavioural changes.

safety_sections.title: Appropriate Allergy Use
safety_sections.description: Reserve montelukast-containing treatment for allergic rhinitis when alternatives are ineffective or unsuitable. It does not treat an acute asthma attack.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Individual Assessment
safety_sections.description: Avoid driving if affected. Review pregnancy, breastfeeding, organ impairment and all other medicines with the clinician.

composition_summary: Sultamicillin 375 mg Tablets
short_description: Sultics-375 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption.
full_description: Sultics-375 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption. Ampicillin acts against susceptible bacteria, while sulbactam protects it from certain bacterial enzymes. It is prescribed for selected bacterial infections, with the dose and course determined by the infection, response and kidney function.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1–2 tablets (375–750 mg) twice daily, according to infection severity. Continue for the prescribed course; streptococcal infections require at least 10 days. Significant kidney impairment requires a longer dosing interval.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at evenly spaced times, with or without food. Complete the prescribed course and avoid sharing antibiotics.

benefits.title: Susceptible Respiratory Tract Infections
benefits.description: Treats selected bacterial throat, sinus or lower respiratory infections when the organism and clinical situation support this antibiotic.

benefits.title: Susceptible Urinary Tract Infections
benefits.description: May be prescribed for selected urinary infections according to clinical assessment and susceptibility results.

benefits.title: Selected Skin and Soft Tissue Infections
benefits.description: May be used for susceptible uncomplicated bacterial skin infections when the prescribed strength is appropriate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Releases Two Active Components
mechanisms.description: After absorption, sultamicillin is hydrolysed to ampicillin and sulbactam.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Protects Antibacterial Activity
mechanisms.description: Sulbactam inhibits selected beta-lactamases that would otherwise break down ampicillin.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Disrupts Bacterial Cell Walls
mechanisms.description: Ampicillin inhibits peptidoglycan cross-linking and kills susceptible bacteria.

safety_sections.title: Beta-Lactam Allergy
safety_sections.description: Inform the doctor about penicillin or cephalosporin allergy. Stop and seek emergency care for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin reaction.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Antibiotic Resistance
safety_sections.description: Persistent or bloody diarrhoea needs medical review. Use only for prescribed bacterial infections and complete the prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney impairment may require dose adjustment. Review anticoagulants, probenecid and other medicines with the prescriber.

composition_summary: Sultamicillin 750 mg Tablets
short_description: Sultics-750 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption.
full_description: Sultics-750 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption. It is prescribed for selected bacterial infections, with the dose and course determined by the infection, response and kidney function.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet (750 mg) twice daily for the prescribed infection-specific course. Streptococcal infections require at least 10 days. Use a lower strength when a 375 mg dose is required; significant kidney impairment requires a longer dosing interval.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at evenly spaced times, with or without food. Complete the prescribed course and avoid sharing antibiotics.
