safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney impairment may require dose adjustment. Review anticoagulants, probenecid and other medicines with the prescriber.

composition_summary: Hydroquinone 2% + Mometasone 0.1% + Tretinoin 0.025% Cream
short_description: Melacore combines hydroquinone, tretinoin and mometasone for short-term, supervised treatment of facial melasma.
full_description: Melacore combines hydroquinone, tretinoin and mometasone for short-term, supervised treatment of facial melasma. Hydroquinone reduces pigment production, tretinoin supports epidermal turnover, and mometasone limits inflammation. Consistent sun protection is essential, and the cream should be used only on the prescribed areas for the advised duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply a thin film once nightly to the affected pigmented area only. Review after 2 weeks; the dermatologist must set a short stop date for this mometasone-containing combination.

Administration Advice
Cleanse gently, pat dry and apply sparingly, avoiding the eyelids, lips, nostrils and broken skin. Wash hands afterwards. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen and protective clothing during the day.

benefits.title: Moderate Facial Melasma
benefits.description: May be prescribed for assessed moderate facial melasma when a short course of this combination is appropriate.

benefits.title: Severe Facial Melasma
benefits.description: May form part of dermatologist-supervised treatment for more pronounced melasma, with strict sun protection and scheduled review.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Melanin Production
mechanisms.description: Hydroquinone inhibits tyrosinase-related pathways involved in melanin synthesis.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Promotes Epidermal Turnover
mechanisms.description: Tretinoin alters keratinocyte turnover and helps disperse epidermal pigment.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Controls Treatment-Related Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Mometasone suppresses local inflammatory responses during the prescribed short course.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy or while planning pregnancy because the cream contains tretinoin. Seek individual advice during breastfeeding.

safety_sections.title: Steroid and Hydroquinone Risks
safety_sections.description: Prolonged use may cause skin thinning, steroid acne, visible vessels or paradoxical darkening. Do not apply beyond the prescribed areas or duration.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek advice for severe irritation or blue-black pigmentation. Avoid strong exfoliants, waxing and unnecessary sun exposure.

composition_summary: Clindamycin 1% + Adapalene 0.1% Gel
short_description: Clindaone-AD combines clindamycin with adapalene for treatment of acne involving inflamed spots and blocked pores.
full_description: Clindaone-AD combines clindamycin with adapalene for treatment of acne involving inflamed spots and blocked pores. Clindamycin reduces susceptible acne-associated bacteria, while adapalene helps normalise follicular cell turnover. Regular, limited application and gentle skin care are important, with treatment reviewed to assess response, irritation and antibiotic duration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older: apply a thin film once nightly over the acne-affected area. Review response at 8–12 weeks and stop prolonged antibiotic use unless specifically renewed.

Administration Advice
Cleanse gently and allow the skin to dry before application. A pea-sized amount is sufficient for the whole face. Avoid eyes, lips, nostrils and damaged skin; wash hands afterwards and use daytime sunscreen.

benefits.title: Inflammatory Acne
benefits.description: Helps treat papules and pustules when topical antibiotic and retinoid combination therapy is appropriate.

benefits.title: Mixed Comedonal and Inflammatory Acne
benefits.description: Adapalene helps reduce blocked pores alongside treatment of inflammatory lesions.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Clindamycin inhibits bacterial protein synthesis at the 50S ribosomal subunit.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Normalises Follicular Turnover
mechanisms.description: Adapalene acts on retinoid receptors and reduces formation of microcomedones.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Acne Lesions
mechanisms.description: Antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects work alongside improved follicular clearance.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Skin Irritation
safety_sections.description: Avoid during pregnancy or when planning pregnancy. Dryness, peeling and stinging may occur, particularly early in treatment.

safety_sections.title: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhoea
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek advice for persistent or bloody diarrhoea, even with topical use. A history of antibiotic-related colitis needs review.

safety_sections.title: Resistance and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: Use antibiotics only for the prescribed course. The dermatologist may add benzoyl peroxide separately to reduce resistance. Limit sun exposure.

composition_summary: Clobetasol propionate 0.05% w/w + salicylic acid 6.5% w/w ointment (as supplied; verify 6.5%)
short_description: Clobtos-AD combines a very potent topical corticosteroid with salicylic acid for selected thick, scaly inflammatory skin lesions.
full_description: Clobtos-AD combines a very potent topical corticosteroid with salicylic acid for selected thick, scaly inflammatory skin lesions. Clobetasol suppresses inflammation and itching, while salicylic acid loosens scale. The combination requires short-term medical supervision because excessive application can increase steroid absorption, skin damage and salicylate-related adverse effects.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply a thin layer to the prescribed thickened plaque once daily for up to 2 weeks, then reassess. Do not increase frequency or treat extensive areas. Confirm the unusual 6.5% salicylic acid declaration before publication.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces.

benefits.title: Thick Plaques of Psoriasis
benefits.description: May be prescribed for limited, thick psoriatic plaques when a very potent steroid and scale-removing agent are appropriate.

benefits.title: Hyperkeratotic Steroid-Responsive Dermatoses
benefits.description: May help selected chronic thickened inflammatory lesions after diagnosis by a clinician.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Suppresses Local Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Clobetasol activates glucocorticoid receptors and reduces inflammatory mediator production.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Loosens Excess Scale
mechanisms.description: Salicylic acid reduces cohesion between surface skin cells and helps remove thick scale.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Access to Thickened Skin
mechanisms.description: Reduced scale can improve steroid penetration, requiring careful limits on treated area and duration.

safety_sections.title: Potent Steroid Restrictions
safety_sections.description: Avoid the face, groin, skin folds and broken skin unless specifically directed. Do not use under occlusion or on large areas.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Paediatric Use
safety_sections.description: Do not use for undiagnosed rashes or routine ringworm treatment. Children have greater systemic absorption risk and need specialist advice.

safety_sections.title: Absorption and Toxicity
safety_sections.description: Prolonged use may cause skin thinning or adrenal suppression. Salicylate absorption increases on damaged skin and in kidney impairment.

composition_summary: Fusidic acid 2% w/w cream
short_description: Fusifite contains fusidic acid, a topical antibiotic used for selected superficial bacterial skin infections.
full_description: Fusifite contains fusidic acid, a topical antibiotic used for selected superficial bacterial skin infections. It inhibits bacterial protein production and is particularly active against susceptible staphylococci. A short prescribed course helps treat the affected area while limiting unnecessary antibiotic exposure and the risk of resistance.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to the affected skin three times daily for 5–7 days. Reassess if the infection fails to improve or spreads.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the affected area, apply gently and wash hands afterwards. Keep away from the eyes and mucous membranes. Use a clean dressing only when directed.

benefits.title: Localised Impetigo
benefits.description: May treat limited superficial impetigo caused by susceptible bacteria when topical treatment is appropriate.

benefits.title: Selected Superficial Staphylococcal Infections
benefits.description: May be prescribed for localised infected skin lesions, such as susceptible folliculitis or secondary bacterial infection.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Enters Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Fusidic acid reaches bacterial cells at the treated skin surface.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Protein Synthesis
mechanisms.description: It interferes with elongation factor G, which is required for bacterial protein production.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Limits Bacterial Growth
mechanisms.description: Suppression of essential protein synthesis helps control susceptible superficial infection.

safety_sections.title: Resistance and Treatment Duration
safety_sections.description: Avoid repeated or prolonged courses without review. It is not a treatment for fungal or viral skin infection.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Persistent Infection
safety_sections.description: Stop for significant irritation or rash. Spreading redness, fever or failure to improve requires reassessment.

safety_sections.title: Application Site
safety_sections.description: Use on the skin only. Avoid the eyes and mucosal surfaces and use in pregnancy or infancy only as advised.

composition_summary: Glutathione + kojic acid + vitamin A + vitamin C + vitamin E cream; individual forms and concentrations not supplied
short_description: Velliglow is a topical cosmetic cream combining glutathione, kojic acid and vitamins A, C and E for a more even-looking complexion.
full_description: Velliglow is a topical cosmetic cream combining glutathione, kojic acid and vitamins A, C and E for a more even-looking complexion. The ingredients support surface skin care and antioxidant functions. Regular use may improve the appearance of dullness and uneven tone, with results dependent on formulation, tolerance and sun protection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to the intended skin area once nightly. If irritation develops, stop and obtain a skin-care review.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry skin, avoiding eyes, lips and broken skin. Do not layer with other retinoid or exfoliating products without advice. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.

benefits.title: Uneven-Looking Skin Tone
benefits.description: Helps improve the cosmetic appearance of uneven tone as part of a consistent skin-care routine.

benefits.title: Dull-Looking Skin
benefits.description: Provides skin-conditioning and antioxidant ingredients to support a brighter-looking appearance.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Pigment-Related Ingredients
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid can influence tyrosinase activity. The effect depends on concentration and formulation.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Surface Antioxidant Care
mechanisms.description: Glutathione and vitamins C and E provide antioxidant ingredients for topical skin care.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Conditions the Complexion
mechanisms.description: Regular tolerated use may improve the appearance of dullness and uneven tone without altering natural skin colour permanently.

safety_sections.title: Patch Testing and Irritation
safety_sections.description: Patch test before wider use. Stop for persistent burning, rash, swelling or significant irritation. Avoid use on damaged skin.

safety_sections.title: Sun Protection and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Use appropriate daytime sun protection. Introduce other exfoliating or retinoid products cautiously to limit irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Persistent Pigmentation
safety_sections.description: Seek advice before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Persistent, changing or symptomatic pigmentation needs dermatological assessment.

composition_summary: Tranexamic acid + kojic acid + alpha-arbutin + niacinamide + flower acid + vitamin C in a facial serum base; concentrations and flower-acid identity not supplied
short_description: Traxpause-KC combines tranexamic acid with selected pigment-modulating and skin-conditioning ingredients in a facial serum.
full_description: Traxpause-KC combines tranexamic acid with selected pigment-modulating and skin-conditioning ingredients in a facial serum. It may help improve the appearance of uneven pigmentation when used within a dermatologist-directed routine. The effect depends on the concentrations and formulation, while regular sun protection remains essential for managing pigmentation concerns.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply 2–3 drops as a thin layer to the intended facial area once nightly. Stop if persistent burning or redness develops.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry skin and allow it to absorb before moisturiser. Avoid eyes, lips and broken skin. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.

benefits.title: Uneven Facial Pigmentation
benefits.description: May be prescribed as part of a topical pigmentation plan after the cause of discolouration has been assessed.

benefits.title: Post-Blemish Dark Marks
benefits.description: May help improve the appearance of residual marks following inflammation, alongside treatment of the underlying skin condition.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Modulates Pigment Signalling
mechanisms.description: Topical tranexamic acid may influence plasmin-related pathways involved in UV-associated pigmentation.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Targets Pigment Formation and Transfer
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid and arbutin influence tyrosinase-related processes. Niacinamide may reduce melanosome transfer.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Surface Skin Renewal
mechanisms.description: Vitamin C and the specified acid blend may support antioxidant care and surface appearance, depending on formulation.

safety_sections.title: Patch Testing and Irritation
safety_sections.description: Patch test before wider use. Stop for persistent burning, rash, swelling or significant irritation. Avoid use on damaged skin.

safety_sections.title: Sun Protection and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Use appropriate daytime sun protection. Introduce other exfoliating or retinoid products cautiously to limit irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Persistent Pigmentation
safety_sections.description: Seek advice before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Persistent, changing or symptomatic pigmentation needs dermatological assessment.

composition_summary: L-Glutathione 600 mg + Silybum marianum extract 250 mg + N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 125 mg + Co-Enzyme Q10 60 mg + Alpha lipoic acid 50 mg + Pinus gerardiana bark extract 50 mg + Curcuma longa rhizome extract 50 mg + Phycocyanin from spirulina plantesis dried powder 50 mg + Vitamin C (L-ASCORBIC ACID) 40 mg + Grape seed extract 15 mg + Camellia sinensis-tea catechins 10 mg + Vitamin E 10 mg + Provitamin A 4.8 mg + Astaxanthin 4 mg + Lycopene 2 mg + Folic acid 0.1 mg
short_description: Glutella Plus combines glutathione with selected antioxidant ingredients for nutritional support.
full_description: Glutella Plus combines glutathione with selected antioxidant ingredients for nutritional support. These compounds participate in cellular antioxidant pathways, but the effect of an oral blend depends on its formulation and the individual. It may complement a balanced diet and should not be presented as a proven skin-lightening or disease-treatment product.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take one tablet daily with water, preferably after a meal.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Supplemental Antioxidant Intake
benefits.description: May be considered when a clinician identifies a reason for this antioxidant combination alongside an adequate diet.

benefits.title: Adjunct Skin Nutritional Support
benefits.description: May complement a skin-care plan when appropriate. Reliable improvement in pigmentation or prevention of skin ageing has not been established for this blend.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Antioxidant Ingredients
mechanisms.description: The listed ingredients supply antioxidant molecules or substrates involved in cellular protective pathways.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Endogenous Systems
mechanisms.description: Glutathione and related nutritional pathways participate in handling reactive oxygen species.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Nutritional Intake
mechanisms.description: Supplementation may support assessed dietary gaps. Biochemical activity does not establish a cosmetic or disease-treatment benefit.

safety_sections.title: Cancer Treatment and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Obtain clinician approval before use with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, anticoagulants or glucose-lowering medicines. Supplement interactions may be clinically important.

safety_sections.title: Allergy, Liver and Kidney Problems
safety_sections.description: Check all ingredients for allergy. Seek advice with liver or kidney disease and stop for jaundice, severe nausea or persistent abdominal pain.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Evidence Limits
safety_sections.description: Avoid unsupervised use in pregnancy, breastfeeding or children. Skin-lightening, anti-ageing and disease-treatment claims are not established for this exact formulation.

composition_summary: Luliconazole 1% Cream
short_description: Lulifite contains luliconazole, a topical antifungal used for selected dermatophyte infections of the skin.
full_description: Lulifite contains luliconazole, a topical antifungal used for selected dermatophyte infections of the skin. It interferes with fungal membrane formation and helps control the organisms causing ringworm, groin infection or athlete’s foot. Treatment duration depends on the site, and regular application should continue for the prescribed course.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply once daily for 1 week for tinea corporis or cruris and for 2 weeks for interdigital tinea pedis.

Administration Advice
Wash and dry the area thoroughly. Apply a thin layer over the affected skin and approximately 2.5 cm of surrounding skin. Wash hands afterwards. For external skin use only.

benefits.title: Tinea Corporis and Tinea Cruris
benefits.description: Treats susceptible ringworm infections affecting the body or groin when topical therapy is appropriate.

benefits.title: Interdigital Tinea Pedis
benefits.description: Treats susceptible athlete’s foot between the toes according to the prescribed regimen.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Ergosterol Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Luliconazole inhibits fungal lanosterol demethylase.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Disrupts Fungal Membranes
mechanisms.description: Reduced ergosterol impairs the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Controls Susceptible Dermatophytes
mechanisms.description: Membrane disruption limits fungal growth and helps resolve the infection during the prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Correct Diagnosis
safety_sections.description: Do not treat undiagnosed rashes indefinitely. Scalp, nail, extensive or recurrent fungal infection may require a different treatment.

safety_sections.title: Local Irritation and Application Site
safety_sections.description: Avoid eyes, mouth and vaginal use. Stop for severe burning, rash or swelling.

safety_sections.title: Steroid Combinations and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Do not add a steroid cream unless specifically directed. Pregnancy, breastfeeding and use in children require product-specific advice.

composition_summary: Tacrolimus 0.1% Ointment
short_description: Tracore contains tacrolimus, a topical calcineurin inhibitor used as a second-line treatment for selected patients with atopic dermatitis.
full_description: Tracore contains tacrolimus, a topical calcineurin inhibitor used as a second-line treatment for selected patients with atopic dermatitis. It reduces local immune activation and inflammation without being a corticosteroid. Treatment should be short-term or intermittent, with the strength, treated areas and review schedule determined by the dermatologist.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 16 years or older: apply a thin layer twice daily during an active atopic-dermatitis flare. Stop when signs resolve; reassess if no improvement occurs within 6 weeks.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry affected skin and rub in gently. Avoid occlusive dressings, eyes and mucous membranes. Keep emollients at least 2 hours apart on the same area and minimise sunlight exposure.

benefits.title: Moderate Atopic Dermatitis Requiring Second-Line Therapy
benefits.description: May be prescribed when appropriate topical treatments have not worked adequately or are unsuitable.

benefits.title: Severe Atopic Dermatitis Requiring Intermittent Control
benefits.description: May help manage selected severe eczema flares within a specialist-directed plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Enters Skin Immune Cells
mechanisms.description: Tacrolimus binds the intracellular protein FKBP-12.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Calcineurin Signalling
mechanisms.description: The complex inhibits calcineurin and reduces T-cell cytokine production.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Reduces Eczematous Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Lower immune activation helps reduce itching and inflammatory skin changes in appropriate patients.

safety_sections.title: Age and Immune Status
safety_sections.description: The 0.1% strength is for patients aged 16 years or older. Avoid use in immunocompromised patients unless a specialist specifically directs it.

safety_sections.title: Long-Term Safety and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: Avoid continuous long-term use and unnecessary UV exposure. Rare malignancy reports led to a warning, although causation is unproven.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Burning
safety_sections.description: Do not apply to untreated infected skin. Temporary burning may occur. Persistent lymph-node swelling or a changing skin lesion needs review.

composition_summary: Sunscreen lotion; UV filters, concentrations, tested SPF, UVA rating and water-resistance duration not supplied
short_description: Yuvizee is a sunscreen lotion intended to help protect exposed skin from ultraviolet radiation when applied correctly.
full_description: Yuvizee is a sunscreen lotion intended to help protect exposed skin from ultraviolet radiation when applied correctly. Use forms part of a sun-protection routine that includes shade and protective clothing. The degree of UVB and UVA protection depends on the tested SPF, UVA rating and filters in the finished product.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply evenly 15 minutes before sun exposure, using approximately 2 mg/cm² of skin. Reapply at least every 2 hours outdoors and after swimming, heavy sweating or towel drying.

Administration Advice
Cover all exposed areas, including ears and neck, avoiding the eyes. Use enough to form an even film. Combine with shade and protective clothing; follow the actual pack’s SPF and water-resistance claims.

benefits.title: Daily Protection of Exposed Skin
benefits.description: Helps reduce ultraviolet exposure when the lotion is used at the labelled amount and reapplied appropriately.

benefits.title: Support During Pigmentation Care
benefits.description: Can complement a pigmentation-management routine by reducing UV exposure that may worsen uneven pigmentation.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms a Surface Film
mechanisms.description: The lotion distributes its UV filters across the skin when an adequate amount is applied.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Attenuates Ultraviolet Radiation
mechanisms.description: Verified UV filters absorb and/or scatter ultraviolet radiation according to their properties.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Maintains Protection with Reapplication
mechanisms.description: Reapplication replaces film lost through wear, water and sweating. Protection depends on the tested formulation and correct use.

safety_sections.title: SPF, UVA and Water Resistance
safety_sections.description: Do not assume SPF 50+, broad-spectrum or water-resistant performance without test-supported label claims. No sunscreen blocks all ultraviolet radiation.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Eye Contact
safety_sections.description: Patch test if skin is sensitive. Avoid the eyes and stop for rash or persistent irritation.

safety_sections.title: Infants and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: For infants under 6 months, prioritise shade and protective clothing and seek paediatric advice before sunscreen use. Avoid prolonged intense sun exposure.

composition_summary: Ebastine 20 mg Tablet
short_description: Ebacore contains ebastine, an antihistamine that reduces symptoms caused by histamine release.
full_description: Ebacore contains ebastine, an antihistamine that reduces symptoms caused by histamine release. It is prescribed for allergic rhinitis and selected urticaria symptoms. By blocking peripheral H1 receptors, it helps reduce sneezing, itching and wheals, with the dose chosen according to symptom severity, tolerability and individual risk factors.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older requiring the 20 mg strength: take 1 tablet once daily. In severe liver impairment, do not use this 20 mg regimen; the maximum ebastine dose is 10 mg daily.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water, with or without food, at the same time each day.

benefits.title: Allergic Rhinitis
benefits.description: Helps relieve sneezing, runny nose and itching associated with allergic rhinitis.

benefits.title: Urticaria
benefits.description: May reduce hives and itching when an oral antihistamine is indicated.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms an Active Metabolite
mechanisms.description: Ebastine is converted to carebastine after absorption.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Peripheral H1 Receptors
mechanisms.description: Carebastine limits histamine-mediated responses in allergic tissues.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Allergic Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced histamine activity helps control itching, wheals and selected nasal symptoms.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Review long-QT risk and interacting medicines, including some macrolides and azole antifungals.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Pregnancy
safety_sections.description: Severe liver disease may make the 20 mg strength unsuitable. Pregnancy and breastfeeding require individual advice.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid driving if sleepy or dizzy. Stop and seek urgent help for a severe allergic reaction.

composition_summary: Biotin 40 mcg + N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 50 mg + Pantothenic Acid 5 mg + Selenium 40 mcg + Iron 8 mg + Copper 0.5 mg + Zinc 17 mg + Niacin 14 mg + Folic Acid-5-Methyltetrahydrofolic Acid 0.3 mg Tablet
short_description: Tracore (Biotin) combines biotin with selected minerals, B vitamins and N-acetylcysteine for hair and nail nutritional support.
full_description: Tracore (Biotin) combines biotin with selected minerals, B vitamins and N-acetylcysteine for hair and nail nutritional support. These nutrients contribute to normal cellular processes when intake is inadequate. Supplementation may help address identified nutritional gaps, but persistent hair loss requires investigation and is not reliably corrected by vitamins alone.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Hair Nutritional Support in Inadequate Intake
benefits.description: Supplies selected micronutrients when dietary insufficiency may be contributing to poor hair condition.

benefits.title: Nail Nutritional Support
benefits.description: May help meet assessed nutrient needs relevant to normal nail formation. Benefits are not established when no deficiency is present.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Essential Micronutrients
mechanisms.description: Biotin, zinc, iron and B vitamins contribute to normal enzyme and cellular functions.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Protein and Cell Metabolism
mechanisms.description: Adequate micronutrient intake supports the metabolic processes involved in normal hair and nail formation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Addresses Nutritional Gaps
mechanisms.description: Replacing a true deficit may support recovery. It does not directly treat hormonal, autoimmune or scarring hair loss.

safety_sections.title: Investigate Persistent Hair Loss
safety_sections.description: Sudden, patchy or prolonged hair loss requires assessment for anaemia, thyroid disease, scalp disorders and other causes.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Minerals and Laboratory Tests
safety_sections.description: Avoid excess zinc, selenium or iron. Inform laboratories about biotin supplementation because some assays can be affected.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Special Conditions
safety_sections.description: Check ingredients for allergy. Iron overload, kidney disease, pregnancy and breastfeeding require individual advice.

composition_summary: Salicylic acid + niacinamide cosmetic face gel; concentrations not supplied
short_description: Acnozoe is a cosmetic face gel combining salicylic acid with niacinamide for care of oily, blemish-prone skin.
full_description: Acnozoe is a cosmetic face gel combining salicylic acid with niacinamide for care of oily, blemish-prone skin. Salicylic acid helps loosen surface cells and clear congested pores, while niacinamide supports the skin barrier. Regular, tolerated use may improve skin texture and the appearance of mild blemishes.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer once daily in the evening. For sensitive skin, start on alternate evenings for the first week, then increase to daily if tolerated.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry acne-prone skin, avoiding eyes, lips and broken skin. Do not apply additional peeling agents at the same time without advice. Use daytime sunscreen.

benefits.title: Oily and Congested Skin
benefits.description: Helps improve the appearance of excess oil and blocked pores as part of a gentle skin-care routine.

benefits.title: Mild Blemishes and Uneven Texture
benefits.description: Supports smoother-looking skin and surface care. Persistent or inflammatory acne may require prescription treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Loosens Surface Skin Cells
mechanisms.description: Salicylic acid helps reduce cohesion between dead cells within oily follicles.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports the Skin Barrier
mechanisms.description: Niacinamide contributes to epidermal barrier function and skin conditioning.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Surface Appearance
mechanisms.description: Consistent tolerated use may reduce visible congestion and improve the appearance of skin texture.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Salicylate Sensitivity
safety_sections.description: Avoid if allergic to salicylates. Stop for marked burning, peeling or rash and avoid large areas of damaged skin.

safety_sections.title: Other Exfoliants and Retinoids
safety_sections.description: Introduce carefully with retinoids, benzoyl peroxide or acid products to avoid excessive irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Young Children
safety_sections.description: Seek individual advice during pregnancy or for young children. Do not use on extensive areas or under occlusion.

composition_summary: White Soft Paraffin 13.2% + Liquid Paraffin 10.2% + Methylparaben 0.15% + Propylparaben 0.05% Cream
short_description: Coresoft combines white soft paraffin and liquid paraffin in an emollient cream for dry skin care.
full_description: Coresoft combines white soft paraffin and liquid paraffin in an emollient cream for dry skin care. The paraffins form a protective film that reduces water loss and helps soften rough skin. Regular application supports the skin barrier alongside prescribed treatment for an underlying dry or eczematous skin condition.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to dry or irritated skin three times daily and after washing. Reduce frequency if irritation occurs.

Administration Advice
Apply gently to clean skin. Avoid eyes and mucous membranes. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Keep paraffin-contaminated clothing and bedding away from flames and cigarettes.

benefits.title: Dry and Rough Skin
benefits.description: Helps soften dry skin and reduce moisture loss with regular application.

benefits.title: Adjunct Emollient Care in Eczema
benefits.description: Supports the skin barrier alongside appropriate anti-inflammatory treatment when eczema is present.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms a Protective Surface Layer
mechanisms.description: Paraffins spread over the surface and form an occlusive emollient film.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Moisture Loss
mechanisms.description: Paraffin limits transepidermal water loss and helps retain moisture within the outer skin.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Skin Comfort
mechanisms.description: Improved hydration softens rough skin and reduces dryness-related tightness and itching.

safety_sections.title: Fire Risk from Fabric Residue
safety_sections.description: Residue on clothing, bedding or dressings can make fabrics ignite more easily. Keep treated fabrics away from smoking, flames and heat sources.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Infected Skin
safety_sections.description: Stop for rash or worsening irritation. Weeping, spreading redness, pain or suspected infection requires assessment.

safety_sections.title: Application Precautions
safety_sections.description: Avoid eyes and mucous membranes. Paraffin can make floors or bathing surfaces slippery. Check preservatives and other ingredients for allergy.

composition_summary: Mupirocin 2% Ointment
short_description: Velibact contains mupirocin, a topical antibiotic used for selected superficial bacterial skin infections.
full_description: Velibact contains mupirocin, a topical antibiotic used for selected superficial bacterial skin infections. It inhibits an enzyme needed for bacterial protein synthesis and is active against susceptible staphylococci and streptococci. Use is limited to the prescribed area and course to treat infection while reducing unnecessary antibiotic exposure.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a small amount to the affected skin three times daily for up to 10 days. Reassess if there is no improvement within 3–5 days.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces. A clean gauze dressing may be used if advised.

benefits.title: Staphylococcal Impetigo
benefits.description: Treats localised impetigo caused by susceptible Staphylococcus aureus when topical treatment is appropriate.

benefits.title: Streptococcal Impetigo
benefits.description: Treats susceptible Streptococcus pyogenes impetigo within the prescribed short course.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches the Infected Surface
mechanisms.description: Mupirocin acts locally at the treated area of skin.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Isoleucyl-tRNA Synthetase
mechanisms.description: It blocks an enzyme essential for incorporation of isoleucine into bacterial proteins.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Suppresses Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Loss of essential protein synthesis controls susceptible organisms at the treatment site.

safety_sections.title: Correct Route and Formulation
safety_sections.description: This skin ointment is not the dedicated nasal product. Avoid use inside the nose, eyes or mouth unless specifically directed.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Persistent Infection
safety_sections.description: Stop for severe irritation or rash. Spreading infection, fever or poor response requires medical review.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Problems and Damaged Skin
safety_sections.description: Polyethylene glycol-containing bases may be absorbed through extensive damaged skin. Use cautiously in significant kidney impairment.

composition_summary: Calamine 8% + Liquid Paraffin 10% Cream
short_description: Camycore combines calamine with liquid paraffin to soothe mild skin irritation and reduce dryness.
full_description: Camycore combines calamine with liquid paraffin to soothe mild skin irritation and reduce dryness. Calamine provides a protective, soothing effect, while paraffin forms an emollient film that limits moisture loss. It may help improve comfort in dry, itchy skin when the underlying condition is appropriately assessed.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to dry or irritated skin three times daily and after washing. Reduce frequency if irritation occurs.

Administration Advice
Apply gently to clean skin. Avoid eyes and mucous membranes. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Keep paraffin-contaminated clothing and bedding away from flames and cigarettes.

benefits.title: Mild Itchy Skin Irritation
benefits.description: May soothe limited superficial irritation when the cause has been assessed and does not require specific treatment.

benefits.title: Dry Skin with Discomfort
benefits.description: Helps reduce dryness and improve comfort through paraffin-based emollient care.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms a Protective Surface Layer
mechanisms.description: Calamine provides a local protective and soothing effect on the skin surface.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Moisture Loss
mechanisms.description: Paraffin limits transepidermal water loss and helps retain moisture within the outer skin.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Skin Comfort
mechanisms.description: Improved hydration softens rough skin and reduces dryness-related tightness and itching.

safety_sections.title: Fire Risk from Fabric Residue
safety_sections.description: Residue on clothing, bedding or dressings can make fabrics ignite more easily. Keep treated fabrics away from smoking, flames and heat sources.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Infected Skin
safety_sections.description: Stop for rash or worsening irritation. Weeping, spreading redness, pain or suspected infection requires assessment.

safety_sections.title: Application Precautions
safety_sections.description: Avoid eyes and mucous membranes. Paraffin can make floors or bathing surfaces slippery. Check preservatives and other ingredients for allergy.

composition_summary: Glutathione + kojic acid + vitamin C + vitamin E + niacinamide face wash; concentrations not supplied
short_description: Glukozoe is a cosmetic face wash containing glutathione, kojic acid, vitamins C and E, and niacinamide for cleansing and complexion care.
full_description: Glukozoe is a cosmetic face wash containing glutathione, kojic acid, vitamins C and E, and niacinamide for cleansing and complexion care. It helps remove impurities while providing skin-conditioning ingredients. The appearance of dullness or uneven tone may improve with a suitable routine, although a rinse-off cleanser has limited contact time.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Use once in the morning and once in the evening. Reduce to once daily if dryness develops.

Administration Advice
Wet the face, massage a small amount over the skin, then rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Avoid the eye area and follow with a suitable moisturiser.

benefits.title: Daily Facial Cleansing
benefits.description: Removes surface dirt and excess oil as part of a regular skin-care routine.

benefits.title: Dull or Uneven-Looking Complexion
benefits.description: Provides cosmetic cleansing support for a fresher-looking complexion without promising treatment of melasma or permanent skin lightening.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Lifts Surface Impurities
mechanisms.description: The cleansing base helps remove dirt, oil and other surface residues.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Brief Ingredient Contact
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid, vitamins and glutathione contact the surface during washing, with effects dependent on formulation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Leaves Skin Cleansed
mechanisms.description: Rinsing removes loosened impurities. Skin-conditioning ingredients may support a comfortable after-feel.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Eye Contact
safety_sections.description: Avoid the eye area. Rinse thoroughly after accidental contact and stop for persistent burning or rash.

safety_sections.title: Over-Cleansing and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Excessive washing or combining several exfoliating products may cause dryness and barrier irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pigmentation and Product Details
safety_sections.description: Do not rely on a cleanser to treat persistent pigmentation. Concentrations and finished-product testing determine any stronger claims.

composition_summary: L-Glutathione 500 mg + Alpha-Lipoic Acid 100 mg + Resveratrol 10 mg + Astaxanthin 4 mg Tablets
short_description: Oxyvive combines glutathione with selected antioxidant ingredients for supplemental nutritional support.
full_description: Oxyvive combines glutathione with selected antioxidant ingredients for supplemental nutritional support. These compounds participate in cellular antioxidant pathways, but the effect of an oral blend depends on its formulation and the individual. It may complement a balanced diet and should not be presented as a proven skin-lightening or disease-treatment product.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Do not add other glutathione or antioxidant combinations without reviewing the total daily intake.

Administration Advice
Swallow the tablet with water after a meal. Maintain a consistent daily schedule.

benefits.title: Supplemental Antioxidant Intake
benefits.description: May be considered when a clinician identifies a reason for this antioxidant combination alongside an adequate diet.

benefits.title: Adjunct Skin Nutritional Support
benefits.description: May complement a skin-care plan when appropriate. Reliable improvement in pigmentation or prevention of skin ageing has not been established for this blend.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Antioxidant Ingredients
mechanisms.description: The listed ingredients supply antioxidant molecules or substrates involved in cellular protective pathways.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Endogenous Systems
mechanisms.description: Glutathione and related nutritional pathways participate in handling reactive oxygen species.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Nutritional Intake
mechanisms.description: Supplementation may support assessed dietary gaps. Biochemical activity does not establish a cosmetic or disease-treatment benefit.

safety_sections.title: Cancer Treatment and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Obtain clinician approval before use with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, anticoagulants or glucose-lowering medicines. Supplement interactions may be clinically important.

safety_sections.title: Allergy, Liver and Kidney Problems
safety_sections.description: Check all ingredients for allergy. Seek advice with liver or kidney disease and stop for jaundice, severe nausea or persistent abdominal pain.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Evidence Limits
safety_sections.description: Avoid unsupervised use in pregnancy, breastfeeding or children. Skin-lightening, anti-ageing and disease-treatment claims are not established for this exact formulation.

composition_summary: Clobetasol propionate 0.05% w/w + miconazole 2% w/w cream
short_description: Clobtos-M combines clobetasol, a very potent corticosteroid, with miconazole, an antifungal.
full_description: Clobtos-M combines clobetasol, a very potent corticosteroid, with miconazole, an antifungal. It may be considered only for narrowly selected inflammatory skin conditions with a susceptible fungal component after specialist assessment. Unsupervised use can suppress visible inflammation while allowing fungal infection to persist, spread or become difficult to recognise.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply a thin layer once daily for a short course of no more than 7 days before review, only to a diagnosed condition requiring both ingredients. Do not renew for an undiagnosed or spreading rash.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces. Do not cover with an airtight dressing unless specifically directed.

benefits.title: Specialist-Assessed Inflammatory Dermatitis with Fungal Complication
benefits.description: May be considered only when the clinician determines that both a very potent steroid and an antifungal are justified.

benefits.title: Short-Term Control of Selected Inflamed Infected Lesions
benefits.description: Any use should follow a confirmed diagnosis and the product’s approved indication. It is not routine first-line treatment for ringworm.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Suppresses Local Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Clobetasol activates glucocorticoid receptors and reduces inflammatory responses.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Fungal Ergosterol Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Miconazole inhibits fungal sterol synthesis and disrupts susceptible fungal membranes.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Produces Two Distinct Effects
mechanisms.description: Inflammation may improve before infection resolves. The steroid can also mask or worsen an inadequately treated fungal infection.

safety_sections.title: Fungal Infection and Steroid Misuse
safety_sections.description: Potent steroid combinations can cause steroid-modified tinea. Avoid unsupervised ringworm treatment and seek review for spreading or recurrent lesions.

safety_sections.title: Skin Thinning and Absorption
safety_sections.description: Avoid face, groin, folds, large areas and prolonged use. Skin atrophy and systemic steroid absorption are possible.

safety_sections.title: Children, Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Children and pregnant or breastfeeding patients require specialist advice. Review anticoagulants and other topical treatments.

composition_summary: Clindamycin 1% w/w + niacinamide 4% w/w + aloe + allantoin gel; aloe and allantoin concentrations not supplied
short_description: Clindaone-N combines clindamycin with niacinamide and soothing skin-care ingredients for prescribed acne treatment.
full_description: Clindaone-N combines clindamycin with niacinamide and soothing skin-care ingredients for prescribed acne treatment. Clindamycin reduces susceptible acne-associated bacteria, while niacinamide contributes anti-inflammatory and barrier-supporting effects. The gel is used on affected skin for a defined course, with review of response, irritation and the need to limit antibiotic exposure.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to the acne-affected area twice daily, morning and evening. Review at 8–12 weeks and reassess before extending the antibiotic course.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces. Apply over the acne-affected area rather than only individual spots when directed.

benefits.title: Inflammatory Acne Papules
benefits.description: May help reduce inflamed raised acne lesions when topical antibiotic treatment is appropriate.

benefits.title: Inflammatory Acne Pustules
benefits.description: May be prescribed for pustular acne lesions within a broader acne-care plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Inhibits Acne-Associated Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Clindamycin blocks protein synthesis in susceptible bacteria by acting on the 50S ribosome.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Modulates Local Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Niacinamide may reduce inflammatory responses and support skin barrier function.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Tolerability and Lesion Control
mechanisms.description: Aloe and allantoin provide skin conditioning while the prescribed acne regimen addresses active lesions.

safety_sections.title: Colitis and Severe Diarrhoea
safety_sections.description: Avoid without review if there is a history of antibiotic-associated colitis. Stop for persistent or bloody diarrhoea.

safety_sections.title: Antibiotic Resistance
safety_sections.description: Limit use to the prescribed course. The clinician may include benzoyl peroxide separately to reduce resistance.

safety_sections.title: Skin Irritation and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Avoid eyes and broken skin. Stop for severe irritation and seek advice in pregnancy, breastfeeding or young children.

composition_summary: Fluticasone furoate 27.5 mcg per metered nasal spray; 12 g pack listed in one division
short_description: Flutiriv contains fluticasone furoate, a corticosteroid nasal spray for control of allergic rhinitis symptoms.
full_description: Flutiriv contains fluticasone furoate, a corticosteroid nasal spray for control of allergic rhinitis symptoms. It reduces inflammation within the nasal lining and helps relieve congestion, sneezing, itching and discharge. Regular use gives the best effect, with the lowest effective dose chosen according to age and symptom control.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and ages 12 years or older: use 2 sprays in each nostril once daily (total 110 mcg/day); reduce to 1 spray per nostril daily once controlled. Children aged 6–11 years: use 1 spray in each nostril once daily (total 55 mcg/day).

Administration Advice
Shake and prime according to the device instructions. Gently blow the nose, tilt the head slightly forward and aim away from the nasal septum. Use regularly rather than only for immediate relief.

benefits.title: Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis
benefits.description: Controls nasal symptoms caused by seasonal exposure to allergens such as pollen.

benefits.title: Perennial Allergic Rhinitis
benefits.description: Helps manage persistent nasal symptoms associated with year-round allergens such as dust mites or animal dander.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates Local Glucocorticoid Receptors
mechanisms.description: Fluticasone furoate binds glucocorticoid receptors in the nasal mucosa.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Suppresses Allergic Inflammation
mechanisms.description: It reduces inflammatory-cell activity and the release of inflammatory mediators.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Nasal Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced swelling and irritation help control congestion, discharge, sneezing and itching over time.

safety_sections.title: Nasal Bleeding and Healing
safety_sections.description: Report persistent nosebleeds or nasal soreness. Recent nasal surgery, trauma or ulceration requires advice before use.

safety_sections.title: Growth, Eye and Steroid Effects
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose. Long-term paediatric treatment needs growth monitoring. Report visual changes and review other steroid exposure.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Infection
safety_sections.description: Review strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, including ritonavir or cobicistat. Untreated nasal infection and pregnancy require individual assessment.

composition_summary: Sodium chloride 0.9% w/v aqueous nasal spray
short_description: Flutiriv NS is a saline nasal spray that helps moisten dry nasal passages and loosen mucus.
full_description: Flutiriv NS is a saline nasal spray that helps moisten dry nasal passages and loosen mucus. It provides local physical support rather than a medicated decongestant effect. Regular use may improve comfort during dryness or congestion, with the spray technique and frequency adjusted to the person’s age and device instructions.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and older children: use 1–2 sprays in each nostril up to 4 times daily as needed. Infants require an age-appropriate saline-drop preparation and a separately prescribed technique.

Administration Advice
Gently clear the nose, insert the nozzle just inside the nostril and spray without forceful sniffing. Clean the nozzle after use and do not share the bottle.

benefits.title: Dry or Irritated Nasal Passages
benefits.description: Helps moisten the nasal lining during dry weather, air-conditioned environments or other causes of local dryness.

benefits.title: Thick Mucus and Nasal Congestion
benefits.description: Helps loosen nasal secretions and support clearance during a cold or alongside prescribed allergy treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Moistens the Nasal Lining
mechanisms.description: The saline solution supplies local moisture to dry mucosal surfaces.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Loosens Nasal Secretions
mechanisms.description: Fluid helps soften and dilute thick mucus.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Physical Clearance
mechanisms.description: Moist secretions are easier to clear through normal mucociliary activity and gentle nose blowing.

safety_sections.title: Device Hygiene
safety_sections.description: Do not share the nozzle. Follow cleaning and after-opening instructions to reduce contamination.

safety_sections.title: Persistent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Prolonged blockage, recurrent bleeding, severe facial pain or fever needs medical assessment.

safety_sections.title: Children and Recent Surgery
safety_sections.description: Use the correct device for age. Seek advice after nasal surgery or if an infant has feeding difficulty or breathing problems.

composition_summary: Amoxicillin 500 mg + clavulanic acid 125 mg per tablet
short_description: Otomentin 625 combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid for selected susceptible bacterial infections.
full_description: Otomentin 625 combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid for selected susceptible bacterial infections. Amoxicillin disrupts bacterial cell wall formation, while clavulanic acid inhibits some enzymes that would otherwise inactivate it. The medicine should be used only for an appropriate bacterial infection, with the course adjusted to the diagnosis and kidney function.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and children weighing 40 kg or more: take 1 tablet (500 mg/125 mg) every 8 hours for the prescribed course. Adjust the interval in kidney impairment.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at the start of a meal. Space doses about 8 hours apart and complete the prescribed course. Do not substitute two lower-strength tablets without checking clavulanate exposure.

benefits.title: Bacterial Respiratory and ENT Infections
benefits.description: May treat selected susceptible sinus, ear or lower respiratory infections when this antibiotic is appropriate.

benefits.title: Skin and Soft Tissue Infections
benefits.description: May be prescribed for selected susceptible bacterial skin infections after assessment.

benefits.title: Selected Urinary Tract Infections
benefits.description: May be used when clinical findings or culture results support this combination.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Inhibits Bacterial Wall Formation
mechanisms.description: Amoxicillin binds penicillin-binding proteins and inhibits peptidoglycan cross-linking.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Selected Resistance Enzymes
mechanisms.description: Clavulanic acid inhibits some beta-lactamases that would otherwise degrade amoxicillin.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Controls Susceptible Infection
mechanisms.description: The protected antibiotic can kill susceptible organisms at adequate tissue concentrations.

safety_sections.title: Beta-Lactam Allergy
safety_sections.description: Inform the doctor about penicillin or cephalosporin allergy. Stop and seek emergency care for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin reaction.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Antibiotic Resistance
safety_sections.description: Persistent or bloody diarrhoea needs medical review. Use only for prescribed bacterial infections and complete the prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney impairment may require dose adjustment. Review anticoagulants, probenecid and other medicines with the prescriber.

safety_sections.title: Previous Liver Injury
safety_sections.description: Avoid if previous amoxicillin/clavulanate caused jaundice or liver dysfunction. Report jaundice, dark urine or persistent abdominal pain.

composition_summary: Bilastine 20 mg Tablets
short_description: Bilariv contains bilastine, a generally non-sedating antihistamine used to relieve allergic rhinitis and urticaria symptoms.
full_description: Bilariv contains bilastine, a generally non-sedating antihistamine used to relieve allergic rhinitis and urticaria symptoms. It blocks peripheral histamine H1 receptors and helps reduce sneezing, itching, watery eyes and wheals. Taking the tablet away from food and fruit juice is important because these can reduce absorption.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older: take 1 tablet (20 mg) once daily.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after food or fruit juice.

benefits.title: Allergic Rhinoconjunctivitis
benefits.description: Relieves nasal and eye symptoms associated with seasonal or perennial allergic exposure.

benefits.title: Urticaria
benefits.description: Helps relieve hives and associated itching when an oral antihistamine is prescribed.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Peripheral Histamine Receptors
mechanisms.description: Bilastine selectively binds histamine H1 receptors outside the central nervous system.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Limits Allergic Tissue Responses
mechanisms.description: It reduces histamine-related itching, vascular leakage and swelling.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Allergy Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Reduced H1 signalling helps control rhinitis, conjunctival symptoms and urticarial itching.

safety_sections.title: Food and Fruit Juice
safety_sections.description: Food and fruit juice can reduce absorption. Maintain the recommended gap rather than taking the tablet with meals.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Moderate or severe kidney impairment combined with P-glycoprotein inhibitors may increase exposure. Review interacting medicines.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Individual sleepiness can occur. Assess driving tolerance and seek advice during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

composition_summary: Hesperidin Berberis aristata root ext. + Quercetin obtained from extracts of citrus fruits, vegetables and other plant sources + Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic acid) + Bromelain-pineapple (Ananas Comosus)
short_description: Histocore combines botanical-derived ingredients, quercetin, vitamin C and bromelain for nutritional support.
full_description: Histocore combines botanical-derived ingredients, quercetin, vitamin C and bromelain for nutritional support. These ingredients have antioxidant or enzyme-related properties, but the finished product’s effect depends on the extract identities, standardisation and amounts. It may complement a clinician-directed wellness plan and should not replace prescribed treatment for allergy or respiratory disease.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Use the verified finished-product directions, usually with food if an oral supplement. Do not substitute it for prescribed antihistamines, inhalers or emergency treatment.

benefits.title: Supplemental Antioxidant Intake
benefits.description: May provide selected antioxidant ingredients when a clinician considers this blend appropriate alongside the diet.

benefits.title: Adjunct Nutritional Support in Allergy Care
benefits.description: May complement an established care plan. Clinically reliable antihistamine or asthma-control effects are not established for this exact combination.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Plant-Derived Compounds
mechanisms.description: Quercetin and the specified botanicals supply polyphenols with antioxidant activity.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supplies Vitamin C and Bromelain
mechanisms.description: Vitamin C contributes to antioxidant systems, while bromelain provides proteolytic enzyme activity.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Dietary Support
mechanisms.description: These biochemical properties may support nutrition but do not establish treatment efficacy for allergy.

safety_sections.title: Extract Identity and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Berberis extracts can interact with medicines and affect glucose. Confirm whether hesperidin and Berberis are separate ingredients.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Bromelain may increase bleeding risk with anticoagulants. Avoid with relevant pineapple or ingredient allergy.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Respiratory Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Seek individual advice in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Wheeze, facial swelling or breathlessness needs appropriate medical treatment.

composition_summary: Camphor 25 mg + chlorothymol 5 mg + eucalyptol 125 mg + menthol 65 mg + terpineol 120 mg per inhalation capsule
short_description: Coldstar contains aromatic ingredients in a capsule intended to release vapours for inhalation.
full_description: Coldstar contains aromatic ingredients in a capsule intended to release vapours for inhalation. The vapours may provide a temporary sensation of easier breathing during nasal congestion. This is a symptomatic inhalation product, not an oral supplement, and it does not treat the cause of infection or replace asthma treatment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
For adults using the tissue-inhalation method: use the contents of 1 capsule per application. 

Administration Advice
Cut the capsule and place its contents on a tissue or handkerchief; inhale the vapour without touching the nose or skin. For inhalation only. Do not swallow, instil into the nostrils or add to a nebuliser. Keep away from children and avoid hot-water steam exposure.

benefits.title: Temporary Sensation of Nasal Congestion
benefits.description: May provide short-lived subjective relief of stuffiness during a cold when used according to the inhalation-product label.

benefits.title: Congestion-Related Discomfort
benefits.description: Aromatic vapour may improve comfort when nasal blockage is troublesome, alongside appropriate supportive care.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Releases Volatile Aromatic Compounds
mechanisms.description: The opened capsule releases menthol, eucalyptol and other aromatic vapours.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Stimulates Airflow Sensation
mechanisms.description: Menthol activates cold-sensitive TRPM8 receptors, producing a cooling sensation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Temporary Comfort
mechanisms.description: The sensory effect may make breathing feel easier without reliably reducing physical nasal obstruction.

safety_sections.title: Poisoning and Children
safety_sections.description: Camphor-containing contents can be toxic if swallowed and may cause seizures. Keep securely away from children and follow the pack’s age restriction.

safety_sections.title: Airway Sensitivity and Eye Contact
safety_sections.description: Stop if vapours cause wheezing, coughing or irritation. Avoid in sensitive asthma without advice and keep away from eyes.

safety_sections.title: Heat and Handling
safety_sections.description: Do not use near flames or heated devices unless specifically designed for the product. Hot-water inhalation can cause serious burns, particularly in children.

composition_summary: Fluticasone propionate 50 mcg + azelastine 140 mcg per metered nasal spray (as supplied)
short_description: Flutiriv AZ combines fluticasone propionate with azelastine in a nasal spray for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms.
full_description: Flutiriv AZ combines fluticasone propionate with azelastine in a nasal spray for selected allergic rhinitis symptoms. Fluticasone reduces nasal inflammation, while azelastine blocks histamine effects. The combination may be prescribed when one treatment is insufficient, with regular use and correct spray technique helping achieve consistent symptom control.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older: use 1 spray in each nostril twice daily, morning and evening.

Administration Advice
Shake and prime the pump as directed on the device. Gently blow the nose, tilt the head slightly forward and aim away from the nasal septum. Breathe in gently during spraying; do not tilt the head backwards.

benefits.title: Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis Requiring Combination Therapy
benefits.description: May be prescribed when an intranasal steroid or antihistamine alone does not adequately control symptoms.

benefits.title: Persistent Allergic Rhinitis Symptoms
benefits.description: May help ongoing congestion, sneezing, itching and discharge when the clinician selects this combination under the local label.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Local Histamine Effects
mechanisms.description: Azelastine blocks H1 receptors within nasal tissues.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Nasal Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Fluticasone propionate activates glucocorticoid receptors and suppresses inflammatory responses.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Multiple Nasal Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Combined local actions can reduce congestion, sneezing, itching and discharge when appropriately prescribed.

safety_sections.title: Nosebleeds and Local Injury
safety_sections.description: Persistent bleeding, soreness or ulceration requires review. Recent nasal surgery or trauma may delay suitability for treatment.

safety_sections.title: Sleepiness and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Azelastine may cause drowsiness. Avoid driving if affected and review alcohol, sedatives and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.

safety_sections.title: Growth and Eye Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose. Continued use in children needs growth review, and visual changes require medical assessment.

composition_summary: Amoxicillin 200 mg + clavulanic acid 28.5 mg per 5 mL after reconstitution (volume basis inferred)
short_description: Otomentin DS combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid in a dry syrup for reconstitution.
full_description: Otomentin DS combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid in a dry syrup for reconstitution. It is prescribed for selected susceptible bacterial infections in children. Amoxicillin disrupts the bacterial cell wall, while clavulanic acid protects against certain bacterial enzymes. Dosing must be calculated from body weight and the reconstituted concentration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 3 months or older and under 40 kg: for less severe susceptible infection, give 0.3125 mL/kg per dose every 12 hours (25 mg/kg/day amoxicillin). For otitis media, sinusitis, lower-respiratory or more severe infection, give 0.5625 mL/kg per dose every 12 hours (45 mg/kg/day). Do not exceed the corresponding adult amoxicillin dose. The prescription must state the rounded mL dose and course.

Administration Advice
Reconstitute with the exact water volume on the pack. Shake well before each dose and measure with an oral syringe. Give at the start of a meal, about 12 hours apart. Follow the pack’s refrigeration and discard date.

benefits.title: Bacterial Ear and Sinus Infections
benefits.description: May treat selected acute bacterial otitis media or sinusitis when the organism and clinical assessment support use.

benefits.title: Selected Respiratory or Skin Infections
benefits.description: May be prescribed for susceptible lower respiratory or skin infections according to diagnosis and severity.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Amoxicillin

short_description: Otomentin Duo combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid in a dry syrup for reconstitution.
full_description: Otomentin Duo combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid in a dry syrup for reconstitution. It is prescribed for selected susceptible bacterial infections in children. Amoxicillin disrupts the bacterial cell wall, while clavulanic acid protects against certain bacterial enzymes. Dosing must be calculated from body weight and the reconstituted concentration.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 3 months or older and under 40 kg: for less severe susceptible infection, give 0.15625 mL/kg per dose every 12 hours (25 mg/kg/day amoxicillin). For otitis media, sinusitis, lower-respiratory or more severe infection, give 0.28125 mL/kg per dose every 12 hours (45 mg/kg/day). Do not exceed the corresponding adult amoxicillin dose. The prescription must state the rounded mL dose and course.

Administration Advice
Reconstitute with the exact water volume on the pack. Shake well before each dose and measure with an oral syringe. Give at the start of a meal, about 12 hours apart. Duo is twice the amoxicillin concentration of DS; do not reuse the DS mL dose. Follow the pack’s refrigeration and discard date.

short_description: Moxable contains moxifloxacin, a topical fluoroquinolone antibiotic for selected bacterial conjunctival infections.
full_description: Moxable contains moxifloxacin, a topical fluoroquinolone antibiotic for selected bacterial conjunctival infections. The drops should be used for the prescribed course, with careful dropper hygiene and medical review if pain, swelling or vision changes develop.

Dosing and Schedule
Instil 1 drop into each affected eye three times daily for 7 days.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes.

benefits.title: Gram-Positive Bacterial Conjunctivitis

benefits.title: Gram-Negative Bacterial Conjunctivitis
benefits.description: Treats susceptible gram-negative conjunctival infection after clinical assessment. It does not treat allergic or viral conjunctivitis.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reaches the Infected Eye Surface
mechanisms.description: Moxifloxacin acts locally against susceptible bacteria at the ocular surface.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Bacterial DNA Enzymes
mechanisms.description: It inhibits DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV, which are required for bacterial DNA maintenance.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Kills Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Interrupted DNA replication and repair lead to bacterial death.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Irritation
safety_sections.description: Avoid if allergic to this antibiotic or related medicines. Stop and seek urgent help for facial swelling, breathing difficulty or a severe rash.

safety_sections.title: Persistent or Worsening Infection
safety_sections.description: Seek review if symptoms worsen or fail to improve within 48 hours. Prolonged unnecessary use can encourage resistant bacteria or fungal overgrowth.

safety_sections.title: Contact Lenses and Contamination
safety_sections.description: Do not wear contact lenses during an eye infection. Keep the dropper sterile and follow the labelled discard period after opening.

short_description: Angelcent-TM combines dorzolamide with timolol to lower raised pressure inside the eye.
full_description: Angelcent-TM combines dorzolamide with timolol to lower raised pressure inside the eye. The ingredients reduce aqueous humour production through different pathways, and their combined effect can improve pressure control. It is prescribed for appropriate glaucoma or ocular hypertension when combination treatment is needed, with regular ophthalmic monitoring.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: instil 1 drop into each affected eye twice daily, approximately 12 hours apart. Continue regularly and reassess intraocular pressure at scheduled visits.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes. Close the eyelids and press the inner corner for 1–2 minutes to reduce systemic absorption. Remove contact lenses as directed by the label.

benefits.title: Open-Angle Glaucoma
benefits.description: Lowers raised eye pressure as part of prescribed treatment to reduce the risk of further optic nerve damage.

benefits.title: Ocular Hypertension
benefits.description: Helps control raised eye pressure when treatment is needed before detectable glaucomatous damage develops.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Aqueous Production
mechanisms.description: Dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase in the ciliary body.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Adds Beta-Blockade
mechanisms.description: Timolol blocks beta-adrenergic receptors and further reduces aqueous humour formation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Lowers Intraocular Pressure
mechanisms.description: Reduced fluid production helps control pressure and reduce further optic nerve injury risk.

safety_sections.title: Asthma and Heart Conditions
safety_sections.description: Timolol-containing drops are contraindicated in asthma, significant bradycardia, certain heart blocks and uncontrolled cardiac failure. Eye drops can have systemic effects.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Low Blood Glucose
safety_sections.description: Review oral beta-blockers, verapamil, diltiazem and other cardiac medicines. Beta-blockade may mask warning signs of hypoglycaemia.

safety_sections.title: Sulfonamide Reactions and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors may cause sulfonamide-type hypersensitivity. Severe kidney impairment or acid-base disturbance requires avoidance or specialist review.

safety_sections.title: Application and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Use punctal pressure after instillation to reduce systemic absorption. Attend eye-pressure checks and seek advice for breathing difficulty, faintness or a slow pulse.

Treatment is limited to the surgeon’s prescribed schedule because prolonged or inappropriate use may delay healing or cause serious corneal adverse effects.

Dosing and Schedule
Adults: instil 1 drop into the operated eye three times daily, starting 1 day before cataract surgery, continuing on the day of surgery and for 14 days afterwards. The surgical team must prescribe any additional preoperative dose.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes. Shake the suspension well before use.

full_description: Olgerix contains olopatadine, an antihistamine and mast-cell stabiliser used to relieve itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis. It blocks histamine-related responses at the ocular surface and helps limit mediator release. The dosing frequency depends on concentration, and infection or unexplained eye pain should be assessed separately.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Instil 1 drop into each affected eye twice daily, 6–8 hours apart.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes.

benefits.title: Seasonal Allergic Conjunctivitis
benefits.description: Helps relieve ocular itching associated with seasonal allergen exposure.

benefits.title: Perennial Allergic Conjunctivitis
benefits.description: May relieve persistent allergen-related eye itching when prescribed according to the product label.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Histamine H1 Receptors
mechanisms.description: Olopatadine prevents histamine from activating H1 receptors at the ocular surface.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Stabilises Mast Cells
mechanisms.description: It reduces release of mediators involved in the allergic response.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Relieves Allergy-Related Itching
mechanisms.description: Reduced histamine activity helps control itching and associated allergic discomfort.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Persistent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Pain, purulent discharge, light sensitivity, reduced vision or persistent redness needs examination rather than repeated allergy-drop use.

safety_sections.title: Contact Lenses and Preservatives
safety_sections.description: Remove lenses before instillation and follow label advice on reinsertion, commonly after at least 10 minutes. Do not treat lens-related irritation with these drops.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Age-Specific Use
safety_sections.description: Stop for a significant allergic reaction. Use in young children, pregnancy or breastfeeding requires individual advice.

Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes.

benefits.title: Environmental Ocular Surface Irritation

mechanisms.title: 01 — Spreads over the Ocular Surface
mechanisms.description: The lubricant forms a moist film across the cornea and conjunctiva.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Retains Water and Reduces Friction

mechanisms.title: 03 — Improves Temporary Comfort
mechanisms.description: Better lubrication reduces dryness-related friction and irritation without treating every underlying cause of dry eye.

safety_sections.title: Persistent Pain or Vision Change
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek examination for eye pain, reduced vision, marked redness or symptoms that persist or worsen.

safety_sections.title: Dropper Hygiene and Discard Period

safety_sections.title: Contact Lenses and Blurring
safety_sections.description: Check compatibility with contact lenses and remove them if the label requires it. Wait until temporary blurring clears before driving.
