safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and interacting medicines, including levodopa, require individual review.

composition_summary: Proprietary Probiotic Matrix (64 mg) 26 Billion CFU Lab4™, Clinical Cultures Lactobacillus acidophilus (ATCC SD6865), Lactobacillus acidophilus (ATCC SD6866), Bifidobacterium bifidum (ATCC SD6869), Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis (ATCC Sd6870), Active Microbiome Blend Lactobacillus rhamnosus (IMC501), Lactobacillus paracasei (IMC502), Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid 100 mg, Valerian Extract (root) (0.8% valerenic acids) 50 mg, Melatonin (immediate release) 0.75 mg, Melatonin (delayed release) 0.75 mg Capsule
short_description: Neurorelax combines a multi-strain probiotic blend with GABA, valerian extract and immediate- and delayed-release melatonin.
full_description: Neurorelax combines a multi-strain probiotic blend with GABA, valerian extract and immediate- and delayed-release melatonin. It is intended for supplemental sleep and microbiota support in adults. Melatonin contributes to sleep timing, while benefits from the complete combination remain formulation-specific and should be assessed alongside sleep habits and other medicines.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule 30–60 minutes before bedtime. This supplies 1.5 mg total melatonin. Review response after 2–4 weeks before continuing.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water in the evening and allow a full night for sleep. Do not crush the delayed-release component or combine with alcohol or other sedatives.

benefits.title: Occasional Difficulty Initiating Sleep
benefits.description: May support sleep timing when a clinician considers melatonin appropriate after assessment of sleep habits and underlying causes.

benefits.title: Supplemental Microbiota Support
benefits.description: Provides the listed probiotic organisms for intestinal microbial support. This does not establish treatment of anxiety, depression or chronic insomnia.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides a Melatonin Signal
mechanisms.description: Immediate- and delayed-release melatonin can activate receptors involved in circadian sleep timing.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Adds Other Calming Ingredients
mechanisms.description: Valerian and GABA are included for proposed calming effects, but reliable benefits of the exact blend are not established.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Delivers Probiotic Organisms
mechanisms.description: The microbial blend provides specified organisms whose gastrointestinal effects depend on strain viability and individual response.

safety_sections.title: Sedation and Interactions
safety_sections.description: May cause next-day sleepiness. Alcohol, benzodiazepines, opioids and other sedatives can increase impairment.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Children and Persistent Insomnia
safety_sections.description: Avoid unsupervised use in pregnancy, breastfeeding or children. Persistent sleep problems need assessment for underlying medical or psychological causes.

safety_sections.title: Probiotic and Product-Specific Risks
safety_sections.description: Severe illness or immunosuppression needs specialist review. Confirm strain identity, viable count and release design before use.

composition_summary: Cissus quadrangularis extract 500 mg + Collagen peptide 100 mg + L-arginine 200 mg + Vitamin C 50 mg + Vitamin K2-7 45 mcg Tablets
short_description: Fracway combines Cissus quadrangularis with collagen peptides, arginine, vitamin C and vitamin K2 for bone and connective-tissue nutritional support.
full_description: Fracway combines Cissus quadrangularis with collagen peptides, arginine, vitamin C and vitamin K2 for bone and connective-tissue nutritional support. These ingredients may complement an assessed recovery diet. The formulation should not be presented as a proven way to accelerate fracture union or replace immobilisation, surgery or prescribed fracture management.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support During Fracture Recovery
benefits.description: May complement adequate calories, protein and prescribed fracture care when the clinician identifies dietary support needs.

benefits.title: Connective-Tissue Nutrient Intake
benefits.description: Supplies selected ingredients involved in normal collagen-related and bone-protein processes when intake is inadequate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Connective-Tissue Nutrients
mechanisms.description: Collagen peptides and arginine supply nutritional substrates, while vitamin C supports collagen-related enzyme activity.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Vitamin K-Dependent Proteins
mechanisms.description: Vitamin K2 participates in activation of vitamin K-dependent proteins involved in bone physiology.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Adds a Botanical Component
mechanisms.description: Cissus has been studied in small trials, but findings from other combinations do not validate fracture acceleration with this formula.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin K and Anticoagulants
safety_sections.description: Vitamin K2 can interfere with warfarin and related vitamin K antagonists. Use only after anticoagulation review.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Botanical Variability
safety_sections.description: Confirm collagen source and Cissus extract identity. Avoid with relevant animal-protein or botanical allergy.

safety_sections.title: Fracture Care and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Do not replace orthopaedic follow-up. Seek individual advice in pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney disease or before surgery.

composition_summary: Curcuma longa (curcumin 95%) 200 mg + Rosehip 200 mg Chondroitin sulfate sodium 200 mg + Elemental magnesium 45 mg + Collagen type I 40 mg + Vitamin C 35 mg Sodium hyaluronate 30 mg + Vitamin D 400 IU Capsules
short_description: Curajoy combines curcumin, rosehip, chondroitin and selected connective-tissue nutrients for supplemental joint support.
full_description: Curajoy combines curcumin, rosehip, chondroitin and selected connective-tissue nutrients for supplemental joint support. The ingredients participate in antioxidant, cartilage-related or nutritional pathways. It may complement exercise and an individual osteoarthritis care plan, but improvement in pain, cartilage structure or disease progression is not established for this exact formulation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily. Reassess joint symptoms and total vitamin D intake before continuing long term.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Adjunct Joint Nutritional Support
benefits.description: May complement an assessed joint-care plan when a clinician considers these ingredients appropriate.

benefits.title: Inadequate Connective-Tissue Micronutrient Intake
benefits.description: Provides selected vitamins and minerals when dietary intake is inadequate. It is not a replacement for adequate protein or prescribed treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supplies Antioxidant Botanicals
mechanisms.description: Curcumin and rosehip provide compounds with antioxidant and inflammatory-signalling activity in experimental systems.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Matrix-Related Components
mechanisms.description: Chondroitin, collagen and hyaluronate are included as connective-tissue-related nutritional ingredients.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Nutrient-Dependent Functions
mechanisms.description: Vitamins C and D and magnesium contribute to normal connective-tissue, muscle or bone physiology.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Surgery
safety_sections.description: Review anticoagulants, antiplatelets and planned surgery because several ingredients may affect bleeding or interact with treatment.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Liver Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Check collagen and chondroitin sources. Stop for jaundice, persistent nausea or significant abdominal pain.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Vitamin Intake
safety_sections.description: Review kidney impairment and total vitamin D or magnesium intake. Pregnancy and breastfeeding require individual advice.

composition_summary: Glucosamine Sulphate Potassium Chloride 750 mg + Methylsulfonylmethane 250 mg + Diacerein 50 mg + Chondroitin Sulphate 100 mg + Manganese Sulphate 3 mg Sodium Borate 0.5 mg + Selenium 70 mcg Tablets
short_description: Jorelax combines diacerein with glucosamine, methylsulfonylmethane, chondroitin and selected minerals for prescribed osteoarthritis care.
full_description: Jorelax combines diacerein with glucosamine, methylsulfonylmethane, chondroitin and selected minerals for prescribed osteoarthritis care. Diacerein is a pharmacologically active medicine with a slow symptomatic effect. The combination requires individual assessment because diarrhoea, liver injury, interactions and age-related risks can make treatment unsuitable for some patients.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults younger than 65 years: start with 1 tablet once daily for 2–4 weeks. If tolerated and ongoing treatment is required, increase to 1 tablet twice daily. Do not exceed 2 tablets daily (diacerein 100 mg/day). Stop treatment if diarrhoea develops.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with food and water. At the twice-daily stage, take after breakfast and the evening meal. Do not use for immediate pain relief; reassess benefit and liver function during continued treatment.

benefits.title: Symptomatic Knee Osteoarthritis
benefits.description: May be prescribed for selected patients after assessment of expected benefit, alternatives and diacerein-related risks.

benefits.title: Symptomatic Hip Osteoarthritis
benefits.description: May be considered in selected hip osteoarthritis where the locally approved indication and patient profile support use.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Slow-Acting Pharmacological Activity
mechanisms.description: Diacerein is converted to rhein and modulates interleukin-1-related inflammatory pathways.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supplies Joint-Related Ingredients
mechanisms.description: Glucosamine and chondroitin provide compounds associated with cartilage matrix physiology.

mechanisms.title: 03 — May Reduce Osteoarthritis Symptoms
mechanisms.description: Symptomatic effects can take weeks and do not establish cartilage regrowth or reversal of osteoarthritis.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Older Age
safety_sections.description: Diacerein can cause severe diarrhoea and dehydration. Stop if diarrhoea occurs. It is generally not recommended from age 65 under EMA safety guidance.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Avoid with current or previous liver disease. Monitor liver symptoms and function as advised.

safety_sections.title: Interactions, Allergy and Organ Function
safety_sections.description: Review warfarin, diabetes, shellfish or collagen-related allergy and kidney impairment. Do not use during pregnancy or breastfeeding without specialist advice.

composition_summary: Aflapin (Boswellia serrata gum resin extract) 100mg + Mobilee (Native Collagen Type II) 40mg + (Contains Sodium Hyaluronate, Polysaccharides and collagen) Capsules
short_description: OneFLEXO combines a Boswellia serrata extract with a collagen- or hyaluronate-related ingredient for supplemental joint support.
full_description: OneFLEXO combines a Boswellia serrata extract with a collagen- or hyaluronate-related ingredient for supplemental joint support. Boswellia constituents have anti-inflammatory signalling effects, while the companion ingredient may support joint-related nutrition. The exact branded ingredient identity needs confirmation before applying evidence from a particular native collagen or hyaluronate formulation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
One capsule daily after meal orally with water for minimum 2-3 months or more depending upon the severity of condition, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Adjunct Joint-Comfort Support
benefits.description: May complement exercise, weight management and clinician-directed care in selected people with joint discomfort.

benefits.title: Supplemental Joint-Related Nutrition
benefits.description: Provides the verified companion ingredient when a clinician considers it appropriate. It does not establish cartilage regeneration.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Boswellia Constituents
mechanisms.description: The extract supplies boswellic-acid-related compounds that may influence inflammatory signalling.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Adds a Joint-Related Ingredient
mechanisms.description: A verified hyaluronate matrix or native collagen ingredient would have different proposed actions.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Joint Care
mechanisms.description: Any symptomatic benefit depends on the exact ingredients, doses and evidence and should be reviewed clinically.

safety_sections.title: Ingredient Identity and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Confirm whether the formula contains Mobilee, native type II collagen or both. Review the animal source and relevant allergy.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Tolerance
safety_sections.description: Review anticoagulants and other joint supplements. Stop for significant gastrointestinal upset or allergic symptoms.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Progressive Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Seek individual advice in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Hot, swollen joints or worsening functional loss needs medical assessment.

composition_summary: Vitamin D3 600 IU + Vitamin K2 as MK-7 55 mcg Tablets
short_description: DuoDK combines vitamin D3 with vitamin K2 as menaquinone-7 for nutritional bone support.
full_description: DuoDK combines vitamin D3 with vitamin K2 as menaquinone-7 for nutritional bone support. Vitamin D helps maintain calcium and phosphate absorption, while vitamin K supports activation of vitamin K-dependent proteins. It complements adequate dietary calcium and a balanced diet when assessed nutrient intake is insufficient.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Inadequate Vitamin D and K Intake
benefits.description: Supplements the listed vitamins when dietary assessment indicates a need for this combination.

benefits.title: Adjunct Bone Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Supports normal bone-related physiology alongside adequate calcium, protein and appropriate exercise. It does not replace osteoporosis-specific medicines.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supports Calcium Absorption
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D3 is converted to active metabolites that support calcium and phosphate absorption.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Activates Vitamin K-Dependent Proteins
mechanisms.description: Vitamin K2 is a cofactor for carboxylation of proteins involved in bone and other physiological functions.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Bone Nutrition
mechanisms.description: Adequate vitamin D, vitamin K and dietary mineral intake support normal skeletal maintenance.

safety_sections.title: Warfarin and Related Medicines
safety_sections.description: Vitamin K2 can alter vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation. Do not start or change intake without the anticoagulation clinician’s advice.

safety_sections.title: High Calcium and Duplicate Supplements
safety_sections.description: Review total vitamin D intake. High blood calcium, kidney stones or granulomatous disease requires individual assessment.

safety_sections.title: Dose Expectations
safety_sections.description: This nutritional dose is not a high-dose deficiency treatment. Pregnancy, breastfeeding and children need age-appropriate advice.

composition_summary: Trypsin-Chymotrypsin 150000 AU, Aceclofenac 100 mg & Paracetamol 325 mg Tablets
short_description: Trypcor combines aceclofenac with paracetamol and trypsin-chymotrypsin for short-term relief of selected painful inflammatory conditions.
full_description: Trypcor combines aceclofenac with paracetamol and trypsin-chymotrypsin for short-term relief of selected painful inflammatory conditions. Aceclofenac reduces prostaglandin-mediated pain and inflammation. The enzyme ingredients are included as adjuncts, but additional benefits for swelling or recovery are not consistently established and do not replace treatment of the underlying cause.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet twice daily for the shortest necessary course. Do not exceed 2 tablets in 24 hours; this supplies the maximum 200 mg daily aceclofenac dose.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water immediately after breakfast and the evening meal. Do not crush an enteric-coated enzyme component. Avoid other NSAIDs and review other paracetamol-containing medicines before use.

benefits.title: Acute Musculoskeletal Pain and Inflammation
benefits.description: May be prescribed briefly for assessed painful strains, sprains or other inflammatory musculoskeletal conditions.

benefits.title: Selected Post-Injury or Postoperative Pain
benefits.description: May provide symptomatic relief when the treating clinician considers the combination appropriate and bleeding risk acceptable.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Inflammatory Prostaglandins
mechanisms.description: Aceclofenac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase-mediated prostaglandin production.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Adds Central Pain Relief
mechanisms.description: Paracetamol supports analgesia mainly through central pain pathways.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Adjunct Proteolytic Activity
mechanisms.description: Trypsin-chymotrypsin supplies proteolytic enzyme activity, with limited evidence for additional clinical reduction of swelling.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active peptic ulcer, previous NSAID-related bleeding or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Stop and seek urgent care for black stools or vomiting blood.

safety_sections.title: Kidney, Heart and Liver Problems
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose briefly. Kidney disease, dehydration, cardiovascular disease and liver problems need medical assessment.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, particularly from 20 weeks onwards. Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Review anticoagulants and other interacting medicines.

safety_sections.title: Enzymes and Other Ingredients
safety_sections.description: Avoid duplicate paracetamol and excessive alcohol. Review anticoagulants because proteolytic enzymes may add bleeding risk.

composition_summary: Trypsin 48 mg + Bromelain 90 mg + Rutoside Trihydrate 100 mg + Aceclofenac 100 mg Tablets
short_description: Trypcor-BR combines aceclofenac with bromelain, trypsin and rutoside for short-term relief of selected painful inflammatory conditions.
full_description: Trypcor-BR combines aceclofenac with bromelain, trypsin and rutoside for short-term relief of selected painful inflammatory conditions. Aceclofenac reduces prostaglandin-mediated pain and inflammation. The enzyme ingredients are included as adjuncts, but additional benefits for swelling or recovery are not consistently established and do not replace treatment of the underlying cause.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet twice daily for the shortest necessary course. Do not exceed 2 tablets in 24 hours; this supplies the maximum 200 mg daily aceclofenac dose.

Administration Advice
Swallow the tablet whole with water immediately after breakfast and the evening meal. Do not crush an enteric-coated enzyme component or combine with other NSAIDs.

benefits.title: Acute Musculoskeletal Pain and Inflammation
benefits.description: May be prescribed briefly for assessed painful strains, sprains or other inflammatory musculoskeletal conditions.

benefits.title: Selected Post-Injury or Postoperative Pain
benefits.description: May provide symptomatic relief when the treating clinician considers the combination appropriate and bleeding risk acceptable.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Inflammatory Prostaglandins
mechanisms.description: Aceclofenac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase-mediated prostaglandin production.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Provides Adjunct Enzyme and Flavonoid Components
mechanisms.description: Trypsin, bromelain and rutoside have proposed proteolytic or inflammatory-signalling actions; clinical benefit is formulation-specific.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Adjunct Proteolytic Activity
mechanisms.description: The blend is intended to complement symptomatic care; it does not prove accelerated tissue healing.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active peptic ulcer, previous NSAID-related bleeding or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Stop and seek urgent care for black stools or vomiting blood.

safety_sections.title: Kidney, Heart and Liver Problems
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose briefly. Kidney disease, dehydration, cardiovascular disease and liver problems need medical assessment.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, particularly from 20 weeks onwards. Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Review anticoagulants and other interacting medicines.

safety_sections.title: Enzymes and Other Ingredients
safety_sections.description: Review anticoagulants and planned surgery. Avoid with relevant pineapple or enzyme allergy.

composition_summary: Tofacitinib 11 mg Extended Release Tablets
short_description: TOFCORE-11 contains extended-release tofacitinib, an oral Janus kinase inhibitor used in selected immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
full_description: TOFCORE-11 contains extended-release tofacitinib, an oral Janus kinase inhibitor used in selected immune-mediated inflammatory diseases. It reduces signalling by cytokines involved in inflammation. Treatment requires specialist selection, screening and monitoring because serious infection, cancer, major cardiovascular events and thrombosis can occur, particularly in patients with relevant risk factors.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis or ankylosing spondylitis requiring this formulation: take 1 extended-release tablet (11 mg) once daily. Moderate or severe kidney impairment, moderate liver impairment or relevant interacting medicines require a different reduced-dose regimen and formulation.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water at the same time daily, with or without food. Do not split, crush or chew. Do not interchange with immediate-release tablets without a prescribing change.

benefits.title: Selected Rheumatoid Arthritis
benefits.description: May be used after an inadequate response or intolerance to appropriate prior therapies, according to the local indication and risk assessment.

benefits.title: Selected Psoriatic Arthritis
benefits.description: May be prescribed for eligible adults after previous treatment has been reviewed.

benefits.title: Selected Ankylosing Spondylitis
benefits.description: May be considered in eligible adults when the approved indication and prior-treatment requirements are met.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Inhibits Janus Kinases
mechanisms.description: Tofacitinib inhibits intracellular JAK-dependent signalling.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Cytokine Responses
mechanisms.description: This limits downstream signalling from multiple immune-regulating cytokine receptors.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Suppresses Inflammatory Activity
mechanisms.description: Reduced immune signalling can improve disease activity in appropriately selected patients.

safety_sections.title: Serious Infection and Screening
safety_sections.description: Screen for tuberculosis and relevant hepatitis and assess blood counts before treatment. Do not start during active serious infection and review vaccination needs.

safety_sections.title: Cancer and Cardiovascular Risk
safety_sections.description: Assess malignancy, smoking, cardiovascular and thrombotic risk before treatment. Use only when the specialist judges expected benefit appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Monitoring and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Monitor blood counts, liver enzymes and lipids. Kidney or liver impairment and strong CYP inhibitors may require a different dose or formulation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Urgent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy and follow contraception and breastfeeding restrictions. Fever, chest pain, breathlessness or leg swelling needs urgent assessment.

composition_summary: Aceclofenac 200 mg + rabeprazole 20 mg per tablet
short_description: Frecox-R combines aceclofenac with rabeprazole for selected painful inflammatory conditions when both an NSAID and acid suppression are appropriate.
full_description: Frecox-R combines aceclofenac with rabeprazole for selected painful inflammatory conditions when both an NSAID and acid suppression are appropriate. Aceclofenac reduces pain and inflammation, while rabeprazole lowers stomach acid. Acid suppression does not remove the NSAID’s bleeding, kidney or cardiovascular risks, and treatment should remain brief and individually reviewed.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Swallow the tablet whole with water at the prescribed meal-related time. Do not crush a sustained-release or gastro-resistant component. Follow the actual fixed-combination label.

benefits.title: Painful Inflammatory Musculoskeletal Conditions
benefits.description: May relieve assessed joint or musculoskeletal pain when an NSAID is appropriate.

benefits.title: NSAID Therapy Requiring Acid Suppression
benefits.description: May be selected when the clinician identifies a concurrent need for proton pump inhibitor gastroprotection.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Prostaglandin-Mediated Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Aceclofenac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase activity and reduces inflammatory pain.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Suppresses Gastric Acid
mechanisms.description: Rabeprazole inhibits the gastric proton pump.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Combines Symptomatic and Acid Control
mechanisms.description: The two actions address separate clinical needs but do not eliminate serious NSAID toxicity.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active peptic ulcer, previous NSAID-related bleeding or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Stop and seek urgent care for black stools or vomiting blood.

safety_sections.title: Kidney, Heart and Liver Problems
safety_sections.description: Use the lowest effective dose briefly. Kidney disease, dehydration, cardiovascular disease and liver problems need medical assessment.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy unless specifically prescribed, particularly from 20 weeks onwards. Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Review anticoagulants and other interacting medicines.

composition_summary: Aceclofenac 1.5% w/w + linseed oil 3% w/w + methyl salicylate 10% w/w + menthol 5% w/w + capsaicin 3% w/w
short_description: Frecox Gel combines topical aceclofenac with linseed oil, methyl salicylate, menthol and capsaicin for selected local musculoskeletal discomfort.
full_description: Frecox Gel combines topical aceclofenac with linseed oil, methyl salicylate, menthol and capsaicin for selected local musculoskeletal discomfort. The ingredients have anti-inflammatory or sensory counter-irritant actions. The capsaicin concentration requires verification before use because the supplied value differs greatly from common low-strength topical pain-relief formulations.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
For external use only on intact skin after label verification. Avoid heat pads, tight dressings, vigorous massage, eyes and mucous membranes. Wash hands thoroughly afterwards.

benefits.title: Local Muscle or Joint Discomfort
benefits.description: May be used for limited symptomatic relief once the finished formula and safe application directions are confirmed.

benefits.title: Minor Soft-Tissue Pain
benefits.description: May complement appropriate care for a minor strain or sprain after assessment and verification of the product strength.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Reduces Local Inflammatory Activity
mechanisms.description: Aceclofenac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase-related prostaglandin production.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Produces Sensory Counter-Irritation
mechanisms.description: Menthol and methyl salicylate alter local sensory perception and provide a warming or cooling effect.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Modulates Capsaicin-Sensitive Nerves
mechanisms.description: Capsaicin activates TRPV1 receptors; repeated suitable exposure can reduce sensory responsiveness, but concentration governs safety.

safety_sections.title: Capsaicin Strength and Burns
safety_sections.description: The listed 3% is not a routine low-strength pain-gel concentration. Do not use until verified. Heat or occlusion can increase serious burn risk.

safety_sections.title: Broken Skin and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Avoid wounds, irritated skin and relevant NSAID or salicylate allergy. Stop immediately for severe burning, blistering or rash.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Children and Other Treatments
safety_sections.description: Use only after individual advice in pregnancy or children. Review other topical analgesics and avoid accidental ingestion.

composition_summary: Curcuma longa 125 mg + nanocurcuminoids stated as 10% + coenzyme Q10 50 mg in water-soluble syrup
short_description: Curajoy Q10 combines curcuma-derived ingredients with coenzyme Q10 in a water-soluble syrup for supplemental antioxidant support.
full_description: Curajoy Q10 combines curcuma-derived ingredients with coenzyme Q10 in a water-soluble syrup for supplemental antioxidant support. Curcuminoids have antioxidant activity, while coenzyme Q10 participates in cellular energy pathways. It may complement an assessed nutritional plan, but benefits during cancer treatment or recovery are not established for this specific formulation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Measure the verified prescribed serving with a calibrated device. Shake if directed and follow storage instructions. Obtain oncology approval during cancer treatment.

benefits.title: Supplemental Antioxidant Intake
benefits.description: May be considered when a clinician identifies a reason for this antioxidant combination.

benefits.title: Adjunct Nutritional Support During Recovery
benefits.description: May complement an appropriate nutritional plan after illness when cleared by the treating team. It is not an anticancer therapy.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supplies Plant-Derived Antioxidants
mechanisms.description: The listed curcuminoids or tocotrienols have antioxidant activity in experimental systems.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Mitochondrial Electron Transfer
mechanisms.description: Coenzyme Q10 participates in energy production and antioxidant functions within cell membranes.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Adjunct Nutritional Support
mechanisms.description: Use may complement assessed nutritional care. These mechanisms do not establish prevention or treatment of cancer.

safety_sections.title: Cancer Treatment and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Ask the oncologist before use during chemotherapy, radiotherapy or immunotherapy. Antioxidant and herbal interactions may affect treatment.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding, Liver and Digestive Effects
safety_sections.description: Review anticoagulants and planned surgery. Stop for jaundice, persistent nausea or significant abdominal pain and seek medical advice.

safety_sections.title: Evidence and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Do not replace prescribed treatment. Pregnancy, breastfeeding, children and significant kidney or liver disease require individual advice.

composition_summary: Gemcitabine 200 mg / 1 g Injection
short_description: Gemcore contains gemcitabine, an intravenous cytotoxic medicine used in selected cancer treatment regimens.
full_description: Gemcore contains gemcitabine, an intravenous cytotoxic medicine used in selected cancer treatment regimens. Inside cells, it is converted into active metabolites that interfere with DNA synthesis. Treatment is delivered by an oncology team, with the dose and schedule based on cancer type, body surface area, blood counts and organ function.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — pancreatic cancer: 1000 mg/m² once weekly for 7 weeks, then 1 week off; subsequently on days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle. NSCLC with cisplatin: 1250 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days, or 1000 mg/m² on days 1, 8 and 15 every 28 days. Breast cancer with paclitaxel: 1250 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days. Ovarian cancer with carboplatin: 1000 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days. Adjust or withhold according to blood counts and toxicity.

Administration Advice
Give by intravenous infusion over 30 minutes in an oncology unit. Calculate the required milligrams from body surface area and select sufficient 200 mg and/or 1 g vials. Reconstitute and dilute by the exact vial instructions; use cytotoxic handling precautions.

benefits.title: Pancreatic Cancer
benefits.description: Used in selected locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer regimens according to the oncologist’s assessment.

benefits.title: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
benefits.description: May be used with cisplatin in appropriate non-small cell lung cancer treatment protocols.

benefits.title: Breast Cancer
benefits.description: May be combined with paclitaxel for selected metastatic breast cancer following prior treatment.

benefits.title: Ovarian Cancer
benefits.description: May be combined with carboplatin in selected recurrent ovarian cancer.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms Active Nucleotide Metabolites
mechanisms.description: Intracellular enzymes convert gemcitabine to diphosphate and triphosphate metabolites.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Interferes with DNA Synthesis
mechanisms.description: The metabolites inhibit ribonucleotide reductase and are incorporated into DNA.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Restricts Cancer Cell Division
mechanisms.description: Impaired DNA synthesis limits proliferation of susceptible rapidly dividing cells.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Infection
safety_sections.description: Myelosuppression requires blood-count monitoring. Fever, bleeding or marked weakness during treatment needs urgent oncology advice.

safety_sections.title: Lung, Kidney and Liver Toxicity
safety_sections.description: Report new breathlessness, reduced urine, swelling or jaundice. Organ function and haemolytic-uraemic syndrome risk require monitoring.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Reproductive Risk
safety_sections.description: Can harm a fetus. Use effective contraception for the label-specified period and discuss fertility and breastfeeding restrictions.

safety_sections.title: Infusion and Radiation Precautions
safety_sections.description: Longer infusions or excessive dosing frequency increase toxicity. Radiation-related toxicity requires coordination of treatment timing.

composition_summary: Oxaliplatin 50 mg per injection vial; concentrate or powder presentation not specified
short_description: Oxalitos 50 contains oxaliplatin, a platinum-based intravenous chemotherapy medicine used with other anticancer agents in colorectal cancer.
full_description: Oxalitos 50 contains oxaliplatin, a platinum-based intravenous chemotherapy medicine used with other anticancer agents in colorectal cancer. It forms DNA cross-links that interfere with cell division. Treatment is prescribed by an oncologist, with dose selection and adjustments based on body surface area, neuropathy, blood counts and kidney function.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults receiving FOLFOX for colorectal cancer: administer 85 mg/m² intravenously on day 1 of each 14-day cycle with leucovorin and fluorouracil. Calculate the dose from body surface area; adjust or withhold for neuropathy, blood counts, severe kidney impairment or other toxicity.

Administration Advice
Infuse over 2 hours through an oncology service, before fluorouracil. Use the pack-specified 5% glucose dilution. Do not use sodium chloride or other chloride-containing solutions, and do not mix with alkaline preparations. Use the required number of vials for the calculated dose.

benefits.title: Adjuvant Treatment of Stage III Colon Cancer
benefits.description: Used with fluorouracil and leucovorin after complete tumour removal in appropriate patients.

benefits.title: Advanced Colorectal Cancer
benefits.description: Used within selected combination chemotherapy regimens for advanced disease.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms Reactive Platinum Compounds
mechanisms.description: Oxaliplatin undergoes conversion to reactive platinum species within biological fluids.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Creates DNA Cross-Links
mechanisms.description: Platinum binds DNA and produces intra-strand and inter-strand cross-links.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Disrupts Cell Replication
mechanisms.description: DNA damage interferes with replication and transcription, leading to death of susceptible cells.

safety_sections.title: Neuropathy and Cold Sensitivity
safety_sections.description: Cold can trigger acute tingling or throat discomfort. Avoid cold exposure around treatment and report persistent numbness or functional difficulty.

safety_sections.title: Hypersensitivity and Infusion Reactions
safety_sections.description: Severe allergy can occur, including after previous tolerated cycles. Infusion staff must monitor and manage reactions immediately.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Organ Function
safety_sections.description: Monitor blood counts and kidney function. Fever, unusual bleeding, severe diarrhoea or dehydration requires prompt oncology advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Contraception
safety_sections.description: May harm a fetus and affect fertility. Follow label-specific contraception and breastfeeding restrictions.

composition_summary: Bevacizumab 400 mg/16 mL (25 mg/mL) concentrate for intravenous infusion
short_description: Bevacore 400 contains bevacizumab, a monoclonal antibody used in selected cancer regimens to inhibit vascular endothelial growth factor.
full_description: Bevacore 400 contains bevacizumab, a monoclonal antibody used in selected cancer regimens to inhibit vascular endothelial growth factor. Blocking this signal reduces formation of blood vessels that support tumour growth. Treatment is delivered by an oncology team with monitoring for hypertension, bleeding, wound-healing problems and other serious adverse effects.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — metastatic colorectal cancer: 5 mg/kg every 2 weeks with bolus-IFL chemotherapy, or 10 mg/kg every 2 weeks with FOLFOX4. First-line non-squamous NSCLC: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with carboplatin/paclitaxel. Persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with paclitaxel/cisplatin or paclitaxel/topotecan. Platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with carboplatin/gemcitabine for 6–10 cycles, then 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks alone. Select the protocol matching the indication and treatment setting; withhold for protocol-defined toxicity.

Administration Advice
Dilute the calculated weight-based dose in 0.9% sodium chloride and give by intravenous infusion only. Infuse the first dose over 90 minutes, the second over 60 minutes if tolerated, then over 30 minutes if tolerated. Do not give as an IV push or intraocular injection.

benefits.title: Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
benefits.description: Used with appropriate fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in selected treatment settings.

benefits.title: Selected Non-Squamous Lung Cancer
benefits.description: May be combined with chemotherapy in appropriate advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.

benefits.title: Selected Ovarian or Cervical Cancer
benefits.description: May be used in specific combination regimens where the locally approved indication and patient assessment support treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Binds VEGF-A
mechanisms.description: Bevacizumab binds vascular endothelial growth factor A in extracellular fluid.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Prevents Receptor Activation
mechanisms.description: Bound VEGF cannot activate its receptors on vascular endothelial cells.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Inhibits Angiogenic Signalling
mechanisms.description: Reduced signalling limits new blood-vessel formation supporting susceptible tumours.

safety_sections.title: Bleeding, Perforation and Clots
safety_sections.description: Serious haemorrhage, gastrointestinal perforation and thromboembolic events can occur. Severe abdominal pain, bleeding or sudden neurological symptoms need urgent care.

safety_sections.title: Surgery and Wound Healing
safety_sections.description: Withhold around major surgery according to the label, generally at least 28 days before and after surgery and until adequate healing.

safety_sections.title: Blood Pressure and Kidney Effects
safety_sections.description: Monitor blood pressure and urine protein. Uncontrolled hypertension, severe proteinuria or neurological symptoms may require treatment interruption.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Fertility and Administration
safety_sections.description: Can harm a fetus and affect ovarian function. Follow contraception and breastfeeding restrictions. Use only the approved oncology administration route.

composition_summary: Filgrastim 300 mcg per 1 mL injection (corrected spelling)
short_description: Oncogras contains filgrastim, a granulocyte colony-stimulating factor that helps increase neutrophil production.
full_description: Oncogras contains filgrastim, a granulocyte colony-stimulating factor that helps increase neutrophil production. It is used in selected chemotherapy and other neutropenia settings to support recovery of infection-fighting white blood cells. The dose and duration are determined by indication, body weight and blood-count response under specialist supervision.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Chemotherapy-associated neutropenia: start at 5 mcg/kg once daily, beginning at least 24 hours after cytotoxic chemotherapy. Continue until the post-nadir neutrophil count recovers, using blood-count monitoring. At 300 mcg/mL, 5 mcg/kg equals 0.0167 mL/kg; a trained professional must calculate and measure the dose. Do not give within 24 hours before chemotherapy.

Administration Advice
Administer by subcutaneous injection or the label-approved intravenous infusion route. Refrigerate as directed, do not shake and use aseptic technique. A 300 mcg vial is not a fixed dose for every patient; follow vial-specific dilution and discard instructions.

benefits.title: Chemotherapy-Associated Neutropenia
benefits.description: Helps reduce the duration or consequences of neutropenia in appropriate patients receiving myelosuppressive chemotherapy.

benefits.title: Stem-Cell Mobilisation
benefits.description: May be prescribed to mobilise peripheral blood progenitor cells before collection within a specialist protocol.

benefits.title: Selected Severe Chronic Neutropenia
benefits.description: May support neutrophil counts in selected congenital, cyclic or idiopathic neutropenia after specialist assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Activates G-CSF Receptors
mechanisms.description: Filgrastim binds granulocyte colony-stimulating factor receptors on responsive marrow cells.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Stimulates Neutrophil Production
mechanisms.description: It promotes proliferation, differentiation and activity of neutrophil precursor cells.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Neutrophil Recovery
mechanisms.description: Increased circulating neutrophils can reduce the duration of clinically important neutropenia.

safety_sections.title: Splenic and Lung Complications
safety_sections.description: Left upper abdominal or shoulder pain may signal splenic enlargement or rupture. New breathing difficulty requires urgent assessment.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Timing
safety_sections.description: Monitor neutrophils and platelets and use the prescribed chemotherapy interval. Excess white-cell counts may require adjustment.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Other Serious Reactions
safety_sections.description: Severe allergy, capillary leak, glomerulonephritis and aortitis can occur. Sickle-cell disease requires particular caution.

composition_summary: Temozolomide 100 mg per capsule
short_description: Temzoro-100 contains temozolomide, an oral alkylating anticancer medicine used in selected malignant glioma regimens.
full_description: Temzoro-100 contains temozolomide, an oral alkylating anticancer medicine used in selected malignant glioma regimens. It is converted into an active compound that damages tumour-cell DNA. Doses are calculated from body surface area and treatment phase, with regular monitoring of blood counts, liver function and infection risk.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma: 75 mg/m² once daily for 42–49 days with radiotherapy. Start maintenance 4 weeks later at 150 mg/m² once daily on days 1–5 of each 28-day cycle; increase to 200 mg/m² from cycle 2 only if counts and tolerability meet protocol criteria. Calculate capsule combinations from body surface area; adjust or withhold for toxicity.

Administration Advice
Take the entire calculated daily dose at one time with water, consistently on an empty stomach, preferably at bedtime to reduce nausea. Swallow capsules whole; do not open or crush. Use prescribed antiemetics and infection prophylaxis. Do not repeat a dose after vomiting.

benefits.title: Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
benefits.description: Used with radiotherapy and then as maintenance treatment in an appropriate specialist protocol.

benefits.title: Selected Anaplastic Astrocytoma
benefits.description: May be used in locally approved adjuvant or refractory disease settings after specialist assessment.

mechanisms.description: Temozolomide converts spontaneously to MTIC at physiological pH.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Methylates Tumour-Cell DNA
mechanisms.description: Reactive products add methyl groups to DNA bases, including guanine.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Disrupts Replication
mechanisms.description: Unrepaired DNA lesions can trigger cell-cycle arrest and death in susceptible tumour cells.

safety_sections.description: Monitor liver function. Avoid in relevant temozolomide or dacarbazine hypersensitivity and report jaundice or severe rash.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Safe Handling
safety_sections.description: May harm a fetus. Follow contraception, fertility and breastfeeding advice. Avoid contact with powder from damaged capsules.

composition_summary: Paclitaxel 30 mg per injection vial; solvent system, concentration and albumin-bound status not specified
short_description: Pacli-one-30 contains paclitaxel, an intravenous chemotherapy medicine that disrupts microtubule function and cell division.
full_description: Pacli-one-30 contains paclitaxel, an intravenous chemotherapy medicine that disrupts microtubule function and cell division. It is used in selected cancer regimens under oncology supervision. Conventional solvent-based and albumin-bound formulations have different doses, infusion procedures and premedication requirements, so the exact finished formulation must be confirmed before treatment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Your doctor or nurse will give you this medicine. Kindly do not self administer.

Administration Advice
For intravenous infusion in an oncology unit only. The oncologist must calculate the dose in mg/m² using the confirmed formulation and cancer protocol. Follow its exact dilution, filtration, premedication and infusion instructions; vial strength alone does not determine the dose.

benefits.title: Selected Breast Cancer Regimens
benefits.description: May be used in adjuvant or advanced breast cancer according to the selected formulation and approved treatment protocol.

benefits.title: Selected Ovarian Cancer Regimens
benefits.description: Conventional paclitaxel may be used with other medicines or after prior treatment, according to specialist assessment.

benefits.title: Selected Lung Cancer Regimens
benefits.description: May be combined with platinum-based therapy where the formulation-specific indication supports use.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Binds Microtubules
mechanisms.description: Paclitaxel binds beta-tubulin and promotes microtubule assembly.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Prevents Microtubule Disassembly
mechanisms.description: It stabilises microtubules and disrupts their normal dynamic function.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Interrupts Cell Division
mechanisms.description: Abnormal spindle function causes cell-cycle arrest and can lead to death of susceptible cells.

safety_sections.title: Formulation and Infusion Reactions
safety_sections.description: Severe hypersensitivity can occur. Conventional solvent-based products generally need corticosteroid and antihistamine premedication. Follow the exact formulation label.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Infection
safety_sections.description: Check neutrophil and platelet counts before treatment. Fever or unexpected bleeding needs prompt oncology assessment.

safety_sections.title: Neuropathy, Liver and Cardiac Effects
safety_sections.description: Report progressive numbness, marked weakness or palpitations. Liver impairment and neurological toxicity may require dose changes.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Administration Safety
safety_sections.description: Follow contraception and breastfeeding restrictions. Monitor the infusion site for extravasation and use cytotoxic handling precautions.

composition_summary: Liposomal calcium 350 mg  + vitamin K2 source lists 125 mg + vitamin D2 10 mcg (400 IU)
short_description: Glypocal-LP Syrup is listed as a calcium, vitamin K2 and vitamin D2 supplement for bone support.
full_description: Glypocal-LP Syrup is listed as a calcium, vitamin K2 and vitamin D2 supplement for bone support. Calcium and vitamin D contribute to normal bone mineralisation, while vitamin K supports vitamin K-dependent proteins. The serving size, elemental calcium amount and vitamin K2 unit require confirmation before paediatric dosing can be specified.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this syrup in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Measure the verified dose with a calibrated oral syringe and follow meal and storage instructions.

benefits.title: Inadequate Bone-Nutrient Intake
benefits.description: May supplement an assessed dietary gap once the finished composition and age-appropriate dose have been verified.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support During Growth
benefits.description: May complement adequate food intake and normal childhood bone development when clinically indicated. It does not replace treatment of rickets or other bone disease.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Calcium
mechanisms.description: The verified calcium component would supply mineral needed for skeletal development.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Vitamin D-Dependent Absorption
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D2 is converted to active metabolites involved in calcium absorption.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Vitamin K-Dependent Proteins
mechanisms.description: Vitamin K participates in carboxylation of relevant proteins, with dose-dependent use requiring verified composition.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin K2 Unit Discrepancy
safety_sections.description: The supplied 125 mg value is unusually high for a paediatric nutritional product. Do not use or publish a dose until it is verified.

safety_sections.title: High Calcium and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Children with high blood calcium, kidney disease or stone disorders require individual assessment.

safety_sections.title: Other Supplements and Medicines
safety_sections.description: Review total calcium and vitamin D intake and medicines, especially vitamin K antagonists. Keep the bottle out of children’s reach.

composition_summary: Zinc bisglycinate 50 mg + lysine 200 mg + vitamin B6 2 mg per 5 mL syrup (volume basis assumed; elemental zinc equivalent not supplied)
short_description: Zincolys Syrup is a nutritional supplement containing zinc bisglycinate, lysine and vitamin B6.
full_description: Zincolys Syrup is a nutritional supplement containing zinc bisglycinate, lysine and vitamin B6. It helps address nutritional deficiencies that may contribute to poor appetite, inadequate dietary intake and slow growth in children. It supports protein synthesis, nutrient metabolism and normal growth when used alongside a balanced diet.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 1–4 years: give 2.5 mL once daily. Children aged 5 years or older: give 5 mL once daily. Review after 2–4 weeks. These directions use the per-5-mL composition stated in the sheet; the manufacturer must confirm that concentration and elemental zinc equivalent before publication.

Administration Advice
Measure with a calibrated oral syringe and give with or just after a meal to reduce stomach discomfort. Follow label storage and handling directions.

benefits.title: Zinc Deficiency with Poor Appetite or Altered Taste
benefits.description: May help improve deficiency-related appetite or taste problems by replenishing zinc. It is not a general appetite stimulant for children with adequate zinc intake.

benefits.title: Inadequate Nutritional Intake from Restricted Diets
benefits.description: Supplements the listed nutrients when a limited diet does not meet assessed needs, alongside adequate calories and protein.

benefits.title: Deficiency-Related Poor Growth
benefits.description: May support normal growth when relevant nutrient gaps contribute to poor growth. The underlying cause and growth pattern need assessment.

benefits.title: Nutritional Recovery after Illness
benefits.description: May supplement specific nutrient needs during recovery when intake is temporarily inadequate.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Replenishes Essential Nutrients
mechanisms.description: Provides zinc, lysine and vitamin B6 to support assessed nutritional needs.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Protein and Cell Metabolism
mechanisms.description: Lysine supplies an essential amino acid, zinc supports normal cell division, and vitamin B6 participates in amino acid metabolism.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Deficiency-Related Recovery
mechanisms.description: Restoring zinc status may improve taste and appetite when zinc deficiency is the underlying cause.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Stomach Discomfort
safety_sections.description: Avoid with ingredient allergy. Zinc can cause nausea, vomiting or stomach pain, particularly on an empty stomach.

safety_sections.title: Excess Zinc and Vitamin B6
safety_sections.description: Review all supplements. Prolonged excessive zinc can reduce copper status, and excessive vitamin B6 can cause neuropathy.

safety_sections.title: Antibiotic and Penicillamine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Give relevant tetracycline or quinolone antibiotics at least 2 hours before or 4–6 hours after zinc unless their label differs. Separate penicillamine by at least 1 hour.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Copper Deficiency
safety_sections.description: Seek individual advice in kidney disease or known copper deficiency. Verify the elemental zinc dose rather than treating chelate weight as elemental zinc.

composition_summary: Cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) 800 IU per mL oral drops (concentration basis assumed)
short_description: Oneriv D3 Drops provides vitamin D3 in an oral drop formulation for age-appropriate supplementation or prescribed deficiency care.
full_description: Oneriv D3 Drops provides vitamin D3 in an oral drop formulation for age-appropriate supplementation or prescribed deficiency care. Vitamin D supports calcium and phosphate absorption and normal bone development. The daily volume must be calculated from the verified concentration, because different drop products can contain very different amounts per drop.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Infant nutritional supplementation: give 0.5 mL once daily to provide 400 IU vitamin D3 at the stated concentration of 800 IU/mL. Children older than 1 year requiring 600 IU/day: give 0.75 mL once daily. Deficiency treatment requires a separate regimen. Confirm the assumed 800 IU/mL label before publication.

Administration Advice
Measure with the supplied calibrated dropper or oral syringe. Give directly or in a small amount of cool feed that will be fully consumed. Do not estimate dose by drop count unless calibrated on the pack.

benefits.title: Routine Infant Vitamin D Supplementation
benefits.description: May provide the recommended supplement when the infant’s total vitamin D intake is insufficient, according to paediatric advice.

benefits.title: Assessed Vitamin D Deficiency
benefits.description: May be used in a prescribed replacement plan, with the dose and duration based on age, severity and clinical assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Cholecalciferol
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D3 is absorbed and converted to 25-hydroxyvitamin D in the liver.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Forms Active Vitamin D
mechanisms.description: Further conversion produces calcitriol, which regulates calcium and phosphate handling.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Normal Mineralisation
mechanisms.description: Appropriate vitamin D supply supports bone development alongside adequate calcium intake.

safety_sections.title: Concentration and Overdose
safety_sections.description: Confirm IU per mL rather than IU per drop. Excess vitamin D can cause high calcium, vomiting, dehydration and kidney injury.

safety_sections.title: Total Intake and Kidney Conditions
safety_sections.description: Include vitamin D from formula and other supplements. Kidney disease, stones or high calcium requires individual advice.

safety_sections.title: Deficiency Treatment and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Do not use a maintenance dose as treatment for rickets without assessment. Follow the prescribed course and monitoring plan.

composition_summary: Tricalcium phosphate 260 mg + vitamin D3 15 mcg (600 IU)
short_description: Glypocal Junior combines tricalcium phosphate with vitamin D3 in a chewable gummy for nutritional support.
full_description: Glypocal Junior combines tricalcium phosphate with vitamin D3 in a chewable gummy for nutritional support. Calcium contributes to normal bone and tooth structure, while vitamin D supports calcium absorption. The product complements a balanced diet when intake is inadequate, with supervised use and review of the amount supplied per gummy.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 4 years or older who can chew safely: give 1 gummy once daily. This supplies 600 IU vitamin D3 on the stated per-gummy basis. Review total calcium and vitamin D from food and other supplements.

Administration Advice
Give after a meal with adult supervision. The child must chew thoroughly and must not swallow the gummy whole. Keep the bottle out of reach between doses.

benefits.title: Inadequate Calcium and Vitamin D Intake
benefits.description: May supplement the listed nutrients when the diet does not meet assessed requirements.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support for Bone Development
benefits.description: Supports normal bone and tooth mineralisation alongside adequate protein, food intake and activity.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides a Calcium Salt
mechanisms.description: Tricalcium phosphate supplies calcium, with elemental content lower than the stated salt weight.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Calcium Absorption
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D3 supports intestinal uptake of calcium after metabolic activation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Bone Nutrition
mechanisms.description: Adequate mineral and vitamin intake supports normal skeletal growth.

safety_sections.title: Choking and Accidental Overconsumption
safety_sections.description: Do not give to children who cannot chew safely. Keep out of reach to prevent consumption of multiple gummies.

safety_sections.title: Elemental Calcium and Vitamin D
safety_sections.description: Verify the per-gummy amount. Tricalcium phosphate 260 mg is not 260 mg elemental calcium. Include other supplements in total intake.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Seek advice with high calcium, kidney disease or stone history. Check ingredients and gummy base for allergy.

composition_summary: Melatonin 3 mg/5 mL Syrup
short_description: Dozokid contains melatonin in an oral syrup for sleep-timing difficulties when a paediatrician considers treatment appropriate.
full_description: Dozokid contains melatonin in an oral syrup for sleep-timing difficulties when a paediatrician considers treatment appropriate. Melatonin signals biological night and can help with sleep onset in some children. It should be used alongside consistent sleep routines, after assessment of underlying causes, with the lowest suitable dose and periodic review.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
For a child selected for melatonin by the paediatrician: start with 1 mL (0.6 mg) once nightly, 30–60 minutes before bedtime. Review response, age suitability and the sleep routine before any increase. Do not repeat a dose during the night.

Administration Advice
Measure with an oral syringe marked in mL. Give at a consistent time alongside a regular bedtime routine. Avoid additional sedating products unless specifically prescribed.

benefits.title: Selected Sleep-Onset Difficulty
benefits.description: May be considered when persistent difficulty falling asleep remains after suitable behavioural and sleep-routine measures.

benefits.title: Selected Circadian Sleep-Timing Problems
benefits.description: May help shift sleep timing in an appropriately diagnosed circadian problem, with the administration time set by the clinician.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides an Evening Melatonin Signal
mechanisms.description: Melatonin activates MT1 and MT2 receptors involved in circadian timing.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Influences Sleep Readiness
mechanisms.description: Appropriately timed dosing can help align the sleep-wake cycle and support sleep onset.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Works with Behavioural Measures
mechanisms.description: Benefit depends on timing and the underlying sleep problem. It does not replace a consistent sleep routine.

safety_sections.title: Medical Assessment and Duration
safety_sections.description: Use only after paediatric review. Snoring, breathing pauses, restless legs, anxiety or prolonged insomnia may need different treatment.

safety_sections.title: Sedation and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Daytime sleepiness, headache or vivid dreams may occur. Review sedatives, seizure medicines and other interacting treatments.

safety_sections.title: Accidental Ingestion and Long-Term Uncertainty
safety_sections.description: Store securely away from children. Long-term paediatric safety and effects on development remain incompletely established.

composition_summary: Vitamin C 30 mg + vitamin B12 2.5 mcg + vitamin B6 0.7 mg + niacin 3 mg + thiamine 0.5 mg + zinc 2 mg + chicory extract 5 mg + fenugreek extract 25 mg + watercress extract 20 mg + spirulina 10 mg + honey 5 mg + lysine HCl 2 mg + carnitine tartrate 10 mg + histidine 5 mg + colostrum 20 mg
short_description: Appyone combines selected vitamins, zinc, amino-acid-related ingredients, botanicals and colostrum in a gummy supplement.
full_description: Appyone combines selected vitamins, zinc, amino-acid-related ingredients, botanicals and colostrum in a gummy supplement. It provides nutritional ingredients when a child’s dietary intake is inadequate. The product should support a balanced diet and growth assessment, without promising appetite stimulation, weight gain or improved immunity in children without a nutritional need.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 4 years or older who can chew safely: give 1 gummy once daily after a meal, using the stated one-gummy serving assumption. Confirm the age approval and per-gummy nutrient declaration before publication.

Administration Advice
Supervise the child and ensure the gummy is chewed thoroughly. Do not give as a sweet, a meal replacement or to a child unable to chew safely.

benefits.title: Restricted Dietary Variety
benefits.description: May supplement selected nutrient gaps in children with a limited diet after assessment of overall intake.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support During Recovery
benefits.description: May complement adequate food and protein intake during recovery when the clinician identifies a need for the listed ingredients.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Supplies Selected Vitamins and Zinc
mechanisms.description: The micronutrients support normal metabolic processes when dietary supply is inadequate.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Adds Amino-Acid and Food-Derived Components
mechanisms.description: Lysine, carnitine-related ingredients and the other listed components provide additional nutritional substrates.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements the Diet
mechanisms.description: Supplementation may address specific gaps when combined with adequate calories, protein and varied food.

safety_sections.title: Milk and Botanical Allergy
safety_sections.description: Colostrum is milk-derived. Review milk, fenugreek and other ingredient allergies before use.

safety_sections.title: Choking and Age Restrictions
safety_sections.description: Use only when the child can chew safely. Honey-containing products should not be given below 12 months, and the gummy’s own age limit may be higher.

safety_sections.title: Total Intake and Persistent Poor Growth
safety_sections.description: Avoid duplicate vitamins and zinc. Persistent poor appetite or growth requires assessment rather than repeated supplement use.

composition_summary: Cefpodoxime proxetil equivalent to cefpodoxime 50 mg per 5 mL after reconstitution
short_description: Doxicent DS contains cefpodoxime proxetil in a dry syrup that is reconstituted before use.
full_description: Doxicent DS contains cefpodoxime proxetil in a dry syrup that is reconstituted before use. It is prescribed for selected susceptible bacterial infections in children. The antibiotic interferes with bacterial cell wall formation, while the dose is calculated from body weight, infection type, kidney function and the concentration after mixing.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 2 months to 12 years: give 0.5 mL/kg per dose every 12 hours (5 mg/kg/dose). Pharyngitis/tonsillitis: maximum 10 mL per dose for 5–10 days. Otitis media: maximum 20 mL per dose for 5 days. Acute maxillary sinusitis: maximum 20 mL per dose for 10 days. Significant kidney impairment requires an interval adjustment.

Administration Advice
Reconstitute with the exact water volume on the pack. Shake thoroughly before every dose and measure with an oral syringe. Give with or without food, about 12 hours apart. Follow the pack’s refrigeration and discard instructions.

benefits.title: Selected Bacterial Throat or Sinus Infections
benefits.description: May be prescribed when the likely organism and local antibiotic guidance support cefpodoxime use.

benefits.title: Acute Bacterial Otitis Media
benefits.description: May be selected for a susceptible middle-ear infection after clinical assessment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Forms Active Cefpodoxime
mechanisms.description: Cefpodoxime proxetil is converted to cefpodoxime after absorption.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Inhibits Cell Wall Cross-Linking
mechanisms.description: Cefpodoxime binds bacterial penicillin-binding proteins and disrupts peptidoglycan synthesis.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Kills Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: The weakened cell wall leads to bacterial death when exposure is appropriate.

safety_sections.title: Beta-Lactam Allergy
safety_sections.description: Inform the doctor about penicillin or cephalosporin allergy. Stop and seek emergency care for breathing difficulty, facial swelling or a severe skin reaction.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Antibiotic Resistance
safety_sections.description: Persistent or bloody diarrhoea needs medical review. Use only for prescribed bacterial infections and complete the prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney impairment may require dose adjustment. Review anticoagulants, probenecid and other medicines with the prescriber.

composition_summary: L-carnosine 200 mg + DHA 150 mg + EPA 300 mg + vitamin D2 400 IU oral suspension
short_description: WayOmega-LC combines L-carnosine with DHA, EPA and vitamin D2 for supplemental nutritional support.
full_description: WayOmega-LC combines L-carnosine with DHA, EPA and vitamin D2 for supplemental nutritional support. Omega-3 fatty acids contribute to cell membrane structure, while vitamin D supports mineral metabolism. The suspension may complement an assessed diet, but improved intelligence, speech or treatment of neurodevelopmental conditions is not established for this formulation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this syrup in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Shake the suspension well and measure the verified dose with a calibrated oral syringe. Give with food if advised and follow storage instructions.

benefits.title: Inadequate Omega-3 Intake
benefits.description: May supplement dietary DHA and EPA when intake is insufficient and the formulation is appropriate for age.

benefits.title: Selected Vitamin D Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Provides the listed vitamin D amount when a clinician considers it part of the child’s total nutritional plan.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Omega-3 Fatty Acids
mechanisms.description: DHA and EPA are incorporated into cellular phospholipids.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Nutrient-Dependent Processes
mechanisms.description: Vitamin D2 contributes to calcium and phosphate regulation after metabolic activation.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Adds Carnosine-Related Substrates
mechanisms.description: L-carnosine is included for proposed cellular support, but clinical neurodevelopmental benefits are not established for this blend.

safety_sections.title: Serving Size and Duplicate Vitamin D
safety_sections.description: Confirm the volume basis before dosing and include vitamin D from all sources. Excess intake can cause high calcium.

safety_sections.title: Allergy and Bleeding Medicines
safety_sections.description: Check fish or other omega-3 sources for allergy and review anticoagulants or bleeding disorders.

safety_sections.title: Developmental Concerns
safety_sections.description: Do not use instead of hearing, speech or developmental assessment. Persistent symptoms require appropriate specialist care.

composition_summary: Kids Protein Powder (Vanilla & Chocolate Flavour)
short_description: Vitatots (400g) is a children’s nutrition powder listed in vanilla and chocolate flavours.
full_description: Vitatots (400g) is a children’s nutrition powder listed in vanilla and chocolate flavours. It is intended to supplement dietary intake when a child has an assessed nutritional gap. The protein, energy, carbohydrate and micronutrient content must be taken from the finished label to determine a suitable serving and age range.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this powder in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Prepare with the exact scoop weight and liquid volume on the pack. Use clean utensils, consume promptly and follow preparation and storage instructions. Do not use as the sole food unless specifically designed and prescribed for that purpose.

benefits.title: Inadequate Energy or Protein Intake
benefits.description: May complement meals when a dietitian or paediatrician identifies insufficient intake.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support for Children at Risk of Undernutrition
benefits.description: May be included in an individual growth-support plan alongside feeding advice and treatment of the underlying cause.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Labelled Macronutrients
mechanisms.description: The finished formula supplies protein and other nutrients according to its verified composition.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Dietary Requirements
mechanisms.description: Adequate protein supports tissue growth and maintenance, while energy supports normal physiological needs.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements a Growth-Care Plan
mechanisms.description: An appropriate supplement may help close dietary gaps alongside meals and clinical monitoring.

safety_sections.title: Allergens and Formula Identity
safety_sections.description: Confirm milk, soy, gluten and other allergens from the actual label. Do not assume a protein source or a lactose-free formulation.

safety_sections.title: Growth Assessment and Medical Conditions
safety_sections.description: Poor growth needs assessment. Kidney disease, metabolic disorders and food allergy require a specialised nutrition plan.

safety_sections.title: Preparation and Overfeeding
safety_sections.description: Use the correct dilution and serving. Excess supplement intake can displace food or provide unnecessary calories.
