composition_summary: Cyproheptadine hydrochloride 2 mg + tricholine citrate 275 mg syrup
short_description: Appycore combines cyproheptadine with tricholine citrate in a prescription syrup for selected patients with poor appetite and inadequate intake.
full_description: Appycore combines cyproheptadine with tricholine citrate in a prescription syrup for selected patients with poor appetite and inadequate intake. Cyproheptadine has antihistamine and antiserotonin actions that can increase appetite. Use requires assessment of the cause of poor intake, age-related safety and sedation risk, alongside appropriate nutritional care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 2 years or older: calculate a total DAILY cyproheptadine dose of 0.25 mg/kg, equivalent to 0.625 mL/kg/day of this syrup, and divide into 2 or 3 doses. Maximum daily volumes: ages 2–6 years, 30 mL; ages 7–14 years, 40 mL. The weight-based dose and age maximum both apply. Do not use under 2 years; confirm the assumed per-5-mL strength before publication.

Administration Advice
Measure each divided dose with an oral syringe and give at the prescribed times. Do not confuse the total daily volume with the volume per dose. Avoid sedating cough medicines and monitor alertness and food intake.

benefits.title: Poor Appetite with Clinically Assessed Underweight
benefits.description: May be considered when poor appetite contributes to inadequate intake and the clinician judges medication appropriate.

benefits.title: Selected Recovery-Related Inadequate Intake
benefits.description: May be prescribed briefly during an assessed recovery plan when expected benefit outweighs sedation and other risks.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Blocks Serotonin Receptors
mechanisms.description: Cyproheptadine antagonises serotonin receptors involved in appetite regulation.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Blocks Histamine H1 Receptors
mechanisms.description: Its antihistamine and central actions can produce sedation as well as changes in appetite.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Adds a Choline-Related Ingredient
mechanisms.description: Tricholine citrate supplies a choline-related component; its independent contribution to appetite benefit is less well established.

safety_sections.title: Age and Sedation
safety_sections.description: Do not use below 2 years without an explicit specialist rationale and verified local authorisation. Sedation, paradoxical excitation and impaired alertness can occur.

safety_sections.title: Glaucoma, Retention and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Avoid contraindicated MAOI combinations and review glaucoma, urinary retention, obstruction and other anticholinergic medicines.

safety_sections.title: Underlying Cause and Liver Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Do not routinely medicate normal selective eating. Persistent poor intake, weight loss or jaundice requires assessment.

composition_summary: Vitamin A + riboflavin (B2) + niacin (B3) + pantothenic acid (B5) + vitamin E + DHA + lysine + copper + selenium + zinc sulphate syrup
short_description: Zincolys Plus combines selected vitamins, DHA, lysine and trace minerals in a syrup for nutritional supplementation.
full_description: Zincolys Plus combines selected vitamins, DHA, lysine and trace minerals in a syrup for nutritional supplementation. The ingredients support normal metabolic, antioxidant and growth-related processes when intake is inadequate. The finished concentrations and age range must guide dosing, particularly because excessive vitamin A, zinc or selenium can cause harm.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this syrup in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Measure the verified prescribed dose with a calibrated oral syringe and give with food if advised. Follow the pack’s shaking, storage and after-opening instructions.

benefits.title: Restricted Dietary Intake
benefits.description: May supplement specific micronutrient gaps in a child with a limited diet after nutritional assessment.

benefits.title: Increased Nutritional Needs During Recovery
benefits.description: May complement adequate food and protein during recovery when the clinician identifies a need for the listed nutrients.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Provides Vitamins and Trace Minerals
mechanisms.description: The verified formulation supplies nutrients required for normal cellular enzyme activity.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Supports Protein and Membrane Nutrition
mechanisms.description: Lysine contributes an essential amino acid, while DHA is a structural fatty acid in cell membranes.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Complements Deficiency Correction
mechanisms.description: Appropriate supplementation can close identified gaps when total diet and intake are adequate.

safety_sections.title: Persistent Poor Growth or Illness
safety_sections.description: Ongoing poor appetite, weight loss or developmental concerns require clinical assessment rather than continued empirical supplementation.

composition_summary: Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus in corn oil
short_description: G G Shield contains a Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus probiotic in a corn-oil vehicle for intestinal microbial support.
full_description: G G Shield contains a Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus probiotic in a corn-oil vehicle for intestinal microbial support. The strain and viable count determine the evidence and suitable dose. It may be used as an adjunct within a paediatric digestive-care plan, while hydration, feeding and treatment of the underlying illness remain central.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Give 0.25 mL once daily, providing at least 1 billion CFU under the stated LGG concentration assumption. Use 5 drops only if the supplied dropper is calibrated to deliver 0.25 mL in 5 drops. Confirm strain, CFU concentration and drop calibration before publication.

Administration Advice
Shake as directed and measure with the supplied calibrated device. Give directly or mix into a small amount of cool feed that will be fully consumed. Do not add to hot liquids; separate oral antibiotics by at least 2 hours.

benefits.title: Support During Antibiotic Treatment
benefits.description: A verified evidence-supported strain may be considered to reduce antibiotic-associated diarrhoea risk in selected children.

benefits.title: Adjunct Intestinal Microbiota Support
benefits.description: May provide supplemental organisms after digestive illness. It does not replace oral rehydration or indicated infection treatment.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Delivers a Selected Probiotic
mechanisms.description: The oil vehicle carries the labelled viable L. rhamnosus organisms.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Interacts with the Gut Environment
mechanisms.description: An appropriate strain may influence microbial competition and barrier-related responses.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Provides Strain-Specific Support
mechanisms.description: Clinical effects depend on the exact strain and viable dose. Species identity alone is insufficient to establish benefit.

safety_sections.title: Immunosuppression and Serious Illness
safety_sections.description: Seek specialist advice for premature infants, severe illness, immunosuppression or a central venous catheter. Rare invasive probiotic infection is possible.

safety_sections.title: Dehydration and Warning Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Blood in stools, reduced urine, lethargy or persistent fever needs prompt assessment. Continue appropriate fluids and feeding.

safety_sections.title: Strain, Dose and Storage
safety_sections.description: Confirm the strain code, CFU at expiry, drop size and storage instructions. Avoid use if the product is damaged or contaminated.

composition_summary: Purified Water, Caprylic Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol and Ceteareth-20, Cyclopentasiloxane, Disodium Ethylene Dicocamide PEG-15 Disulfate, Niacinamide, Sorbitol, Glyceryl Mono Stearate, Cyclopentasiloxane (and) Dimethiconol, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Pentylene Glycol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Sodium PCA, Tasman Pepper (Tasmannia Lanceolata Extract), Zinc Oxide, D-Panthenol, Vitamin E Acetate, Citric Acid, Caprylyl Glycol, Colloidal Oatmeal, Calendula Oil Soluble Extract, Sea Buckthorn Seed Oil, Sodium Polyacrylate, Allantoin, Arginine, Lactobacillus Ferment Lysate, Di-Sodium EDTA, Sodium Hyaluronate (Low Molecular Weight), Ceramide Lotion
short_description: Dermatio Cream is a multi-ingredient moisturiser containing humectants, emollients and barrier-supporting skin-care ingredients.
full_description: Dermatio Cream is a multi-ingredient moisturiser containing humectants, emollients and barrier-supporting skin-care ingredients. Glycerin and hyaluronate help retain moisture, while lipids and silicones reduce dryness and improve skin feel. It supports a dry-skin care routine and may complement prescribed eczema care without replacing treatment of active inflammation or infection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer at least twice daily and after bathing. Reapply to dry areas as needed.

Administration Advice
Apply gently to clean skin, preferably immediately after a brief lukewarm bath. Avoid eyes and mucosal surfaces. Use clean hands or a clean spatula to prevent contamination.

benefits.title: Dry and Sensitive Skin Care
benefits.description: Helps improve hydration, softness and comfort when dryness or barrier disturbance is present.

benefits.title: Adjunct Moisturising Care in Eczema-Prone Skin
benefits.description: Supports regular barrier care alongside appropriate treatment of eczema flares and any infection.

mechanisms.title: 01 — Attracts Water
mechanisms.description: Glycerin, sodium PCA and hyaluronate act as humectants within the outer skin.

mechanisms.title: 02 — Reduces Moisture Loss
mechanisms.description: Emollient lipids and silicones form a protective surface layer that limits water loss.

mechanisms.title: 03 — Supports Barrier Comfort
mechanisms.description: Barrier-supporting and soothing ingredients may reduce dryness-related tightness and improve skin comfort.

safety_sections.title: Ingredient Allergy and Patch Testing
safety_sections.description: The formula includes oat and multiple botanical ingredients. Patch test where appropriate and stop for rash, swelling or worsening irritation.

safety_sections.title: Infected or Worsening Eczema
safety_sections.description: Weeping, crusting, spreading redness or marked pain needs assessment. A moisturiser does not replace prescribed anti-inflammatory or antimicrobial treatment.

safety_sections.title: Dosage Form and Product Claims
safety_sections.description: Confirm cream versus lotion and the exact ceramide ingredients. Do not assume SPF, fragrance-free status or proven probiotic effects from the ingredient list.
